korean-k1-l1.title: Iivowuli eziyisiseko
korean-k1-l1.concept: I-Hangul yialfabhethi yesiKorean. Isilabhili ngasinye sibhloko. Ivowuli ekuphela kwayo ibhalwa ne-**ㅇ** ngaphambili, engenasandi ekuqaleni: 아 yi-“a” nje.

korean-k1-l2.title: Iikhonsonanti eziyisiseko
korean-k1-l2.concept: Beka ikhonsonanti phambi kwevowuli ukwenza ibhloko yesilabhili: **ㄱ + ㅏ = 가** (ga). Funda ibhloko usuka ekhohlo uye ekunene.

korean-k1-l3.title: Amagama okuqala
korean-k1-l3.concept: Dibanisa iibhloko zesilabhili ukwenza amagama. Funda ibhloko nganye, uze uzithethe kunye.

korean-k1-l4.title: Iivowuli ze-Y
korean-k1-l4.concept: Ukongeza umgca omfutshane kwenza isandi se-**y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) ne-ㅔ (e) zivakala ngokufanayo kakhulu kwisiKorean sangoku.
korean-k1-l4.example: 야 · 여 · 요 · 유 (ya · yeo · yo · yu)

korean-k1-l5.title: Iikhonsonanti ezongezelelweyo
korean-k1-l5.concept: ㄹ ikwindawo ephakathi kwe-“r” ne-“l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, ngomoya), ㅋ (k, ngomoya), ㅌ (t, ngomoya) ne-ㅍ (p, ngomoya) zigqibezela iikhonsonanti eziyisiseko.
korean-k1-l5.example: 라 · 자 · 차 · 카 · 타 · 파 (ra · ja · cha · ka · ta · pa)

korean-k1-l6.title: Iikhonsonanti eziphindiweyo
korean-k1-l6.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ ne-ㅉ zizandi ezibhinqileyo: zithethe ngomqala oqinileyo ngaphandle komoya, njengesandi sokuqala kwi-“skate”.
korean-k1-l6.example: 까 · 따 · 빠 · 싸 · 짜 (kka · tta · ppa · ssa · jja)

korean-k1-l7.title: Iikhonsonanti zokugqibela
korean-k1-l7.concept: Ikhonsonanti engezantsi kwesilabhili ibizwa ngokuba yi-**받침 (batchim)**. Ivala isilabhili: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Zisixhenxe kuphela izandi ezinokubakho ekugqibeleni: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.
korean-k1-l7.example: 안 · 말 · 밤 · 강 · 집 (an · mal · bam · gang · jip)

korean-k1-l8.title: Amagama emihla ngemihla
korean-k1-l8.concept: Funda igama ngalinye isilabhili ngesilabhili. 학교 ifundwa ngokuthi “hakgyo”: i-ㄱ yokugqibela ye-학 ivaliwe kwaye isilabhili esilandelayo sibizwa ngokuqinileyo.

korean-k1-l9.title: Amagama malunga nehlabathi
korean-k1-l9.concept: Abantu nendalo: 사람 (umntu), 나라 (ilizwe), 하늘 (isibhakabhaka), 산 (intaba), 강 (umlambo), 꽃 (intyatyambo).

korean-k10-l1.title: Izihloko zeendaba nesimbo esifinyeziweyo
korean-k10-l1.concept: Izihloko zeendaba namabinzana amabizo afinyeziweyo: 물가 안정 대책 발표.
korean-k10-l1.example: 물가 안정 대책을 발표했습니다. (mulga anjeong daechaegeul balpyohaesseumnida.) = zibhengeziwe izinyathelo zamaxabiso

korean-k10-l2.title: Imicimbi yangoku neengcali zokuhlela
korean-k10-l2.concept: Ukufunda amanqaku amafutshane eendaba: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.
korean-k10-l2.example: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다. (chinhwan-gyeong eneojiga jumokbatgo isseumnida.) = amandla acocekileyo ayathandwa

korean-k10-l3.title: Amaqhalo ezitho zomzimba (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
korean-k10-l3.concept: Amaqhalo aqhelekileyo ngezitho zomzimba: 발이 넓다 (inethiwekhi ebanzi), 눈이 높다 (imigangatho ephezulu).
korean-k10-l3.example: 김 대리는 발이 넓어요. (gim daerineun bari neobeoyo.) = unoqhagamshelwano olubanzi / 눈이 높아요. (nuni nopayo.) = ukhetha ngemigangatho ephezulu

korean-k10-l4.title: Amaqhalo ezenzo zemihla ngemihla (바가지, 어깨)
korean-k10-l4.concept: Amabinzana ezimo eziqhelekileyo: 바가지를 쓰다 (ukuhlawuliswa ngaphezu kwexabiso), 어깨가 무겁다 (umsebenzi onzima).
korean-k10-l4.example: 바가지를 썼어요. (bagajireul sseosseoyo.) = ixabiso eliphezulu ngokungafanelekanga / 어깨가 무거워요. (eokkaega mugeowoyo.) = umthwalo onzima wemfanelo

korean-k10-l5.title: Izaci ezibalulekileyo zesiKorea
korean-k10-l5.concept: Ubulumko ezizaci: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.
korean-k10-l5.example: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다. (so ilko oeyanggan gochinda.) = ukulungisa ibhari emva kokulahlekelwa yinkomo / 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라. (soeppuldo dangime ppaera.) = betha ngelixa intsimbi ishushu

korean-k10-l6.title: Amaqhalo anabalinganiswa amane (사자성어)
korean-k10-l6.concept: Amaqhalo aqhelekileyo anabalinganiswa amane asuka kwisiTshayina: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.
korean-k10-l6.example: 일석이조예요. (ilseogijoyeyo.) = iintaka ezimbini ngetye elinye / 작심삼일이에요. (jaksimsamirieyo.) = isigqibo seentsuku ezintathu

korean-k10-l7.title: Izixhumi ezinengqiqo neempawu zentetho
korean-k10-l7.concept: Iimpawu zentetho esesikweni: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.
korean-k10-l7.example: 의견에 따르면 그렇습니다. (uigyone ttareumyeon geureotsseumnida.) = ngokwombono / 한편 다른 측면도 있습니다. (hanpyeon dareun cheungmyeondo isseumnida.) = kwelinye icala kukho nenye inxalenye

korean-k10-l8.title: Amaxabiso nemikhwa enzulu yenkcubeko yaseKorea
korean-k10-l8.concept: Iingcamango zenkcubeko namasiko eeholide: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.
korean-k10-l8.example: 따뜻한 정이 있어요. (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) = kukho jeong eshushu (uthando) / 송편을 빚어요. (songpyeoneul bijeoyo.) = ukwenza i-songpyeon ye-chuseok

korean-k10-l9.title: Uphononongo olupheleleyo lwe-K10
korean-k10-l9.concept: Ubuchule benkcubeko yaseKorea, iimidiya, amabinzana neentetho zedebate esemthethweni.
korean-k10-l9.example: 일석이조의 효과를 거두었어요. (ilseogijoui hyogwareul geoduosseoyo.) = kwafezekiswa isiphumo seentaka ezimbini ngelitye elinye / 상호 이해를 바탕으로 협력해요. (sangho ihaereul batangeuro hyeomnyeokaeyo.) = sisebenzisana ngokusekelwe kukuqondana

korean-k2-l1.title: Molo nenkosi
korean-k2-l1.concept: Imibuliso ehloniphekileyo iphela nge-**-요** okanye **-니다**. 안녕하세요 isebenza nangaliphi na ixesha losuku.

korean-k2-l10.title: Iimpawu oza kuzibona
korean-k2-l10.concept: Iimpawu ezifutshane zikho yonke indawo eKorea. **입구** yindawo yokungena, **출구** yindawo yokuphuma kwaye **화장실** ligumbi lokuhlambela. Kumnyango, **미세요** ithetha sunduza kwaye **당기세요** ithetha tsala.

korean-k2-l11.title: Enkosi ngesidlo
korean-k2-l11.concept: Phambi kokutya thetha **잘 먹겠습니다**, kwaye xa ugqibile uthi **잘 먹었습니다**. Umninindlu ukwamkela ngo-**어서 오세요**, kwaye **맛있어요** idumisa ukutya.
korean-k2-l11.example: 잘 먹겠습니다. (jal meokgetseumnida.) = Kuthethwa phambi kokutya: “Ndiza kutya kakuhle.” / 잘 먹었습니다. (jal meogeotseumnida.) = Kuthethwa emva kokutya: “Ndityile kakuhle.”

korean-k2-l2.title: Ewe, hayi nokulunga
korean-k2-l2.concept: Iimpendulo ezifutshane ezihloniphekileyo ongazisebenzisa yonke imihla. IsiKorean songeza **요** ekupheleni ukuze sibe nentlonipho.

korean-k2-l3.title: Ndiyavuya ukudibana nawe
korean-k2-l3.concept: Xa udibana nomntu omtsha, thetha 만나서 반갑습니다. Zimbini iindlela zokuthi sala kakuhle: enye yomntu ohambayo, enye yomntu osalayo.
korean-k2-l3.example: 만나서 반갑습니다. (mannaseo bangapseumnida.) = Ndiyavuya ukudibana nawe.

korean-k2-l4.title: Intetho ezihloniphekileyo
korean-k2-l4.concept: Sebenzisa 실례합니다 ukufumana ingqalelo yomntu okanye ukudlula, 고마워요 ukubulela ngobuhlobo, 천만에요 ukuphendula ombulelo, kunye ne-축하해요 ukuvuyisa.

korean-k2-l5.title: Amagama namazwe
korean-k2-l5.concept: Buza igama ngokuthi 이름이 뭐예요? nelizwe ngokuthi 어느 나라 사람이에요? Phendula ngokuthi 제 이름은 ___예요 okanye 저는 ___ 사람이에요.
korean-k2-l5.example: 이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) = Ngubani igama lakho?

korean-k2-l6.title: Ukuvalelisa
korean-k2-l6.concept: Phakathi kwabahlobo unokuthi 잘 가요 (usale kakuhle), 내일 봐요 (siza kubonana ngomso), 또 만나요 (siza kubonana kwakhona) kunye ne-잘 자요 (lala kakuhle).
korean-k2-l6.example: 잘 가요. (jal gayo.) = Sala kakuhle. (ngokobuhlobo) / 내일 봐요. (naeil bwayo.) = Siza kubonana ngomso.

korean-k2-l7.title: Unjani?
korean-k2-l7.concept: Buza 잘 지냈어요? (Ubukhona kakuhle?) uphendule 잘 지내요 (Ndikhona kakuhle). 좋은 아침이에요 kuthetha “Kusasa elihle.”

korean-k2-l8.title: Ukucela uncedo
korean-k2-l8.concept: Thetha 도와주세요 ukucela uncedo, 모르겠어요 xa ungazi, 알겠어요 xa uqonda, kunye ne-다시 말해 주세요 ukucela umntu ukuba aphinde athethe.

korean-k2-l9.title: Oko ukuthandayo neempendulo
korean-k2-l9.concept: 좋아요 kuthetha kulungile okanye kuhle, 싫어요 kuthetha awukuthandi, 맞아요 kuthetha “kunjalo” kwaye 틀려요 kuthetha “akunjalo”.

korean-k3-l1.title: Ndingumfundi
korean-k3-l1.concept: **저는** kuthetha “mna” (ngembeko). Beka **이에요** emva kwesikhamiso, kwaye **예요** emva kwevawuli ukuthi “Ndinguye …”.

korean-k3-l10.title: Ukuthumela umhlobo umyalezo
korean-k3-l10.concept: Imiyalezo yeteksti isebenzisa izivakalisi ezimfutshane ezinembeko ezigqiba nge-**-요**. **지금 어디예요?** ibuza ukuba ukuphi, **곧 가요** kuthetha “Ndiyeza kungekudala” kwaye **늦어요** kuthetha “Ndiyabuya emva kwexesha”.
korean-k3-l10.example: 지금 어디예요? (jigeum eodiyeyo?) = Ukuphi ngoku? / 곧 가요. (got gayo.) = Ndiyeza kungekudala.

korean-k3-l11.title: Ukufunda amagama ngokuvakalayo
korean-k3-l11.concept: Xa isilabhili siphela ngesikhamiso kwaye elandelayo iqala ngevawuli, isandi siyahamba: 책이 ifundwa **chaegi** kwaye 밥을 ifundwa **babeul**. Ezinye izandi ziguqula nabamelwane bazo: 국물 ifundwa **gungmul** kwaye 같이 ifundwa **gachi**.

korean-k3-l2.title: Usapho lwam
korean-k3-l2.concept: Amagama osapho asetyenziswa kakhulu esiKoreni, nakubantu abangengobosapho.

korean-k3-l3.title: Ukubala
korean-k3-l3.concept: IsiKorean sinezinkqubo zamanani ezimbini: ezomthonyama waseKorea (하나, 둘, 셋 …) zokubala izinto, nezaseSino-Korea (일, 이, 삼 …) zemali, imihla nemizuzu.

korean-k3-l4.title: Amanani omthonyama 6–10
korean-k3-l4.concept: Qhubeka namanani omthonyama waseKorea: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).
korean-k3-l4.example: 여섯 · 일곱 · 여덟 · 아홉 · 열 (yeoseot · ilgop · yeodeol · ahop · yeol)

korean-k3-l5.title: Amanani aseSino-Korea
korean-k3-l5.concept: Amanani aseSino-Korea: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Asetyenziswa kwimali, imihla, iinombolo zefowuni nemizuzu.
korean-k3-l5.example: 일 · 이 · 삼 · 사 · 오 · 육 · 칠 · 팔 · 구 · 십 (il · i · sam · sa · o · yuk · chil · pal · gu · sip)

korean-k3-l6.title: Ubudala
korean-k3-l6.concept: Buza 몇 살이에요? (Uneminyaka emingaphi?). Ubudala busebenzisa amanani omthonyama kunye ne-살: 열 살 (iminyaka eli-10), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).

korean-k3-l8.title: Amagama amaninzi osapho
korean-k3-l8.concept: Abantakwethu basebenzisa amagama ahlukeneyo ngokwekabani othethayo: umfazi uthi 오빠 (umntakwethu omdala) kunye ne-언니 (udadewethu omdala). Kukwakho 아들 (unyana), 딸 (intombi), 부모님 (abazali).
korean-k3-l8.example: 오빠 (oppa) = umntakwethu omdala (kuthethwa ngumfazi) / 언니 (eonni) = udadewethu omdala (kuthethwa ngumfazi)

korean-k3-l9.title: Usapho lwethu
korean-k3-l9.concept: AmaKorea adla ngokuthi 우리 (thina, ethu) endaweni ye-“yam”: 우리 가족 ithetha “usapho lwam”. Bala abantu nge-명: 네 명 (abantu abane).

korean-k4-l1.title: Izenzi zemihla ngemihla
korean-k4-l1.concept: Izenzi zexesha langoku ezihloniphekileyo ziphela nge-**-아요 / -어요 / -해요**. Ifom efanayo isetyenziswa kwi-“mna”, “wena” kunye ne-“bona”.

korean-k4-l2.title: Ukuya kwiindawo
korean-k4-l2.concept: Beka **에** emva kwendawo ukuthi uya okanye uza phi: 학교에 가요. Isenzi siza ekugqibeleni.

korean-k4-l3.title: Ukutya, ukusela, ukufunda
korean-k4-l3.concept: Into yesenzi ithatha **을** emva kwekhonsonanti kunye ne-**를** emva kwevowuli: 밥을 먹어요, 커피를 마셔요.

korean-k4-l4.title: Ukutya nokusela
korean-k4-l4.concept: 밥 (irayisi, isidlo), 빵 (isonka), 과일 (isiqhamo), 고기 (inyama), 물 (amanzi), 우유 (ubisi).

korean-k4-l5.title: Okuthandwayo nokungathandwayo
korean-k4-l5.concept: Thetha oko ukuthandayo nge--를/을 좋아해요 kwaye oko ungakuthandi nge--를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

korean-k4-l6.title: Ukuchaza izinto
korean-k4-l6.concept: Amagama achazayo nawo aphela nge--요: 커요 (inkulu), 작아요 (incinci), 많아요 (zininzi), 맛있어요 (kumnandi), 예뻐요 (intle).

korean-k4-l7.title: Imozulu
korean-k4-l7.concept: 날씨 (imozulu), 더워요 (kushushu), 추워요 (kubanda), 비가 와요 (kuyana imvula), 눈이 와요 (kuyana ikhephu).

korean-k4-l8.title: Ukuthi hayi nge-안 ne-못
korean-k4-l8.concept: Beka **안** phambi kwesenzi ukuthi awenzi into (안 가요). Beka **못** phambi kwaso ukuthi awukwazi (못 가요).

korean-k4-l9.title: Imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla
korean-k4-l9.concept: 일어나요 (vuka), 씻어요 (hlamba), 일해요 (sebenza), 자요 (lala). Amagama exesha anjengo 아침 (ekuseni) ne-밤 (ebusuku) athatha i-에: 아침에.

korean-k5-l1.title: Izolo, namhlanje, ngomso
korean-k5-l1.concept: Amagama exesha adla ngokuza kufutshane nokuqala kwesivakalisi.

korean-k5-l2.title: Endiyenzileyo
korean-k5-l2.concept: Ixesha elidlulileyo: **-았어요 / -었어요 / -했어요**. Ezinye izenzi ziyafinyezwa: 가다 → 갔어요, 보다 → 봤어요.

korean-k5-l3.title: Endiza kuyenza
korean-k5-l3.concept: Sebenzisa **-(으)ㄹ 거예요** kwizicwangciso: 가다 → 갈 거예요, 먹다 → 먹을 거예요.
korean-k5-l3.example: 내일 갈 거예요. (naeil gal geoyeyo.) = Ndiza kuya ngomso.

korean-k5-l4.title: Iintsuku zeveki
korean-k5-l4.concept: 월요일 (uMvulo), 화요일 (uLwesibini), 수요일 (uLwesithathu), 목요일 (uLwesine), 금요일 (uLwesihlanu), 토요일 (uMgqibelo), 일요일 (iCawa).

korean-k5-l5.title: Iinyanga
korean-k5-l5.concept: Iinyanga yinani laseSino-Korea kunye ne-월: 일월 (uJanuwari), 삼월 (uMatshi), 오월 (uMeyi), 칠월 (uJulayi), 구월 (uSeptemba), 십이월 (uDisemba).

korean-k5-l6.title: Ukuxela ixesha
korean-k5-l6.concept: Iiyure zisebenzisa amanani omthonyama kunye ne-시: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Buza 몇 시예요?
korean-k5-l6.example: 한 시 · 두 시 · 세 시 (han si · du si · se si)

korean-k5-l7.title: Kangaphi
korean-k5-l7.concept: 매일 (yonke imihla), 자주 (rhoqo), 가끔 (ngamanye amaxesha), 항상 (ngamaxesha onke). Zibeke phambi kwesenzo.
korean-k5-l7.example: 매일 (maeil) = yonke imihla / 가끔 (gakkeum) = ngamanye amaxesha

korean-k5-l8.title: Ixesha elidlulileyo ngakumbi
korean-k5-l8.concept: Isiphelo sexesha elidlulileyo yi--았/었어요: 했어요 (benzile), 왔어요 (weza), 만났어요 (badibana), 샀어요 (wathenga), 잤어요 (walala).

korean-k5-l9.title: Imihla yokuzalwa neempelaveki
korean-k5-l9.concept: 생일 (usuku lokuzalwa), 주말 (impelaveki), 선물 (isipho). Buza 생일이 언제예요? uphendule 제 생일은 오월이에요.
korean-k5-l9.example: 생일이 언제예요? (saengiri eonjeyeyo?) = Usuku lwakho lokuzalwa nini?

korean-k6-l1.title: evenkileni
korean-k6-l1.concept: Buza ixabiso ngokuthi 얼마예요? kwaye ucele into ngokuthi **… 주세요** (… nceda).

korean-k6-l2.title: Ikuphi?
korean-k6-l2.concept: Buza **… 어디예요?** (Ikuphi …?). Mamela 오른쪽 (ekunene), 왼쪽 (ekhohlo) kunye ne-직진 (ngqo phambili).

korean-k6-l3.title: Ndifuna ukuya …
korean-k6-l3.concept: Yongeza **-고 싶어요** kwingcambu yesenzo ukuthi into ofuna ukuyenza: 가다 → 가고 싶어요.

korean-k6-l4.title: Kwindawo yokutyela
korean-k6-l4.concept: 메뉴 (imenyu), 주문할게요 (ndiza kuodola), 물 더 주세요 (amanzi ngakumbi, nceda), 계산해 주세요 (ibhili, nceda).

korean-k6-l5.title: Ukuhamba-hamba
korean-k6-l5.concept: 버스 (ibhasi), 지하철 (isubway), 택시 (iteksi), 기차 (uloliwe). Thetha ukuba uhamba njani nge--로/으로: 버스로 가요.

korean-k6-l6.title: Iifowuni nemiyalezo
korean-k6-l6.concept: 전화 (umnxeba), 전화번호 (inombolo yomnxeba), 문자 (umyalezo weteksti). 전화해요 kuthetha “Ndiyafowuna”.

korean-k6-l7.title: Esibhedlele
korean-k6-l7.concept: 병원 (isibhedlele), 약 (amayeza), 아파요 (iyabuhlungu). Thetha inxalenye yomzimba kuqala: 머리가 아파요 (intloko yam iyabuhlungu).

korean-k6-l8.title: Izicelo ezihloniphekileyo
korean-k6-l8.concept: -세요 kunye ne--아/어 주세요 zenza izicelo ezihloniphekileyo: 앉으세요 (nceda uhlale phantsi), 기다려 주세요 (nceda ulinde), 문을 열어 주세요 (nceda uvule ucango).

korean-k6-l9.title: Ukwenza izicwangciso kunye
korean-k6-l9.concept: 같이 (kunye) imema umntu: 같이 가요. 갈래요? ibuza “Ufuna ukuya?” kwaye 시간 있어요? ibuza “Unaxesha?”

korean-k7-l1.title: Izigqibo ezihloniphekileyo ezisemthethweni
korean-k7-l1.concept: Kwintetho esemthethweni nasemsebenzini, incanyathisele i--ㅂ니다 kwingcambu yesenzi okanye yesichazi eliphela nge-vowuli kunye ne--습니다 kwingcambu ephela ngekhonsonanti. Imibuzo iphela nge--ㅂ니까 / -습니까.
korean-k7-l1.example: 저는 학생입니다. (jeoneun haksaengimnida.) = Ndingumfundi. / 이름이 무엇입니까? (ireumi mueosimnikka?) = Ngubani igama lakho?

korean-k7-l10.title: Umlinganiselo nokungenakuphepheka (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
korean-k7-l10.example: 만날수록 좋아요. (mannalsurok joayo.) = kungcono njengoko sidibana / 사람은 실수하기 마련이에요. (sarameun silsuhagi maryeonieyo.) = kufanele wenze iimpazamo

korean-k7-l11.title: Ukubonakala nokuqikelela (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
korean-k7-l11.concept: Ubonakala (-아/어 보이다) kunye nokubonakala ukuba (-는 모양이다).
korean-k7-l11.example: 행복해 보여요. (haengbokae boyeoyo.) = ubonakala onwabile / 비가 오는 모양이에요. (biga oneun moyangieyo.) = kubonakala kuna imvula

korean-k7-l12.title: Ukuzenza (-는 척하다)
korean-k7-l12.concept: Zenza ukwenza okanye ukuba yinto: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.

korean-k7-l13.title: Ukuzisola nezinto ezichasene nenyaniso (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
korean-k7-l13.example: 일찍 올 걸 그랬어요. (iljjik ol geol geuraesseoyo.) = ndandifanele ndize kwangoko

korean-k7-l14.title: Uphononongo olupheleleyo lwe-K7
korean-k7-l14.concept: Phonononga intetho ebikwayo, izidibanisi ezintsonkothileyo namabinzana anobunono.
korean-k7-l14.example: 친구가 온다고 했어요. (chinguga ondago haesseoyo.) = umhlobo uthe uyeza / 같이 밥 먹자고 했어요. (gachi bap meokjago haesseoyo.) = ucebise ukuba sityele kunye

korean-k7-l2.title: Iifom ezilula
korean-k7-l2.concept: Isimbo esilula (esibhaliweyo) siphelisa izivakalisi nge--ㄴ다 / -는다 nezivakalisi zexesha elidlulileyo nge--았다 / -었다. Ezi fom sisiseko sentetho ebikwayo kwizifundo ezilandelayo.
korean-k7-l2.example: 나는 학교에 간다. (naneun hakgyoe ganda.) = Ndiya esikolweni. / 동생은 책을 읽는다. (dongsaengeun chaegeul ingneunda.) = Umntakwethu omncinci ufunda incwadi.

korean-k7-l3.title: Ukuchaza izibizo
korean-k7-l3.concept: Isenzi okanye isichazi sinokuchaza isibizo: -(으)ㄴ kwizichazi nakwizenzo zexesha elidlulileyo, -는 kwizenzo zangoku, -(으)ㄹ kwizenzo zexesha elizayo okanye ezicwangcisiweyo, zibekwe phambi kwesibizo.
korean-k7-l3.example: 저는 맛있는 음식을 좋아해요. (jeoneun masinneun eumsigeul joahaeyo.) = Ndiyakuthanda ukutya okumnandi. / 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요. (yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.) = Ndathenga iintyatyambo ezintle.

korean-k7-l4.title: Izidibanisi eziyisiseko
korean-k7-l4.concept: Dibanisa iziqendu ezimbini nge--아/어서 (isizathu okanye ulandelelwano), -지만 (umahluko), -(으)니까 (isizathu), -(으)면 (ukuba) kunye ne--(으)려고 (ukuze).
korean-k7-l4.example: 피곤해서 일찍 잤어요. (pigonhaeseo iljjik jasseoyo.) = Ndandidiniwe, ngoko ndalala kwangoko. / 비가 와서 집에 있었어요. (biga waseo jibe isseosseoyo.) = Kwana imvula, ngoko ndahlala ekhaya.

korean-k7-l5.title: Isakhono, uxanduva, imvume
korean-k7-l5.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 ibonisa isakhono okanye ukuba nako, -아/어야 하다 uxanduva, kwaye -아/어도 되다 imvume.
korean-k7-l5.example: 저는 수영할 수 있어요. (jeoneun suyeonghal su isseoyo.) = Ndiyakwazi ukudada. / 저는 한국어로 이야기할 수 있어요. (jeoneun hangugeoro iyagihal su isseoyo.) = Ndiyakwazi ukuthetha ngesiKorean.

korean-k7-l6.title: Izivakalisi ezibikwayo (-다고 하다)
korean-k7-l6.concept: Bika oko umntu akuthethayo okanye akuthethileyo: isenzi/isichazi + -다고 하다.
korean-k7-l6.example: 친구가 온다고 해요. (chinguga ondago haeyo.) = umhlobo uthe uyeza

korean-k7-l7.title: Imibuzo ebikwayo (-냐고 하다)
korean-k7-l7.example: 어디 가냐고 물었어요. (eodi ganyago mureosseoyo.) = ubuze ukuba uya phi

korean-k7-l8.title: Imiyalelo neziphakamiso ezibikwayo (-라고 / -자고 하다)
korean-k7-l8.concept: Bika umyalelo (-라고 하다) okanye isiphakamiso (-자고 하다).
korean-k7-l8.example: 빨리 오라고 했어요. (ppalli orago haesseoyo.) = uthe eze ngokukhawuleza / 같이 가자고 했어요. (gachi gajago haesseoyo.) = ucebise ukuba siye kunye

korean-k7-l9.title: Izizathu ezintsonkothileyo neziphikisi (-느라고, -는데도)
korean-k7-l9.concept: Unobangela ongalunganga okanye ukulibaziseka (-느라고) kunye nokuphikisana nangona kunjalo (-는데도).
korean-k7-l9.example: 공부하느라고 바빴어요. (gongbuhaneurago bapasseoyo.) = bendixakeke ndifunda / 비가 오는데도 갔어요. (biga oneundedo gasseoyo.) = ndiye nangona kwana imvula

korean-k8-l1.title: Isigama sembeko sezifundo
korean-k8-l1.concept: Amabizo nezenzi zembeko ezikhethekileyo zabantu abahlonitshwayo: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.
korean-k8-l1.example: 할머니께서 진지를 드세요. (halmeonikkeseo jinjireul deuseyo.) = umakhulu uyadla isidlo

korean-k8-l2.title: Izenzi zembeko zento (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
korean-k8-l2.concept: Izenzi zokuthobeka/zembeko xa isenzo siya komdala: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.
korean-k8-l2.example: 선물을 드려요. (seonmureul deuryeoyo.) = nika isipho ngembeko / 내일 봬요. (naeil bwaeyo.) = siza kubonana ngomso ngembeko

korean-k8-l3.title: Izenzi zokwenziwa ngezimamva (-이/히/리/기-)
korean-k8-l3.concept: Izenzi zokwenziwa ezenziwe ngokongeza -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.
korean-k8-l3.example: 문이 열려요. (muni yeollyeoyo.) = ucango luyavuleka / 창문이 닫혀요. (changmuni dachyeoyo.) = ifestile iyavaleka

korean-k8-l4.title: Izenzi zokwenziwa zesintaksi (-어지다, -게 되다)
korean-k8-l4.concept: Izenzi ezithatha iifom zokwenziwa ezizenzekelayo okanye eziphumayo: -아/어지다, -게 되다.
korean-k8-l4.example: 글씨가 써져요. (geulssiga sseojyeoyo.) = unobumba ubhalwe kakuhle / 알게 되었어요. (alge doeeosseoyo.) = ndafikelela ekwazini

korean-k8-l5.title: Izenzi zokwenzisa ngezimamva (-이/히/리/기/우-)
korean-k8-l5.concept: Izenzi zokwenzisa ezenza umntu enze isenzo: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.
korean-k8-l5.example: 사진을 보여 줘요. (sajineul boyeo jwoyo.) = ubonisa ifoto / 아기에게 밥을 먹여요. (agiege babeul meogyeoyo.) = ulisa usana

korean-k8-l6.title: Izenzi zokwenzisa zesintaksi (-게 하다)
korean-k8-l6.concept: Ukwenza okanye ukubangela umntu enze into: -게 하다.
korean-k8-l6.example: 웃게 해요. (utge haeyo.) = uyahlekisa / 기다리게 했어요. (gidarige haesseoyo.) = ndenze alinde

korean-k8-l7.title: Isimbo esisesikweni sesidlangalala (-하십시오)
korean-k8-l7.example: 자리에 앉으십시오. (jarie anjeusipsio.) = nceda uhlale / 출발하십시다. (chulbalhasipsida.) = masihambe

korean-k8-l8.title: Amabinzana okuthobeka nokuzithoba
korean-k8-l8.concept: Intetho enembeko isebenzisa izimeli nezenzi zokuthobeka: 저희, 말씀 올리다.
korean-k8-l8.example: 인사 말씀 올립니다. (insa malsseum ollimnida.) = ndinikela amazwi okubulisa / 저희 학교입니다. (jeohui hakgyoimnida.) = sisikolo sethu (ngokuthobeka)

korean-k8-l9.title: Uphononongo olupheleleyo lwe-K8
korean-k8-l9.concept: Phonononga ukuhlonipha, isenzeka-kwisenzo, isenzisa nemo yokuthobeka esemthethweni.
korean-k8-l9.example: 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요. (halmeonikke seonmureul deuryeosseoyo.) = ndanika umakhulu isipho / 문이 저절로 닫혔어요. (muni jeojeollo dachyeosseoyo.) = ucango luvaleke ngokwalo

korean-k9-l1.title: Ukubhala i-imeyile yeshishini nezicelo
korean-k9-l1.concept: Imigaqo ye-imeyile yeshishini esemthethweni: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l1.example: 회의 안건에 관하여 말씀드립니다. (hoeui angeone gwanhayeo malsseumdeurimnida.) = ngokuphathelele i-ajenda yentlanganiso

korean-k9-l2.title: Indlela efanelekileyo yokuthetha ngefowuni kwishishini
korean-k9-l2.concept: Ukuphatha iimfowuni nemiyalezo: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.
korean-k9-l2.example: 지금 통화 가능하신지요? (jigeum tonghwa ganeunghasinjiyo?) = uyafumaneka ukuthetha ngoku / 담당자를 연결해 드리겠습니다. (damdangjareul yeongyeolhae deurigetseumnida.) = ukudibanisa umntu onoxanduva

korean-k9-l3.title: Ukucwangcisa nokucwangcisa kwakhona
korean-k9-l3.concept: Ukucebisa nokutshintsha amaxesha entlanganiso: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l3.example: 일정을 변경하고자 합니다. (iljeongeul byeongyeonghagoja hamnida.) = isicelo sokutshintsha ishedyuli / 너른 양해 부탁드립니다. (neoreun yanghae butakdeurimnida.) = ukucela ukuqonda ngenceba

korean-k9-l4.title: Iingxoxo neembono ezintlanganisweni
korean-k9-l4.concept: Ukuchaza iimbono kwiintlanganiso: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.
korean-k9-l4.example: 제 생각으로는 이번 안이 좋습니다. (je saenggakeoroneun ibeon ani jotseumnida.) = ngokwembono yam isiphakamiso silungile / 적극 찬성합니다. (jeokgeuk chanseonghamnida.) = ndivuma ngamandla

korean-k9-l5.title: Ukunika ingxelo yenkqubela yeprojekthi
korean-k9-l5.concept: Ukunika izihlaziyo zeemeko: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.
korean-k9-l5.example: 프로젝트 진행 상황을 보고합니다. (peurojekteu jinhaeng sanghwangeul bogohamnida.) = ukunika ingxelo yenkqubela yeprojekthi / 조치를 완료했습니다. (jochireul wallyohaesseumnida.) = isenzo sigqityiwe

korean-k9-l6.title: Amanani eenkcukacha kunye nemigaqo yedatha
korean-k9-l6.concept: Ukuchaza imigaqo namanani: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.
korean-k9-l6.example: 매출이 증가했습니다. (maechuri jeunggahaesseumnida.) = intengiso iyandile / 전년 대비 상승했습니다. (jeonnyeon daebi sangseunghaesseumnida.) = inyukile xa kuthelekiswa nonyaka odlulileyo

korean-k9-l7.title: Utshintshiselwano lweshishini kunye nobambiswano
korean-k9-l7.concept: Intsebenziswano yobuchule: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.
korean-k9-l7.example: 상호 협력을 희망합니다. (sangho hyeomnyeogeul huimanghamnida.) = siyathemba intsebenziswano yomntu ngomnye / 절충안을 제안합니다. (jeolchuganeul jeanhamnida.) = ndicebisa isivumelwano esiphakathi

korean-k9-l8.title: Amakhadi eshishini namagama osebenzi
korean-k9-l8.concept: Ukutshintshiselana ngamakhadi namagama osebenzi: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.
korean-k9-l8.example: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다. (cheoeum boepgetseumnida, myeongham deurimnida.) = ndiyavuya ukudibana, ikhadi lam / 김 부장님입니다. (gim bujangnimimnida.) = ngumphathi wesebe uKim

korean-k9-l9.title: Uphononongo olupheleleyo lwe-K9
korean-k9-l9.concept: Phonononga unxibelelwano lwezobugcisa, iileta ezisemthethweni neentlanganiso.
korean-k9-l9.example: 안건을 검토해 주시기 바랍니다. (angeoneul geomtohae jusigi baramnida.) = nceda uphonononge umba / 회의에서 뵙겠습니다. (hoeuieseo boepgetseumnida.) = siza kubonana kwintlanganiso

k-k10-culture_deep-1.explanation: “따뜻한 정이 있어요.” (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) kuthetha “uthando lwe-jeong olufudumeleyo”.

k-k10-culture_deep-3.explanation: “음식을 나눠 먹어요.” (eumsigeul nanwo meogeoyo.) kuthetha “ukwabelana ngokutya nabamelwane”.

k-k10-culture_deep-4.explanation: “따뜻한 정이 있어요.” (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) kuthetha “uthando lwe-jeong olufudumeleyo”.

k-k10-culture_deep-v1.explanation: “음식을 나눠 먹어요.” (eumsigeul nanwo meogeoyo.) kuthetha “ukwabelana ngokutya nabamelwane”.

texts.s:0cb03813: Umntu ubuza ukuba uyaluthanda kangakanani ukutya kwaseKorea kwaye uyalithanda kakhulu.
texts.s:534cd1d2: Umhlobo ukuxelela iindaba ezothusayo uze ubonise indlela ovakalelwa ngayo.
texts.s:f7b4f339: Umhlobo uthi uyayithanda ikofu kwaye nawe uyayithanda.
texts.s:33c59864: Umkhonzi ubuza ukuba ufuna ukuoda ngoku kwaye ufuna ukulinda.
texts.s:3bdcca90: Umntu ukubuza into uze ungazi impendulo echanekileyo.
texts.s:ef011d41: Umthengisi wevenkile ukunika ingxowa kodwa uyayidinga.
texts.s:b90c6c0b: Umhlobo ukumema ngaphandle kodwa uxakekile namhlanje.
texts.s:c9f4427b: Umntu ubuza ukuba uyatshaya okanye wenze into ongayenziyo.
texts.g:09cff54d: A: Unayo ikofu? B: Ewe, siyinayo.
texts.n:k.k2.culture:tableMan: Izimilo zetafile zaseKorea: abadala baqala, abantu babelana ngezitya ezincedisayo, kwaye izipho okanye iziselo zinikezelwa ngezandla zombini.
texts.s:0eb1f066: Isimenywa sasekhaya sineentloni zokutya, ngoko umhlohla utye kakhulu.
texts.s:850538a5: Umhlobo udibana nawe ngexesha lesidlo sasemini uze abuze ukuba unjani.
texts.s:74ee7d1d: Wena nabahlobo bakho niphakamisa iiglasi kwisidlo sangokuhlwa.
texts.s:bf06140e: Uhlala kwindawo yokutyela uze ubuze abasebenzi.
texts.s:8fd9d2d2: Ucela abasebenzi ukuba bagcwalise iimbiza ezincinci.
texts.n:k.k2.greetings:greetTime: IsiKorea sinezibulo ezimiselweyo ngamaxesha athile anjengexesha lokulala, ukuphuma ekhaya nokubuyela ekhaya.
texts.n:k.k2.greetings:honPart: Iifom zembeko zithatha indawo yezinxalenye eziqhelekileyo xa umntu ofumana isenzo engumntu omhloniphayo.
texts.s:bed71323: Uthi ulale kakuhle kumakhulu wakho ngaphambi kokuba alale.
texts.s:7825a729: Lixesha lokuqala konyaka omtsha kwaye ubulisa ummelwane.
texts.g:0e6ea78d: Ndiyemka; ndiza kubuya. (kuthethwa xa uphuma ekhaya)
texts.s:0e6ea78d: Uphuma ekhaya uye esikolweni kwaye uyithi kusapho lwakho.
texts.s:378cc5ed: Iqabane lakho okanye umzali uphuma ekhaya uye emsebenzini kwaye uphendula usemnyango.
texts.s:203ef35b: Ubuyela ekhaya kwaye ubiza usapho lwakho.
texts.s:c0a9cb3e: Ubulisa umfundi omtsha ofika kwisikolo solwimi.
texts.s:2ea8f887: IChuseok iyeza kwaye uvalelisa umsebenzi mnye.
texts.s:e7166498: Umhlobo osondeleyo ufika ngasemnyango kwaye umnxusa ukuba angene.
texts.g:1fb4754f: Ndidibana nomhlobo wam emva kwexesha elide.
texts.g:539a5df5: A: Ndiyemka. B: Ewe, zikhathalele kwaye ubuye kungekudala.
texts.n:k.k2.helpme:juseyo: Ipatheni yesenzi + a/eo juseyo itshintsha isenzi sibe sisicelo esinembeko sokwenza into ngenxa yam.
texts.n:k.k2.helpme:whereQ: Ibizo kunye ne-i okanye ga kunye negama lombuzo elithi 'phi' libuza indawo yento.
texts.s:7b1a3eac: Utitshala uchaza into kwaye awukwazi ukulandela.
texts.s:8e153b9e: Uzama ukuyalela ngesiKorea evenkileni kodwa ungumqali kuphela, ngoko uxwayisa umabhalana.
texts.s:b4be7732: Ubuza umntu ongamaziyo ukuba ningaxoxa ngesiNgesi na.
texts.s:644694ca: Ucela umhlobo ukuba eze nawe esibhedlele.
texts.s:fc469d2b: Ulahlekelwe yifowuni yakho kwaye ufuna ukufowuna.
texts.g:e53d76e9: A: Uxolo. Andiqondi. B: Kulungile, ndiza kuphinda ndithethe kancinane.
texts.n:k.k2.introduce:fromPart: Isinxalenye esibonisa indawo yokuqala sisiza emva kwegama lelizwe phambi kwesenzi sokuza.
texts.n:k.k2.introduce:isCop: Emva kwebizo, ikhopyula yi-ieyo emva kwekonsonanti kwaye yi-yeyo emva kwesikhamiso.
texts.g:ea60746e: A: NdinguHana. Uphuma kwelaphi ilizwe? B: Ndivela eMelika.
texts.n:k.k2.manners:askPol: Izimemo neziceliso ezinembeko zisebenzisa isiphelo sembeko -(eu)seyo ukuceba okanye ukumema umntu ngembeko.
texts.n:k.k2.manners:speechLevel: Intetho enembeko isetyenziswa nabadala nabantu esingabaziyo; intetho engeyiyo esesikweni yabahlobo abasondeleyo okanye abantu abancinci kuphela.
texts.s:ade9a799: Wena nomntu omdala nifika ecaleni kocango ngexesha elinye.
texts.s:da046f3c: Iindwendwe zifika kwitheko lakho kwaye uzamkela ngembeko.
texts.s:d98abce9: Ufika emva kwexesha kwintlanganiso notitshala wakho.
texts.n:k.k2.meeting:firstMeet: Amabinzana amiselweyo okudibana kokuqala adla ngokusetyenziswa xa udibana nomntu okokuqala okanye uqala ubudlelwane obutsha.
texts.s:27066666: Udibana nabazali bomhlobo wakho okokuqala nje.
texts.s:7aec92e9: Umntu uthi uvuya ukudibana nawe kwaye uyaphendula.
texts.s:3689da92: Ubuza ngembeko igama lomntu ongamaziyo omdala.
texts.s:2b7e26d4: Useteheni kwaye ufuna ukuxelela abantu ukuba ungubani.
texts.g:766b61e8: A: Unjani? NdinguKim Minsu. B: Kuyavuyisa ukudibana nawe nam. NdinguLee Sujin.
texts.n:k.k2.opinions:adjOpin: Izichazi zesiKorea kwifom enembeko ye-yo zinika uluvo ngokuthe ngqo ngaphandle kwesenzi esongezelelweyo.
texts.n:k.k2.opinions:likeObj: Isenzi sokuthanda into sithatha into ephawulwe nge-eul okanye i-reul.
texts.s:1dbce16d: Umhlobo ubuza ngendawo yokutyela ongayithandanga kakhulu.
texts.g:babab3fe: A: Injani le kofu? B: Imnandi. Kodwa ibiza kancinci. A: Nam ndicinga njalo.
texts.n:k.k2.partings:partWho: Ukuvalelisa kuxhomekeke kwindlela abantu abahamba ngayo; uninzi lubhalwe njengemibulelo ethobekileyo enesiphelo sokuhlonipha.
texts.n:k.k2.partings:seeYou: Ukuthi sobonana ngexesha elithile, beka igama lexesha phambi kwesenzi sokubona ngefomu ethobekileyo.
texts.s:6b5a3d50: Ugqiba isidlo sasemini nomhlobo kwaye akukabikho cwangciso luqinisekileyo.
texts.s:5aee0ad9: Uza kudibana nomhlobo kwakhona emva kweeyure ezimbalwa.
texts.s:d8139ac4: Unika umhlobo omtsha inombolo yakho uze ufune ukuva kuye.
texts.s:c8047a18: Uphuma endlini yomhlobo kwaye umhlobo uyasala.
texts.s:b3874198: NgoLwesihlanu kwaye wena nomfundi ofunda naye nidibana kwakhona esikolweni.
texts.s:774dadf1: Uza kudibana nomfundi ofunda naye kwakhona kwiveki ezayo.
texts.g:e0de69e2: A: Ndiza kuhamba kuqala. B: Kulungile, zikhathaze. Siza kubonana kwiveki ezayo.
texts.n:k.k2.signs:signPush: Iimpawu zihlala zisebenzisa amabinzana amafutshane ezibizo okanye imiyalelo ethobekileyo ukukuxelela ukuba wenze ntoni okanye ukuba kuvumelekile ntoni.
texts.n:k.k2.signs:signState: Iivenkile neendawo zezinto ziboniswa ngemeko yazo ngamabinzana amafutshane ezibizo.
texts.s:d9d9564c: Ubona oku kucango kwaye kufuneka usivule.
texts.g:91375c95: A: Uxolo, likuphi igumbi lokuhlambela? B: Yiya ngasekhohlo.
texts.n:k.k2.wellbeing:askHow: Le mibuzo ibuza ngemeko jikelele yomntu okanye imvakalelo yangoku.
texts.s:77b91ba6: Umntu ubuza ukuba unjani kwaye awulunganga kwaye awubi kakubi.
texts.s:f0ac5a84: Umhlobo onobubele ubuza ngawe kwaye umbulela.
texts.g:a72ab5e1: A: Unjani kutshanje? B: Ndixakekile kakhulu ezi ntsuku. Kodwa ndiphilile.
texts.n:k.k3.ages:ageN: Ubudala bubalwa ngamanani omthonyama alandelwa sisibali seminyaka; amashumi amabini athatha ifomu emfutshane ekhethekileyo phambi kwalo.
texts.n:k.k3.ages:ageQ: Ukubuza ubudala bomntu, igama lombuzo elithi 'bangaphi' lidityaniswa nesibali seminyaka.
texts.n:k.k3.ages:tens: Amashumi omthonyama (amashumi amathathu, amane, amahlanu, njalo njalo) ligama ngalinye kwaye adibana ngqo nedijithi yamanani amanye.
texts.g:da49d3ce: Umntakwethu omncinci uneminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala.
texts.g:1e97ab30: Umakhulu wam uneminyaka engamashumi asibhozo ubudala.
texts.g:726993ea: Utata wam uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu anesihlanu ubudala.
texts.g:f7f04e4c: Mama wam uneminyaka engamashumi amane anesibhozo ubudala.
texts.g:b6d6fbf1: Umhlobo wam uneminyaka engamashumi amabini anesithandathu ubudala.
texts.n:k.k3.family:topicP: Isihlomelo sesihloko sinamafom amabini: elinye lisetyenziswa emva kwebizo eliphela ngekonsonanti, elinye emva kwebizo eliphela ngesikhamiso.
texts.n:k.k3.family:objP: Isihlomelo sesicaka sinamafom amabini ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ibizo liphela ngesikhamiso okanye ikonsonanti.
texts.n:k.k3.family:possP: Isihlomelo sobunini sidibanisa amabizo amabini, njengo-'s kwisiNgesi.
texts.n:k.k3.family:countP: Ukubala abantu, inani lomthonyama libekwa phambi kwesibali sabantu.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:who: Abantakwabo bathathu amagama ahlukeneyo ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni umntu othethayo ngowesilisa okanye ngowasetyhini, nasekubeni umntakwabo mdala okanye mncinci.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:side: Iinkosikazi zabazali nabantakwabo bazali banamagama ahlukeneyo ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni basecaleni likatata okanye likamama.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:topicP: Isinxalenye sesihloko sinefomi ezimbini: esinye sisetyenziswa emva kwebizo eliphela ngekonsonanti, esinye emva kwebizo eliphela ngesikhamiso.
texts.n:k.k3.family2:countP: Ukubala abantu, inani lesiKorea langaphandle lisiza phambi kwesibali sabantu, kwaye elithi 'nye' liyafinyezwa phambi kwaso.
texts.g:8ec16e71: Ndinooodade bethu abakhulu ababini (othethayo ngumntu oyindoda).
texts.n:k.k3.messages:ask: Amagama emibuzo anje ngo-'ntoni', 'phi' no-'ngaliphi ixesha' athatha indawo yenxalenye engaziwayo kwaye ulandelelwano lwamagama aluguquki.
texts.n:k.k3.messages:loc: Igama lendawo elilandelwa sisinxalenye sendawo lithi umntu uphi okanye uyaphi.
texts.n:k.k3.messages:past: Isiphelo sexesha elidlulileyo sibonisa ukuba into isele yenzekile.
texts.s:dce14ee9: Lusuku lokuzalwa lomhlobo wakho kwaye uthumela isibulelo.
texts.s:a63306d1: Umhlobo ucebisa ukuba nidle isidlo sangokuhlwa kunye wena uvuma ngovuyo.
texts.g:4627efdf: Ibhasi ihlile, ngoko mhlawumbi ndiza kuhlwa kancinane.
texts.s:c6258f25: Ukugqiba incoko nomhlobo ngokuthi uza kuqhagamshelana naye kwakhona ngomso.
texts.g:02c0f829:
A: Ukuphi ngoku?
B: Ndiphambi kwesitishi sikaloliwe osemhlabeni.
A: Ndingaphakathi kwekhafe.
B: Ndiyaqonda. Ndiza kuba lapho ngeemizuzu emihlanu.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:nat6: Amanani omthonyama asithandathu ukuya kwishumi agcina ubume obufanayo phambi kwesibali, ngokungafaniyo nelinye ukuya kwane.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:hour: Iiyure zibalwa ngamanani omthonyama, kodwa imizuzu ibalwa ngamanani esiSino-Korea.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:ordN: Isimamva esongezwa kwinani lomthonyama siliguqula libe ngenani lolandelelwano, njengo-'th' kwisiNgesi.
texts.n:k.k3.native10:ctr: Igama ngalinye lesibali (abantu, iinkomityi, izilwanyana, iibhotile, iincwadi, iziqwenga) lilandela inani.
texts.g:cf53c27b: isithandathu, isixhenxe, isibhozo (ukubala ngamanani omthonyama esiKorea)
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:nat: Amanani omthonyama esiKorea abala izinto nabantu; elinye, mbini, ntathu nane atshintsha ubume phambi kwesibali.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:sinoN: Amanani esiSino-Korea asetyenziselwa imigangatho, iinyanga, amanani eendlela kunye nezibalo.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:ctr: Igama ngalinye lesibali (iikomityi, iincwadi, izilwanyana, iibhotile, abantu) libekwa emva kwenani nebizo.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:mathN: Kwizibalo, kusetyenziswa amanani esiSino-Korea kwaye impendulo ilandelwa sisidibanisi.
texts.g:30314885: ukusuka kwelinye ukuya kwisihlanu (ukubala ngamanani omthonyama esiKorea)
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:ourK: AmaKorea ahlala esithi 'yethu' apho isiNgesi sisithi 'yam', ngakumbi kumalungu osapho, ikhaya nesikolo.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:famN: Ukunika inani lamalungu osapho, inani lomthonyama lisiya phambi kwesibali sabantu.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:birth: Amagama olandelelwano lokuzalwa abonisa ukuba umntu ukwindawo ethile phakathi kwabantwana bosapho.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:ask: Igama lombuzo elithetha 'bangaphi' liza phambi kwesibalo sabantu.
texts.n:k.k3.people:dem: Igama lokukhomba elibekwe phambi kwesibizo likhomba umntu okanye into ekude kubo bobabini abathethayo.
texts.n:k.k3.people:cnt: Ukubala abantu, inani lomthonyama liza phambi kwesibalo sabantu.
texts.n:k.k3.people:occ: Izihloko zemisebenzi ziizibizo, ngoko zithatha i-copula ukuthetha ukuba umntu wenza ntoni.
texts.n:k.k3.self:copula: Ukuthi 'Ndingu...', isibizo silandelwa yi-copula ekwimo yayo exhomekeke ekubeni isibizo siphela nge-vowuli okanye ikhonsonanti.
texts.n:k.k3.self:negCop: Ukuthi 'asingu', isibizo sithatha isiphawuli sesihloko size silandelwe yi-copula ekhethekileyo engavumiyo.
texts.n:k.k3.self:alsoP: Isiphawuli esithetha 'nga' sithatha indawo yesiphawuli sesihloko.
texts.n:k.k3.self:natQ: Amagama ombuzo anjengo 'yintoni', 'ngubani' no 'leliphi' athatha indawo yenxalenye engaziwayo yesivakalisi; ulandelelwano lwamagama aluguquki.
texts.s:c790431f: Usandula ukwazisiwa komnye umntu okokuqala kwaye ufuna ukuthi uyavuya ukudibana naye.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:money: Amaxabiso athiwa ngenani lesiSino-Korea elilandelwa liguama lemali; iwaka elilishumi linyuko lalo ngaphezulu kwamawaka.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:irrMonth: Amagama amabini enyanga atshintsha upelo: kuzo zombini, inani lilahla ikonsonanti yalo yokugqibela phambi kwegama lenyanga.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:mathS: Izibalo neenombolo zeefowuni zifundwa ngamanani esiSino-Korea, kwaye impendulo ilandelwa sisidibanisi.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:dateS: Imihla ithiwa inyanga, emva koko usuku, kusetyenziswa amanani esiSino-Korea anamaqela enyanga nosuku.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:bigN: Amanani amakhulu esiSino-Korea akhiwa ngamashumi, amakhulu namawaka afundwa ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene.
texts.g:ace273d9: Inombolo yefowuni yam yi-zero-one-zero, two-three-four-five, six-seven-eight-nine.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:linkC: Ikonsonanti yokugqibela iya kwisilabhili esilandelayo xa isilabhili eso siqala ngonobumba wekonsonanti ongathethi, ngoko isandi sivakala sidityanisiwe.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:doubleC: Kwamakonsonanti amabini okugqibela, enye kuphela ethethwayo phambi kwekonsonanti, kodwa phambi kwesikhamiso eyesibini iyadibana nesilabhili esilandelayo.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:hDrop: Isandi i-h sithe cwaka emva kwesikhamiso okanye n, m, l, ng; izandi ezingabamelwane ke zidibana kamnandi.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:nasal: Isandi p, t okanye k sibe ngu-m, n okanye ng xa ilandelwa yikonsonanti yempumlo.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:rToN: Isandi l emva kwesiphelo okanye ng sithethwa njengo-n, kwaye isiphelo phambi kwaso sinokuba yimpumlo.
texts.n:k.k4.adjectives:adjSubj: Izichazi zichaza isifundo esiphawulwe nge-이/가, kwaye isiphelo esinembeko 요 sigqibezela isivakalisi.
texts.g:f0289db0: Ndivuka ekuseni. Ndidla isidlo sasemini. Ndilala ebusuku.
texts.n:k.k4.food:foodWords: Izibizo zokutya zithatha 을/를 nge-먹어요 (ukudla) kwaye izibizo zesiselo zithatha 을/를 nge-마셔요 (ukusela).
texts.g:549c55a7:
A: Utheni ukudla ekuseni?
B: Ndidla isonka namaqanda.
texts.n:k.k4.likes:likesVerb: 좋아해요 (ukuthanda) kunye ne-싫어해요 (ukungathandi) zithatha into ethandwayo nge-을/를, hayi nge-이/가.
texts.g:11519667:
A: Uyayithanda ikofu?
B: Hayi, andiyithandi ikofu. Ndiyayithanda iti.
texts.g:f276f946: Andiyithandi ihlobo. Lishushu kakhulu. Ndiyayithanda ubusika.
texts.n:k.k4.negation:negAn: U-안 phambi kwesenzi okanye isichazi ithetha ukungenzi okanye ukungabi nto, njengokukhanyela okuqhelekileyo.
texts.n:k.k4.negation:negMot: U-못 phambi kwesenzi uthetha ukungakwazi, ukungakwazi ukwenza into, kwaye awusetyenziswa nezichazi.
texts.g:509d6c11:
A: Uyasela ikofu?
B: Hayi, andiyisheli ikofu. Ndisela iti.
texts.g:c38124e4:
A: Uyadada?
B: Hayi, andikwazi. Kodwa ndiyakuthanda ukuzilolonga.
texts.g:c8492b20: Ndilele kakhulu kangangokuba andikwazi ukugcina amehlo evulekile.
texts.s:2678af18: Ukuphendula xa umntu ebuza ngezicwangciso zakho.
texts.g:82e36852:
A: Siye sihambe iintaba kunye kule mpelaveki?
B: Ndenzakele umlenze, ngoko andikwazi ukuya entabeni.
A: Ngoko kuthiwa yintoni ngomboniso bhanyabhanya?
B: Umboniso bhanyabhanya ulungile. Kodwa andibukeli imiboniso bhanyabhanya eyoyikisayo.
texts.n:k.k4.objects:objEulReul: Isihlomelo sesicaka ngu-을 emva kwekonsonanti yokugqibela nangu-를 emva kwesikhamiso, kwaye siya ngqo emva kwebizo eliyamkelayo isenzo.
texts.g:2dfbebc8:
A: Utya ntoni?
B: Ndityela isonka. Kwaye ndisela ubisi.
texts.n:k.k4.places:placeE: Isivumelanisi 에 sibonisa indawo yokuya ye-가요 ne-와요, kwaye sincanyathiselwa ngqo kwisibizo sendawo.
texts.g:49624570:
A: Uya phi?
B: Ndiya emarikeni.
A: Ndiya ebhankini.
texts.n:k.k4.verbs:verbPolite: Izenzi zokuhlonipha zangoku ziphela nge-요 kwaye zisetyenziswa nge-을/를 kwento esetyenzwayo, ngaphandle kotshintsho kwi-I, you okanye they.
texts.n:k.k4.weather:weatherSeason: Amagama emozulu athatha i-이/가 njengesihloko, kwaye isizini ithatha i-에 ukuthetha 'kuloo sizini'.
texts.g:3c53ec1e:
A: Imozulu injani namhlanje?
B: Iyana. Kwaye kuyabanda.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdA: Iminyaka ibalwa ngamanani esiKorea angaphandle kunye nesibali seminyaka yobudala; elinye inani lesiKorea liyafinyezwa phambi kwaso.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdB: Izibulo ezimiselweyo zisetyenziswa kwimini yokuzalwa, ukubhiyozela nokuqala kwempelaveki.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdC: Isinxalenye sexesha siphawula ukuba isiganeko senzeka nini; isinxalenye sento siphawula into enikwayo okanye eyenziweyo.
texts.g:db96a43f: Imini yam yokuzalwa ngomhla we-15 kweyeSilimela.
texts.g:20963c43: Abahlobo bam bandinike izipho ngemini yam yokuzalwa.
texts.g:4686b3b9: Ndiza kuba netheko lomhla wokuzalwa ngempelaveki.
texts.g:3cd1c6ef: Ndiye kwitheko lomhla wokuzalwa lomhlobo kwimpelaveki edlulileyo.
texts.g:2772df66:
A: Mini yakho yokuzalwa yinini?
B: NgoLwesihlanu olulandelayo.
A: Ngoko masidle isidlo sangokuhlwa kunye!
texts.g:d0cf1a36:
A: Wenza ntoni kule mpelaveki?
B: Ndiya kwitheko lomhla wokuzalwa lomhlobo.
A: Uthenge isipho?
B: Ewe, ndithenge iintyatyambo.
texts.g:ec5d3d6f: Ndaziva ndixolisa ngokufika emva kwexesha kwitheko lomhla wokuzalwa lomhlobo wam.
texts.g:107e1a4d: Minho, mini yokuzalwa emnandi! Hlala uphilile kwaye ujabule kulo nyaka nawo.
texts.g:8ad5fa92: Ngemini yam yokuzalwa ndiye kwisinema nodade wethu omkhulu.
texts.g:1806d0ca: Umntakwethu omncinci uzalelwa iminyaka elishumi kule mini yokuzalwa.
texts.g:e29f5955: Umenyiwe! Ndinetheko lomhla wam wokuzalwa ekhaya lam ngomgqibelo lo ngentathu emva kwemini. Ndiza kulungisa ukutya. Akukho zipho zifunekayo. Nceda uze ngokungenabunzima. Ukusuka kuMina
texts.g:a05885a1:
A: NgoLwesibini olulandelayo yimini yokuzalwa kaJisu.
B: Ngokwenene? Bendingazi. Sisiphi isipho esihle?

B: Ingcamango entle. Ndiza kubhala ikhadi.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clA: Iiyure zisebenzisa amanani esiKorea angaphandle ngelixa imizuzu isebenzisa amanani aseKorea asuka kwisiTshayina.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clB: Amanye amanani esiKorea angaphandle atshintsha imilo phambi kwesibali seeyure.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clC: Igama elithetha 'isiqingatha' linokumela imizuzu engamashumi amathathu.
texts.g:24d4c42e: Ndidla isidlo sasemini ngentsimbi yeshumi elinambini nesiqingatha.
texts.g:876bb22c:
A: Ngoku lithini ixesha?
B: Yi-2:50.

texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frA: Izimbo zokuphindaphindeka zisiya phambi kwesenzi; ezinye kufuneka zisetyenziswe nesenzi sokukhanyela.
texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frB: Ukuthi kangaphi ngexesha ngalinye, nika ixesha ngesihlomelo, emva koko inani nesibali samaxesha.
texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frC: Ukongeza isihlomelo okanye isimaphambili 'rhoqo' kwigama lexesha liguqula libe yinto eqhelekileyo.
texts.g:40c9d975:
A: Uyazilolonga rhoqo?
B: Ewe, kathathu ngeveki.
A: Wenza msebenzi ofana?
B: Ndiqhele ukudada.
texts.g:56524e78:
A: Usela ikofu yonke imihla?
B: Hayi, ndiyisela ngamanye amaxesha. Ndiqhele ukusela iti.
texts.g:edec3cc0: Usapho lwethu lutyelela indlu kamakhulu kanye ngenyanga.
texts.g:10adc3a6: Sele ndiwubukele lo mboniso bhanyabhanya kathathu.
texts.g:11b4fad4: Mama, kule mihla ndivuka ngentsimbi yesithandathu ekuseni ndize ndizilolonge.
texts.g:67b1f830: Kwiloliwe osemhlabeni ngamanye amaxesha ndifunda incwadi, kodwa ndiqhele ukuphulaphula umculo.
texts.g:49d31c08: Ndibuze abafundi bekilasi yethu. Kwishumi, abathandathu bafunda isiKorea yonke imihla. Abathathu bafunda kabini ngeveki. Omnye ufunda ngamanye amaxesha.
texts.g:e98ebc82:
A: Uyatya rhoqo ukutya kwaseKorea?
B: Hayi, kunqabile kakhulu. Kodwa ndiyatya i-tteokbokki impelaveki nganye.
A: Nam ndiyayithanda i-tteokbokki. Siyatya kunye kwimpelaveki ezayo?
texts.n:k.k5.months:moA: Amagamaeenyanga ngamanani aseKorea asuka kwisiTshayina kunye negama elithi 'inyanga'; amabini kuwo abhalwa ngekonsonanti yokugqibela elahliweyo.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moB: Imihla ifundwa inyanga kuqala, emva koko usuku, kwaye zombini iinxalenye zisebenzisa amanani aseKorea asuka kwisiTshayina.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moC: Amagama ezihlandla athatha isinxalenye sexesha esithetha 'ngo', ngokufuthi kwongezwa nophawu lwesihloko.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastA: Ixesha elidlulileyo lenziwa ngokongeza isiphelo kwisiqu sesenzi; isikhamiso sesiphelo sixhomekeke kwisikhamiso sokugqibela sesiqu, kwaye izenzi ze-'do' zisebenzisa ifom ekhethekileyo.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastB: Izichazi zithatha izimamva ezifanayo zexesha elidlulileyo njengezenzi kwaye zichaza ukuba into yayinjani.
texts.g:bab3b20d: Ndidle isidlo sangokuhlwa nosapho lwam izolo.
texts.g:1673a728:
A: Wenze ntoni izolo?
B: Ndidibene nomhlobo. Kwaye ndibukele ifilimu.
texts.g:ea765dea:
A: Wenze ntoni ngempelaveki?
B: Ndiphumle ekhaya. Kwaye ndifunde incwadi.
texts.g:751591f5: Ndiboleke iincwadi ezintathu kwithala leencwadi izolo.
texts.g:82cb09ee: NgoMgqibelo odlulileyo sipheke isidlo sangokuhlwa kunye ekhaya lomhlobo.
texts.g:40862514: Ndenze umsebenzi wasekhaya emva kwexesha phezolo, ngoko ndandidiniwe ekuseni.
texts.g:bf51d517: Minji, uxolo ngokuba ndingakwazanga ukuya kwintlanganiso izolo. Bendinentloko ebuhlungu ukusuka ekuseni. Ndisele amayeza ndaphumla ekhaya. Ndiphilile ngoku.
texts.g:83bfe9ee:
A: Uye phi ngempelaveki?
B: Ndiye elwandle. Ndithathe neefoto ezininzi.
A: Bekunjani ukuhla kwemozulu?
B: Bekubanda kancinane, kodwa kuhle kakhulu.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2A: Iziqu ezigqibela ngezikhamiso okanye ongonsonanti ezithile ziyatshintsha ukuma phambi kwesiphelo sexesha elidlulileyo.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2B: Isenzi 'ukuba' sinezimo saso ezidlulileyo ezixhomekeke ekubeni isibizo sigqibela ngekonsonanti okanye sisikhamiso.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2C: Igama elichasayo elibekwe phambi kwesenzi linika 'akwenzanga' okanye 'akwazanga', yaye isenzi ngokwaso sithwala isiphelo sexesha elidlulileyo.
texts.g:cd5d0c71: Andikwazanga ukwenza umsebenzi wam wasekhaya izolo.
texts.g:053ddce0: Ndilindele umhlobo wam kwisikhululo sikaloliwe somgxobhozo imizuzu engamashumi amathathu.
texts.g:b9fa8ec4: Udade wethu omkhulu usebenze eofisini izolo.
texts.g:ef4b18a8:
A: Kutheni ungeze esikolweni izolo?
B: Isisu sam sibuhlungu. Ndiye esibhedlele.
texts.g:38d87c8c:
A: Bekukho abantu abaninzi kwitheko izolo?
B: Ewe, bebebaninzi. Ukutya nako bekumnandi.
texts.g:8c5854e8: Ndidle i-galbitang nomhlobo wam kwisidlo sasemini izolo, yaye bekushushu kakhulu.
texts.g:14ec768c: Umnini wevenkile leyo ebengumntu olungileyo kakhulu.
texts.g:fd3dd07a: Umntakwethu omncinci ebesithanda ngokwenene ubisi esemncinci.
texts.g:c29e438b: Namhla ibilusuku olunobuxakeka ngokwenene. Ndivukile emva kwexesha ekuseni ndaphoswa yibhasi. Ngoko ndifike emva kwexesha esikolweni. Ngokuhlwa umhlobo ufowunile sathetha iyure. Bendidiniwe kakhulu, kodwa ndizive ndikhululekile.
texts.g:f167da4a:
A: Uye kwikhonsathi izolo?
B: Ewe, kodwa bekukho abantu abaninzi kangangokuba kungekho ndawo yokuhlala.
A: Ngoko ubukele umi?
B: Ewe, ndime iiyure ezimbini. Imilenze yam ibuhlungu.

texts.n:k.k5.plans:planB: Iziqu eziphela ngekonsonanti evakala njengo-'l' ziyilahla phambi kwesi siphelo.
texts.n:k.k5.plans:planC: Igama lokukhanyela lisiya phambi kwesenzi, kwaye isiphelo senjongo sihlala ekupheleni.

texts.g:5e505523: Ndandingakwazi ukubukela ifilimu kuba ndandithatha iifoto.
texts.g:f651fbce: Ndandingakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wasekhaya kuba ndandikhathalele umntakwethu omncinci.
texts.g:8056419a: Ndixakeke ezi ntsuku kuba ndizilungiselela uviwo.
texts.g:5c0373ea: Nangona ndifunde nzima, andenzanga kakuhle kuvavanyo.
texts.g:2a3e9897: Nangona ndiselile amayeza, intloko yam iyabuhlungu.
texts.g:52ffafb3: Nangona ixabiso liphezulu, kukho abantu abaninzi.
texts.g:11e1bd8c: Nangona ndinexesha elininzi, andenzanga umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:01f67f43: Nangona ndivuke kwangethuba, ndifike emva kwexesha.
texts.g:42036d3e: Ndandingakwazi ukuya rhoqo kwiintlanganiso zeklabhu kuba ndandisebenza ixesha elithile.
texts.g:52095e69: Nokuba indlela inamaxhoba, ibhasi ihlala ifika ngexesha.
texts.g:5faa16d2: Ndalibala nokutya isidlo sasemini kuba ndandibhala ingxelo.
texts.g:719d03b9: Nangona ndanxiba ibhatyi eshinyeneyo, umoya wawubanda yaye ndandihleli ndingcangcazela.
texts.g:b3b8105a: Nangona indlu yethu incinci, abahlobo bayasityelela rhoqo.
texts.g:b3e57de1: Kuba ndandinceda osebenza naye, ndandingakwazi ukugqiba umsebenzi wam ngexesha lokuvala.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_ask:iaForm: Imibuzo ebikwayo isebenzisa -냐고 (izenzi, izichazi, 있다/없다, ixesha elidlulileyo -았/었냐고) kunye ne-(이)냐고 kwizibizo, elandelwa yi-묻다 okanye 하다.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_ask:iaFut: Ixesha elizayo likhutshwa nge-(으)ㄹ 거냐고; izenzi ze-ㄹ zilahla i-ㄹ phambi kwe-냐고.
texts.g:b79e4e17: Umhlobo wam ubuze ukuba ndinaxesha ngomso.
texts.g:65cf7f89: Umntakwethu omncinci ubuze ukuba sityela ntoni ngokuhlwa.
texts.g:b84f1fb3: Umhlobo wam ubuze ukuba le bhegi ibiza kakhulu.
texts.g:3638fe4b: Umntu ubuze ukuba loo mntu ungumfundi.
texts.g:80fa5426: Umhlobo wam ubuze ukuba ndenze ntoni ngempelaveki.
texts.g:d71d9770: Udadewethu omdala ubuze ukuba kuya kuna imvula ngomso.
texts.g:443faa87: Utata ubuze ukuba ndifika ngeyiphi iyure.
texts.g:625b7936: Umsebenzi wevenkile ubuze ukuba bangaphi abantu.
texts.g:6d482591: Umntakwethu omncinci ubuze ukuba ndaya nini eKorea.
texts.g:af8c6bfb: Umama ubuze ukuba andinawo umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:6c865ace: Utitshala ubuze ukuba kutheni ndifike emva kwexesha.
texts.g:a92291f4: Umhlobo ubuze ukuba ndiyakuthanda ukutya kwaseKorea.
texts.g:db1ef2fb: Umntu ongaziwayo ubuze ukuba yeyiphi iyure ngoku.
texts.g:6f6e9e32: Umntakwethu omncinci ubuza ukuba ndayifunda le ncwadi.
texts.g:50bcd2ac: Umhlobo ubuze ukuba ndiza kuhamba kunye.
texts.g:13fd7256: Umama ubuza ukuba ndigqibe wonke umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.s:94ee4c60: Awuvanga ukuba omnye umntu uthe ntoni ngoku, uze umcele ukuba aphinde.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icCmd: Umyalelo obikwayo yi-(으)라고 하다 (-으라고 emva kwekhonsonanti, -라고 emva kwevowuli okanye ㄹ); isiphakamiso esibikwayo yi-자고 하다.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icNeg: Imiyalelo engavumiyo ebikwayo isebenzisa -지 말라고 kwaye izicelo ezingavumiyo zisebenzisa -지 말자고.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icL: Izenzi eziphela nge-ㄹ zithatha -라고, hayi -으라고, kwimiyalelo ebikwayo.
texts.g:7f4aad16: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba sibukele ifilimu kunye.
texts.g:95f00fd3: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba sihambe sonwabe ngempelaveki.
texts.g:8ee1eb97: Umntakwethu omncinci ucebise ukuba sityele isidlo sasemini kunye.
texts.g:0ad9a2ad: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba sidibane kwangoko ngomso.
texts.g:ad2f279a: Umama undixelele ukuba ndenze umsebenzi wasekhaya kuqala.
texts.g:5b7dcfd5: Udadewethu omdala undixelele ukuba ndilinde apha.
texts.g:7833997b: Umhlobo undixelele ukuba ndize kwikhaya lakhe.
texts.g:e733b4f4: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba sithathe ifoto kunye.
texts.g:f07c0449: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba sifunde kunye kuba kukho uvavanyo ngomso.
texts.g:31689486: Umhlobo ucebise ukuba siye kusela ikofu.
texts.g:ef26ef89: Utitshala usixelele ukuba sivule iincwadi zethu.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_state:isVerb: Isivakalisi sibikwa nge-ㄴ/는다고 하다 kwizenzi, i-다고 elula kwizichazi nakwi-있다/없다, kwaye (이)라고 kwizibizo.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_state:isPast: Kwizehlo zexesha elidlulileyo okanye elizayo sebenzisa -았/었다고 kunye ne-(으)ㄹ 거라고 phambi kwe-하다.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_state:isL: Izenzi ze-ㄹ zilahla i-ㄹ phambi kwe-ㄴ xa kwenziwa ixesha langoku elilula.
texts.g:487d2448: Umama uthe kuya kuna imvula ngokuhlwa.
texts.g:b98ff68a: Umntakwethu omncinci uthi wabukela ifilimu izolo.
texts.g:2126721b: Udadewethu omdala uthi uziqhelanisa umzimba imihla ngemihla.
texts.g:bc93bac5: Iindaba zithe kuya kuna ikhephu ngomso.
texts.g:c10b243d: Umhlobo wam uthe ukutya kwaseKorea kumnandi.
texts.g:b7f3abde: Umntakwethu omncinci uthe akanawo umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:ef5d666f: Isoka lam lithi lixakekile ezi ntsuku.
texts.g:2b7eded0: Umhlobo wam uthe akayi esikolweni namhlanje.
texts.g:28bc5eb6:
A: Kutheni uMinsu engezanga?
B: Uthe akakwazi ukuza namhlanje kuba ebanjwe yimfuluwenza.
texts.n:k.k7.pretense:prePres: -는 척하다 ithetha 'ukulinganisa ukwenza' kwizenzi zangoku nakwi-있다/없다; sebenzisa -(으)ㄴ 척하다 emva kwezichazi nakwi-이다.
texts.n:k.k7.pretense:prePast: Ukulinganisa ukuba wenze into esele yenziwe, sebenzisa ixesha elidlulileyo -(으)ㄴ 척하다 kwisenzi.
texts.n:k.k7.pretense:preNeg: Ukukhanyela kusebenza ngaphakathi kokulinganisa: 안 + isenzi okanye -지 않다 kuba 안 V는 척 okanye V지 않는 척.
texts.g:82bf026e: Umhlobo wam walinganisa ukugqiba lonke umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:25438304: Ndenza ngathi ndiphilile, kodwa ngokwenene ndandibuhlungu.
texts.g:46cfc26e: Umhlobo wam ulinganisa ukuba nobuchule bokuthetha isiKorea.
texts.g:a4302604: Umntakwethu omncinci ulinganisa ukufunda aze adlale imidlalo.
texts.g:21e88863: Loo mfundi walinganisa ukuqonda oko utitshala akuthethileyo.
texts.g:6b3199be: Loo mntu ulinganisa ukuba nobubele, kodwa ngokwenene akunjalo.
texts.g:577c64c2: Umntakwethu omncinci ulinganisa ukuba mntu omkhulu.
texts.g:30947284: Umntakwethu omdala wenza ngathi akukho nto yenzekileyo.
texts.g:01310541: Ndalinganisa ukuncuma, kodwa ngaphakathi ndandivakala kakubi.
texts.g:dfc2a254: Umntakwethu omncinci ulinganisa ukucoca kuphela aze adlale.
texts.n:k.k7.proportion:prSu: -(으)ㄹ수록 ithetha 'ukuba ngakumbi ... ngakumbi ...'; ibambelela kwiziqu zezenzi nezichazi, kwaye iziqu ze-ㄹ zithatha -수록 ngqo.
texts.n:k.k7.proportion:prSuIrr: Iziqu ze-ㅂ- nenga-ㄷ-ezingaqhelekanga zitshintsha isandi sazo sokugqibela phambi kwe--(으)ㄹ수록.
texts.n:k.k7.proportion:prMa: -기 마련이다 ithi into ifanele ukwenzeka okanye iyinto yendalo; ibambelela kwisiqu esiqhelekileyo.
texts.g:d3be5d3e: Ndithe ndifunda isiKorea ngakumbi, kube mnandi ngakumbi.
texts.g:2ae3774f: Ndithe ndityile ezi zimuncumuncu ngakumbi, ndifune ukutya ngakumbi.
texts.g:73801adf: Ngokuya ukhula, ixesha lihamba ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi.
texts.g:295c7c60: Ngokuya ibanga lide, intlawulo yeteksi iphezulu ngakumbi.
texts.g:289bc365: Ngokuya kuba nzima, kufuneka usebenze nzima ngakumbi.
texts.g:2a7ba973: Ngokuya imozulu ibanda, iti eshushu imnandi ngakumbi.
texts.g:91e2713c: Ukuba uphulaphula kakhulu, ingoma iba mnandi ngakumbi.
texts.g:333a7225: Ukuba ndiyisebenzisa kakhulu, iba lula ngakumbi.
texts.g:8006715c: Ukuba usebenza nzima, iziphumo ezilungileyo ziya kulandela.
texts.g:60cfdbaf: Emva kokuba ubusika budlulile, intwasahlobo iya kuza.
texts.g:3b456729: Ekuqaleni, kuqhelekile ukuba wonke umntu akufumane kunzima.
texts.g:25e02160: Izinto ziya konakala ukuba uzisebenzisa ixesha elide.
texts.g:ef377813: Xa kuna imvula, iindlela ziya kuxinana.
texts.g:c556748c: Ukuba ulala emva kwexesha, uya kudinwa.
texts.n:k.k7.regret:rgForm: Ingcambu yesenzi + -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요 ibonisa ukuzisola ngento ongayenzanga ('Ndandifanele ...').
texts.n:k.k7.regret:rgNeg: Sebenzisa -지 말 걸 그랬어요 ukuthi 'Ndandingafanele ...' ngento oyenzileyo.
texts.n:k.k7.regret:reg: -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요 ibonisa ukuzisola ngento ongayenzanga. Kwinto oyenzileyo ngoku uzisola ngayo, sebenzisa -지 말 걸 그랬어요. Isenzi phambi kwe-걸 sihlala kwifom ye-(으)ㄹ.
texts.g:bea5a447: Ndandifanele ndityele isidlo sakusasa phambi kokuba ndize.
texts.g:fdf29d08: Ndandingafanele ndihlale ngaphandle ndidlala kude kube kade izolo.
texts.g:d63955fd: Ukuba ndandisazi ukuba indlela iya kuxinana, ndandifanele ndithabathe ololiwe womhlaba.
texts.g:b5ff7e64: Ndandifanele ndiphinde ndihlaziye kanye ngaphambi kovavanyo.
texts.g:63881fdc: Bendifanele ukuba ndimphulaphule umhlobo wam ngokupheleleyo.
texts.g:109f3dda: A: Uyenze kakuhle ityestile? B: Hayi. Bendifanele ukuba ndifunde ngakumbi. A: Musa ukuxhala kakhulu. Masilungiselele kunye kwixesha elizayo. B: Enkosi. Masifunde kunye kwithala leencwadi.
texts.n:k.k7.review_k7:rvMix: Olu phononongo luxuba intetho ethethwe ngomnye, izixhumi ezintsonkothileyo negrama yebhulorho yangaphambili kumgangatho.
texts.n:k.k7.review_k7:rvRep: Dibanisa isiphelo sengxelo nohlobo lwentetho: ingxelo -다고, umbuzo -냐고, umyalelo -(으)라고, ingcebiso -자고.
texts.g:55beac11: Umhlobo wam uthe akakwazi ukuza ngomso.
texts.g:bc51213b: Utitshala wabuza ukuba ndiwenzile na umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:157df687: Mama wandixelela ukuba ndibuye ekhaya kwangoko.
texts.g:8a9e5017: Umntakwethu omncinci ucebise ukudlala umdlalo kunye.
texts.g:b32e5d4f: Ukuba ndisidla kakhulu ukutya kwaseKorea, kuya kuba mnandi ngakumbi.
texts.g:1a3f73c8: Akukho mntu apha, ngoko kubonakala ukuba bavalile namhlanje.
texts.g:0c4359a7: Umntakwethu omncinci wenza ngathi ugqibile umsebenzi wasekhaya.
texts.g:f39529f8: Bendifanele ukuba ndiqhagamshelane nomhlobo wam kuqala.
texts.g:6d0fddaa: Ndandibuhlungu isisu, ngoko andikwazanga ukuya esikolweni.
texts.g:a64563e2: Ukuba ndinemali, ndifuna ukuthenga leyo ngxowa.
texts.g:bfb563c9: Kufuneka ndigqibe umsebenzi wam wasekhaya ngomso.
texts.g:96ccf153:
A: Wenza ntoni ngempelaveki?
B: Umhlobo ucebise ukubukela ifilimu. Ngoko siza kubukela kunye.
texts.g:846c02f2:
A: Minsu, ubonakala udiniwe.
B: Andikwazanga ukulala phezolo kuba bendisenza umsebenzi wasekhaya.
A: Nceda ulale kwangoko namhlanje.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_affix:caAff: Izenzi zinokuthatha isimaphambili esifutshane sokwenzisa (i, hi, ri, gi, okanye u) ukuthetha ukwenza umntu enze isenzo; isimaphambili simiselwe isenzi ngasinye.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_affix:caObj: Isenzi sokwenzisa siyatshintsha, ngoko umntu owenziswa ukwenza adla ngokuphawulwa sisinxalenye sento okanye sesinxalenye sokunikela.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_affix:caAdj: Ezinye izicubungulo zezichazi nezezenzi ezingatshintshiyo zenza izenzi zokwenzisa ezithetha ukwenza into ibe kuloo meko.
texts.g:314f51ee: Usana lunesithukuthezi, ngoko umama ulalisa usana.
texts.g:ab689479: Lo mntu uhlekisayo uhlala ehlekisa abantu.
texts.g:ce06c100: Ndandise ixesha lam lokufunda ukusuka kwiyure enye ukuya kwiiyure ezimbini.
texts.g:93dba078: Ndifunde nzima ndaphakamisa amanqaku am etyestile.
texts.g:4e0dc78d: Ndixelele umhlobo wam ezi ndaba kuqala.
texts.g:be91da8e: Siyagcina kwaye sikhulisa inja encinci ekhaya lethu.
texts.g:a62179e7: Umphathi wesebe wabeke ngasemva ishedyuli yentlanganiso ngeveki.
texts.g:d25d6168: Ingxelo echonge unobangela wengozi ikhutshwe namhlanje.
texts.g:a66d95da: Ukuba ubonisa umthengi isampulu kuqala, ithuba lekontraka liyanyuka.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_compound:ccGe: Ipatheni yokwenzisa yenza okanye ivumela umntu enze into; umntu owenziswa ukwenza uphawulwa sisinxalenye sento okanye sesinxalenye sokunikela.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_compound:ccAdj: Isichazi kunye nepatheni yokwenzisa kuthetha ukwenza into okanye umntu abe kuloo meko.
texts.n:k.k8.causative_compound:ccReq: Ukongeza isiphelo sesicelo kwipatheni yokwenzisa kucela umntu ukuba akuvumele wena okanye abanye benze into.
texts.g:65781296: Utitshala wenza abafundi benze umsebenzi wabo wasekhaya.
texts.g:8326b5c1: Ugqirha uyalele isigulana ukuba siphumle kakhulu.
texts.g:b20db157: Nceda uvumele abantwana badlale kangangoko befuna.
texts.g:b82a8ff5: Ndivale isibane ukuze usana lulale ngokuphumla.
texts.g:cf31bd56: Vumela umntwana wakho afunde iincwadi yedwa.
texts.g:c7cfea02: Inkampani ivumela abasebenzi bayo ukuba bayeke umsebenzi kwangoko.
texts.n:k.k8.formal_style:fsImp: Isiphelo somyalelo osemthethweni songeza isihlomelo sokuhlonipha esiqwini, kwaye ifomu yaso yokukhanyela isebenzisa isenzi sokuthintela.
texts.n:k.k8.formal_style:fsStmt: Izitatimenti ezisemthethweni zisebenzisa isiphelo esinye emva kwesikhamiso okanye isiqu esiphela ngonobumba l, nesinye emva kwekonsonanti; izenzi zesiqu se-l zilahla l yokugqibela.
texts.n:k.k8.formal_style:fsQ: Imibuzo esemthethweni iphela ngepatheni yokuthobeka -nikka, kwaye iifomu zokuhlonipha zongeza isihlomelo sokuhlonipha phambi kwayo.
texts.n:k.k8.formal_style:fsExpr: Imibuliso emiselweyo nezibhengezo ezisemthethweni zisebenzisa iziphelo zomyalelo okanye zesitatimenti esisemthethweni.
texts.s:a37ce990: Ungulungu labasebenzi ekhapha isimenywa kwindawo esemthethweni.
texts.s:2f12c05e: Uhamba entlanganisweni esemthethweni uze uvalelise abo basalayo.
texts.s:c6ac6332: Ilungu labasebenzi libulela abathengi ekupheleni kwenkonzo.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_obj:hoGive: Izenzi zokuthobeka zehlisa isenzo somntu othethayo kumntu ohlonitshwayo, ophawulwe sisihlomelo sokuhlonipha somamkeli.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_obj:hoVerb: Isenzi ngasinye sokuthobeka sinentsingiselo yaso: ukunika, ukudibana, ukubuza, ukuhamba kunye, okanye ukuxelela, ngoko khetha isenzi esilungele isenzo.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_obj:hoPart: Isihlomelo sokuhlonipha somamkeli sithatha indawo ye-dative eqhelekileyo, ngoxa izenzi zokudibana zithatha isihlomelo sesicaka esiqhelekileyo.
texts.g:6e7980cd: Ndiza kutyelela indlu kamakhulu kule mpelaveki.
texts.s:4e3b2448: Unikela ukukhapha umntu osele emdala ukuya ekhayeni lakhe.
texts.g:07f9c124: Ndandingayazi kakuhle indlela, ngoko ndabuza ipolisa.
texts.g:e66f3f26: Ndiza kukhapha undwendwe ndilisa egumbini lentlanganiso.
texts.g:b3d86107: Kwakumnandi kakhulu ukubona utitshala wam wangaphambili emva kwexesha elide kangaka.
texts.g:b4714f71: Ndixelele umongameli ukuba kuvele into ephuthumayo.
texts.g:a78e9127: Ndiceba ukuthatha abazali bam uhambo ngeeholide.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_subj:hsVocab: Izibizo nezenzi zentlonipho zithatha indawo yezo zilula xa isihloko singumntu ohlonitshwayo, umzekelo ubudala, igama, indlu nezidlo.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_subj:hsSubj: Isiphawuli sesihloko sentlonipho siphawula umntu ohlonitshwayo njengesihloko, kwaye isenzi sithatha isingeniso sentlonipho.
texts.n:k.k8.honorific_subj:hsVerb: Ezinye izenzi zinefom zazo zentlonipho, kwaye eyiyo ixhomekeke kwisenzo, njengokutya, ukulala, ukuthetha okanye ukuba kwindawo.
texts.g:5773c496:
A: Ukuphi utatomkhulu?
B: Ulele egumbini lakhe ngoku.
A: Ngoko ndiza kumsebeza isidlo kamva kancinane.
texts.g:98385ea9: Umama akaphilanga, ngoko uye esibhedlele namhlanje.
texts.n:k.k8.modesty:mdSelf: Amagama okuthobeka ayehlisa umntu othethayo okanye iqela lakhe, kwaye isingeniso sentlonipho asisetyenziswa kuwe ngokwakho.
texts.n:k.k8.modesty:mdVerb: Izenzi zokuthobeka zokunika nokuxela ziboniswa intlonipho kumphulaphuli ngokuhlisa isenzo sakho.
texts.n:k.k8.modesty:mdFixed: Amabinzana okuthobeka amiselweyo asetyenziswa xa uzazisa, ucela imbeko, okanye ubulela umntu ohlonitshwayo.
texts.g:b37d9d32: Mhlawumbi ndineengxowa zamava, kodwa ndiza kusebenza nzima.
texts.s:b37d9d32: Umsebenzi omtsha uzazisa kwintlanganiso yokuqala yeqela.
texts.g:4a212218: Akukho nto inkulu, kodwa nceda wamkele.
texts.s:4a212218: Unikezela isipho esincinci kwaye uthetha ngokuthobeka ngaso.
texts.g:16ebf181: Ndineentloni kancinane, kodwa ndiza kucula ingoma.
texts.n:k.k8.passive_affix:paAff: Izenzi ezininzi ezinxulumene nezinto zenza ipassive ngesijobelelo esifutshane (i, hi, ri, okanye gi), eso senza into yokuqala ibe sisihloko.
texts.n:k.k8.passive_affix:paAgent: Umenzi kwisivakalisi sepassive uphawulwa ngesiphawuli esinjengesidativi, kwaye umamkeli wesenzo uba sisihloko.
texts.n:k.k8.passive_affix:paRes: Ingcambu yepassive kunye nesenzi esincedisayo sokuba khona kuchaza imeko eyenziwa sisenzo.
texts.g:f8ec48e4: Eli bhuku lithengiswa kakuhle ngezi ntsuku.
texts.g:6cd82077: Ikhephu liqokelelene kakhulu, ngoko indlela iyatyibilika.
texts.g:f7f047ab: Eli gama lisetyenziswa rhoqo ebomini bemihla ngemihla.
texts.g:d89f561d: Ucango lwangaphambili lwaluzimele, ngoko andikwazanga ukungena.
texts.g:f373e862: Intlanganiso eqhelekileyo yale nyanga iqhutyelwa kwigumbi eliphambili leentlanganiso.
texts.g:8ce81f4f: Olu xwebhu lufundwa kakhulu phakathi kwabasebenzi.
texts.g:2f14176a: Ndikhatshwa lixesha lokugqibela, andikwazanga nokutya isidlo sasemini.

texts.g:b1e254c9: Inani lezikhalazo zabathengi lehle kakhulu xa kuthelekiswa nenyanga edlulileyo.
texts.g:47a193f5: Iindleko zaphuma ngaphezu kwalindelekileyo, ngoko ukulungiswa koHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali akunakuphepheka.
texts.g:31d248bb: Ndilungelelanise iziphumo zovavanyo ndazixela kunkokheli yeqela.
texts.g:b5e19486: Asizange sifezekise zonke iinjongo ezicwangcisiweyo, kodwa sigqibe imisebenzi eyintloko.
texts.g:6bbe6a0d: Uhlalutyo lwendlela yokuthengisa yekota lubonisa ukuba inkqubela ephezulu yacaca njengoko ixesha lesibini liqala.
texts.g:685e1961: Ngokwesi vavanyo, kugwetywa ukuba ukwenza lula inkqubo yangoku kunokunciphisa ixesha lokuqhuba ngesiqingatha.
texts.g:61789bd5: Izinga lokusetyenziswa koHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lweprojekthi liphantsi, ngoko amanyathelo okongeza kufuneka alungiselelwe ngasekupheleni konyaka.
texts.g:be0ce06e: Olu phando lwenziwe kubantu abadala abayi-1,000 abangaphakathi kweminyaka yamashumi amabini ukuya kwamashumi amathandathu.
texts.g:135d2195: Ekupheleni kwengxelo ndishwankathele kwaye ndincamathisele imisebenzi yexesha elizayo neendlela zokuphucula.
texts.g:f567fa5f: Ndixela imeko yokuphatha imibuzo yabathengi yekota yesi-3. Imibuzo yonke ifikile kwi-2,400, inyuke ngamaphesenti ali-8 kunekota edlulileyo, kodwa ixesha eliphakathi lokuphatha lehliswe ukusuka kwiintsuku ezimbini ukuya kuye. Oku kuhlalutywa njengesiphumo sokuncipha kwemibuzo elula emva kokuba imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo ilungiselelwe kwiphepha loncedo. Noko ke, imibuzo enxulumene nokubuyiselwa kwemali yonyuke kunoko, ngoko kudingeka isicwangciso sokuphendula esahlukileyo. Kwikota yesi-4 siceba ukuphucula ukukhokela kwenkqubo yokubuyisela imali kuqala.
texts.g:85123a65: Imizuzu yentlanganiso yesi-3 yokuphononongwa kweprojekthi. Iajenda yayikukucwangcisa kwakhona ukutshintshwa kwenkqubo yomoya yesakhiwo seofisi. Ontraktha uxele ukuba iziqwenga zifike emva kwexesha kwaye wayeza kulibazisa ukuqala kokwakha ngeeveki ezimbini. Ekuphenduleni, umphathi wemicimbi ngokubanzi wamkele ukulibaziseka ngokuthatha ukuba umsebenzi uya kugqitywa phambi kohlolo lwasekupheleni konyaka, kodwa wagqiba ngelithi ukuba umhla olindelekileyo wokugqitywa uphinda wehlile, inkqubo yokukhetha ontraktha obuyisela iya kuqala kwangoko. Amalungu avumile ukwazisa ontraktha ngale meko ngokubhala. Noko ke, ukuba ngubani onoxanduva lokufika emva kwexesha kweziqwenga akuzange kuthethwe kule ntlanganiso.
texts.g:bb2fd3a9: Isaziso sokulungiswa kwemirhumo yokupaka koluntu. Ukususela ngowokuqala wenyanga ezayo, umrhumo osisiseko uya kulungiswa ukusuka kwi-600 won ukuya kwi-800 won ngemizuzu engama-30. Noko ke, umrhumo wangaphambili uya kusebenza kwiimoto ezibhaliswe ukupaka kokuqala kwabahlali nakwiimoto ezibonisa imvume yokukhubazeka. Nakwiimoto ezibhaliswe, xa ukusetyenziswa kwenyanga kudlula iiyure ezili-100, umrhumo olungisiweyo usebenza kuphela kwisixa esingaphezulu. Ingeniso eyongezelelweyo evela kuhlaziyo iya kusetyenziswa kuphela ekulungiseni izixhobo, kwaye ukusetyenziswa kweenkcukacha zemali kuya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi ekupheleni konyaka.
texts.g:049bc42e: Ingxelo yoluvo lwangaphakathi. Kuhlolo lwesampuli yezivumelwano zokuthengwa kwempahla ezingamashumi amane ezisuka kwisiqingatha sokuqala salo nyaka, ezingamashumi amathathu anesithandathu zilandele inkqubo. Kwezo zisele ezine, isizathu sesivumelwano esingenayo ikhwota sibhalwe emva kokusayinwa kwesivumelwano, kodwa kuba izixa zezivumelwano zonke zingaphantsi kwemida, azithathwa njengokophula imigaqo. Noko ke, ukuze ukubhalwa emva kwenyani kungaqinisi kube sisenzo, icandelo elinoxanduva kufuneka liqinisekise isizathu phambi kwesivumelwano ukususela kwikota ezayo. Iqela loluvo liza kuphinda lihlole ukuthotyelwa ekupheleni kwekota.
texts.g:976a9aaa: Isishwankathelo semizuzu yengxoxo yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lesiqingatha sesibini. Icandelo lophando nophuhliso licele ukwanda kwe-400 million won kwiindleko zokuthenga izixhobo. Ikomiti yezemali ayivumelanga isixa sonke esicelwayo; yabela i-200 million won kuqala yaza yagqiba ukuba iqwalasele eseleyo ngokongezelelweyo kuphela ukuba umgangatho wokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo kulo nyaka udlula kwi-70 lepesenti. Usihlalo wacela icandelo lophando nophuhliso ukuba lilungiselele, phambi kwentlanganiso elandelayo, imigangatho yendlela umgangatho wokusetyenziswa oya kubalwa ngayo. Icandelo lophando nophuhliso aliphakamisanga nasiphi isichaso koku.
texts.g:ae29c713: Imeko yemigudu yokufutshane ixesha lokusebenza kwemvume. Ixesha eliphakathi lokusebenza kulo nyaka belingeentsuku ezingama-41, ezi-9 zimfutshane kunonyaka odlulileyo. Ukuxinana kwexesha lokusebenza kusezantsi kwinqanaba lengxoxo yempembelelo yokusingqongileyo, ebalwa nge-60 lepesenti yazo zonke iimeko ezilibazisekileyo. Icandelo elinoxanduva liza kuvavanya icebo lokusingatha iinkqubo zengxoxo ngaxeshanye, kodwa aliyi kuwunciphisa umhla wohlolo olusemthethweni. Ixesha elifunyenwe ekuphatheni ngaxeshanye liza kufunyanwa ngokunciphisa ukuphindaphinda kwezicelo zokongeza amaxwebhu esicelo. Ngoko ke, impembelelo yokufutshane iya kuxhomekeka kakhulu ekubeni amaxwebhu angeniswa ngokucokisekileyo ukususela ekuqaleni.
texts.g:d3bd3f83: Ingxelo ngeemeko neenyathelo emva kwengozi yokuthintana kwefolokhlifti kwisikhululo sokusasaza. Ngexesha lomsebenzi wasebusuku kwinyanga edlulileyo, ifolokhlifti yathintana nomsebenzi kwindawo yokulayisha, kodwa umsebenzi wafumana inxeba elincinci kuphela. Uphando lufumanise ukuba umqhubi wagcina isantya esimiselweyo nokuba imeko yokugcinwa kwefolokhlifti nayo yayilungile. Noko ke, kwindawo ekukhanya kancinane indlela yokuhamba neyemoto zazingahlulwanga. Isikhululo sigqibe ukuba isizathu esithe ngqo sisiphene kuyilo lokuhamba kunokuba kube kukungakhathali komntu ngamnye, kwaye sagqiba ngokungamjezisi umqhubi. Endaweni yoko, siza kugqiba ukwahlula iindlela ngaphakathi kweenyanga ezimbini, kwaye de kube lapho, siza kunciphisa umsebenzi wasebusuku kuloo ndawo.
texts.g:6c39236a: Isikhundla ngokukrokrelwa kokuvuza kwamarekhodi okufikelela kwidatha. I-Hangyeol Institute ibhengeze ukuba, ngokophando lwenkampani yokhuseleko yangaphandle, kuqinisekisiwe iimpawu zokuba amanye amarekhodi okungena abaphandi abonwe ngaphandle ngoMatshi odlulileyo. Noko ke, ukuba amarekhodi abonwe aqulethe ulwazi lokuchonga umntu akukaqinisekiswa, kwaye okwangoku akukho meko yomonakalo ifunyenweyo. Isiseko sithe siza kupapasha iziphumo kwangoko xa ukuqinisekiswa kugqityiwe kwaye, ukuba kuvela ukuba ulwazi lokuchonga lubandakanyiwe, liza kwazisa abachaphazelekayo ngamnye. Ukongeza, licwangcisa uphononongo olupheleleyo lenkqubo yalo yolawulo lwemvume yokufikelela ngenxa yalo mcimbi.
texts.g:b9e90e9f: Uhlolo lufumene izinto ezithile ezigqitha umgangatho, ngoko kwacelwa isenzo sokulungisa.
texts.g:d46e1f08: Ndixela ngezantsi izizathu zokuba izinga lokuphunyezwa kohlahlo lwabiwo-mali libe ngaphantsi kwekhowuta kunye nesicwangciso sokulinxibelelanisa.
texts.g:85605a8f: Ukuba imiqathango yekontraka itshintshiwe, kufuneka kunikwe isaziso esibhaliweyo kwangaphambili.
texts.g:39648128: Esi sinyathelo sesethutyana, kwaye umgaqo-nkqubo wokugqibela uza kuqinisekiswa emva kokuxoxwa yikomiti.
texts.g:a0aa709a: Ukuba kukho utshintsho kwicandelo elingasentla, nceda uqhagamshelane nesebe elinoxanduva ngokukhawuleza.
texts.g:fea2fcff: Ukuba kufunyenwe into engaqhelekanga ngexesha lokuvavanya, kufuneka umise ukusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwaye uxele kumntu oyintloko.
texts.g:a39dd73a: Umcimbi uphathwe ngokweemithetho ebhekiselekileyo, kwaye akukho nkcaso ahlukileyo ephakanyisiweyo.
texts.g:4631c1a2: Ndincoma ukumisa okwethutyana esi sicwangciso sokuphucula kuba umphumo waso wokonga iindleko mncinci, kodwa ukuphinda uvavanye kamva.
