texts.n:k.k9.biz_schedule:schedWord: Amabizo okucwangcisa adla ngokusondelelana ngefom kodwa ahluke ngentsingiselo, ngoko vumelanisa ibizo nesenzo esichazwayo.
texts.s:e3dc1a44: Uqhagamshelana nomlingane ukufumana ixesha lentlanganiso elifanele zombini iinxalenye.
texts.g:f2953c3e: Ndinesibophelelo sangaphambili ngaloo mini, ngoko kuya kuba nzima.
texts.s:017cde72: Uxolisa emva kokutshintsha isicwangciso ngexesha elifutshane.
texts.s:ac6a7e12: Ishedyuli ayikaqinisekiswa kwaye uthembisa ukwazisa omnye uhlangothi.
texts.g:9ac09f78: Ndiza kuyihlehlisa intlanganiso ide ibe ngoLwesibini olulandelayo.
texts.g:298f58b0: Kungalunga ukuyitshintsha ukusuka kwisithathu ukuya kwesine emva kwemini?
texts.g:e0738fa2: Ndiza kuyiqinisekisa emva kokujonga iishedyuli zabo abaza kuba lapho.
texts.g:a0170490: Uxolo, kodwa ndicinga ukuba kufuneka ndirhoxise idinga lale emva kwemini.
texts.g:217ab817: Ukuba undixelela ixesha olikhethayo, ndiza kuzilungelelanisa nalo.
texts.g:3c66ccf6: Ngenxa yohambo lwebhizinisi, siyisise ukutyelela kwiveki ngaphambili.
texts.g:7a9b44f9:
A: Ngaba intlanganiso yeveki ezayo ngoLwesithathu inokukulungela?
B: ULwesithathu lunzima. Kuthekani ngoLwesine emva kwemini?
A: Ngentsimbi yesibini ngoLwesine kulungile.
B: Ngoko ndiza kuliqinisekisa elo xesha.
texts.g:d1e2b533:
KuMncedisi woMphathi uPark,
Intlanganiso ebisemiselwe ngomso ilibaziselwe ngokungenakuphepheka kwangoLwesihlanu.
Ndiyaxolisa ngokungathandeki okubangelwe kutshintsho olukhawulezileyo.
Ishedyuli entsha: ngoLwesihlanu, ngentsimbi yeshumi kusasa, kwiGumbi lentlanganiso B.
texts.g:e8018514: Intlanganiso yangomso kusasa irhoxisiwe ngenxa yeemeko zecandelo.
texts.g:ae464506: Umntu oyinkokheli ukohambo lwebhizinisi, ngoko kufuneka silibazise udliwano-ndlebe lide libe ngenyanga ezayo.
texts.g:7750577b: Umhla wokugqibela wandiswe ngosuku, ngoko kukho ithuba elincinci kwishedyuli yokungenisa.
texts.g:6604f20c:
KuMphathi uLee,
Ukutyelelwa kwomthengi esikumisele ngoLwesibini olulandelayo kulungisiwe.
Umntu oqhagamshelana nomthengi unohambo lwebhizinisi ngoLwesibini, ngoko ucebise ngoLwesine kusasa.
Ukuba oko kulungile kuwe, ndiza kukuqinisekisa ngentsimbi yeshumi ngoLwesine kusasa.
Nceda undazise ukuba kuyasebenza ngokuhlwa kwangoLwesithathu kusasa.
Choi Ha-neul
texts.n:k.k9.biz_stats:statVerb: Izenzo zotshintsho ziyahluka ngokutshintsha kwesenzo: amanani atshintsha ngokwawo asebenzisa izenzo ezingaphumiyo, ngoxa abantu abangela utshintsho basebenzisa ezo zinqumlayo.
texts.n:k.k9.biz_stats:statPart: Uthelekiso notshintsho oluvela-ukuya lufuna izixhumanisi ezifanelekileyo, kwaye amaphesenti apha ngesandi sesikhamiso xa kukhethwa isixhumanisi.
texts.s:3416ab6d: Ubhekisa umfundi wakho kwitheyibhile kwingxelo ebhaliweyo.
texts.g:2a5b0638: Nceda ubhekisele kwizixhobo ezincanyathelisiweyo ngeenkcukacha zeestatistiki.
texts.g:b7af638b: Intengiso kwikota yesithathu kulo nyaka inyuke nge-12 lepesenti xa kuthelekiswa nexesha elifanayo kunyaka odlulileyo.
texts.g:3bc5f7cb: Abathengi abatsha behle nge-5 lepesenti xa kuthelekiswa nenyanga edlulileyo.
texts.g:c771b74d: Isabelo semarike senyuke ukusuka kwi-20 lepesenti ukuya kwi-25 lepesenti.
texts.g:a51be2d2: Ukuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kusendleleni yokukhula okuzinzileyo.
texts.g:e0ae3175: Ixabiso eliphakathi lisenqanaba elifanayo nonyaka odlulileyo.
texts.g:636aab76: Kolu phando, ama-60 lepesenti abaphendulayo anelisekile yimveliso.
texts.g:5299398e: Ndishwankathele utshintsho kwinani lentengiso yenyanga ngenyanga kwigrafu.
texts.g:276c0fe6: Inzuzo yokusebenza yehle kakhulu ngenxa yokunyuka kweendleko.
texts.g:882fbd6c: Ukuba oku kuqhubeka, silindele ukukwazi ukufikelela kwinjongo yalo nyaka.
texts.g:5d8bc83d:
A: Intengiso yekota yoku injani?
B: Inyuke nge-8 lepesenti kunekota edlulileyo kwaye sifikelele kwinjongo.
A: Yeyiphi imveliso ethengiswe kakhulu?
B: Imveliso entsha A ibalwe nge-40 lepesenti yentengiso yonke.
texts.g:e5e33509:
Ixabiso lokuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kwisiqingatha sokuqala salo nyaka linyuke nge-15 lepesenti xa kuthelekiswa nexesha elifanayo kunyaka odlulileyo.
Ngokukodwa, ukukhula kwakubonakala kakhulu kwimarike yaseMzantsi-mpuma weAsia.
Kwelinye icala, imarike yaseYurophu yehle kancinane.
texts.g:48c2687c: Ngokophando, ngaphezu kwesiqingatha sabasebenzi sasixhasa ukwandiswa komsebenzi ekude.
texts.g:3359bae0: Ukusebenzisa ithuba lokuhla kwesabelo semarike somkhuphisi, intengiso yemveliso yethu ikhule ngokukhawuleza.
texts.g:7c881836: Ngenxa yokuba isampuli incinci, kunzima ukusebenzisa esi siphumo ngqo kubo bonke abathengi.
texts.g:af4db1d1: Kwingxelo, ungabeki nje amanani; yitolike nentsingiselo yawo.
texts.g:b6b6f2d4: Ixabiso lokuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kwenyanga edlulileyo linyuke kancinane xa kuthelekiswa nenyanga enye kunyaka odlulileyo, kodwa umgangatho wokukhula wehle.
texts.g:9454f6f5: Inkampani yenze uphando lwenani yabadlali benkxaso yevenkile ye-intanethi nyaka nyaka. Abadlali bakhula rhoqo ukususela ngoJanuwari ukuya kuMatshi kodwa bawa okokuqala ngo-Epreli. Umntu onoxanduva uhlalutye ukuba izikhalazo ezandayo ngokulibaziseka kokuhanjiswa ngoyena nobangela. Ngoko inkampani yagqiba kwelokuba iqale ngokufumana indlela yokunciphisa ixesha lokuhanjiswa.
texts.g:f7c5d0c2: Ingxelo yophando lokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ukwaneliseka kwalo nyaka kwakuyi-78 amanqaku, amanqaku ama-4 angaphezulu kwama-74 onyaka ophelileyo. Noko ke, kulo nyaka indlela yokufumana abaphenduli itshintshiwe isuka kumnxeba iye ku-intanethi, kwaye isabelo sabantu abakwiminyaka yama-20 nama-30 phakathi kwabaphenduli be-intanethi saphindwa kabini kunonyaka ophelileyo. Eli qela leminyaka lelinye elanike amanqaku aphezulu kunomndilili nakwiingxelo zangaphambili. Ngoko ke, kunzima ukugweba ngedatha yangoku ukuba ukunyuka kungummiselo wohlaziyo lwenyani lwenkonzo kangakanani. Siyacebisa ukuba uphando olulandelayo luthelekise kunye nezabelo zeminyaka ezifanayo nezonyaka ophelileyo.
texts.g:e13c0f5b: Uluvo lohlolo ngeziphumo zenkqubo yenkxaso yamashishini amancinci asekuhlaleni. Umndilili wentengiso yenyanga yamashishini angamashumi amathathu axhaswayo unyuke nge-18 pesenti xa kuthelekiswa nangaphambi kokuba inkqubo iqale. Kodwa ukuba sijonga ishishini ngalinye, amashishini amabini abone intengiso inyuka ngaphezu kwamaxesha amathathu kwaye amashumi amabini anamnye ehle kancinane. Ukukhupha la mabini, umndilili wesantya sokunyuka wehla kakhulu. Isebe elinoxanduva lwenkqubo lagqiba ngelokuba iphumelele ngokubanzi, kodwa ngokweenkcukacha ezingasentla, ubungqina obuxhasa eso sigqibo abusonelanga.
texts.g:700e4ddd: Ingxelo yokhuseleko lwendlela kwindawo yolawulo. Iingozi zendlela zalo nyaka zazingama-1,200, zinyuke nge-6 pesenti kunonyaka ophelileyo, kodwa inani lezithuthi ezibhalisiweyo ngexesha elifanayo linyuke nge-11 pesenti. Xa kuguqulelwa kwiingozi ngezithuthi ezili-10,000, ngokwenene ziyehle. Noko ke, ukufa kusezingeni elifanayo nonyaka ophelileyo, ngoko kunzima ukuthi impembelelo yenqanaba eliphantsi leengozi ifikelele ekuhleni kweengozi ezinzulu. Ingxelo icebisa ukutolika izalathisi zenani nezobukhulu beengozi ngokwahlukeneyo.
texts.g:901fbaeb: Ngokwengxelo yeziko lophando, kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo kwavela inkambiso yokuba inqanaba lolwaphulo-mthetho lolutsha lehle kwizixeko nakumabhunga ezithili apho iilayibrari ziye zanda. Kodwa ingxelo ayigqibi ngelokuba oku kuyimpembelelo yokwandiswa kweelayibrari, kwaye ikhankanya nokuba zozibini ezi zinto ziguquguqukayo zinokuba nento yokwenza nemeko yezimali yengingqi. Oku kungenxa yokuba iingingqi ezinezimali ezaneleyo zandise hayi nje iilayibrari kodwa neenkqubo zasemva kwesikolo. Iziko longeze ngelokuba ukuqinisekisa impembelelo ezimeleyo yokwandiswa kweelayibrari, iingingqi ezinemeko yezimali efanayo kufuneka zithelekiswe omnye nomnye.
texts.g:3ca56d36: Iziphumo zophando lweembono zabemi ziyashwankathelwa. Kwiprojekthi ekuthethwa ngayo, inkxaso yayiyi-62 pesenti, ukuchasa yayiyi-31 pesenti, ukungaphenduli yayiyi-7 pesenti. Noko ke, izinga lokuphendula lalingu-4 pesenti kuphela, kwaye abaphenduli abaneminyaka engama-65 okanye ngaphezulu, abangama-52 pesenti, bagqwesa kakhulu isabelo sabo sokwenene sabemi esingama-24 pesenti. Iqela lophando liphinde latyhila amanani alungisiweyo ukuze izabelo zeminyaka zihambelane nokwakheka kwabemi kwenene; emva kolungiso, inkxaso yehla yaya kwi-54 pesenti kodwa yayisaphezulu kunokuchasa. Iqela lathi isalathiso sokuba inkxaso iphambili siyagcinwa, kodwa umahluko kufuneka utolikwe njengomncinci kunamanani okuqala.
texts.g:98ee0f8a: Ingxelo yeziphumo zokusebenza zekota yesithathu. Ingeniso ecocekileyo yayiyi-12 yeebhiliyoni zewon, inyuke malunga ne-35 pesenti kunexesha elifanayo onyaka ophelileyo. Noko ke, i-2.5 yeebhiliyoni zewon yalo yingeniso yexeshana ngokuthengisa isiza esingasetyenziswayo. Ukuyikhupha, izinga lokukhula kwengeniso ecocekileyo lihlala kwizinga elingaphantsi kwe-10. Ngaphezu koko, ingeniso yokusebenza, ebonisa inzuzo evela kushishino oluphambili lokuthengisa iimveliso, yehle nge-2 pesenti. Iqela lezemali likugqiba ukuba ukutolika ukunyuka kwengeniso ecocekileyo njengophawu lokuba ishishini liyaphucuka kusasanda. Olu vavanyo luya kuphinda lujongwe emva kokuqinisekisa ukuba ngaba ulwakhiwo olufanayo luyaphinda kwikota elandelayo.
texts.g:67ee002c: Ingxelo yemigaqo yemarike yezindlu yenyanga. Ivolumu yentengiselwano yeeflethi yale nyanga kummandla wedolophu enkulu inyuke nge-3 yepesenti ukusuka kwinyanga edlulileyo, kodwa ngokujonga ukuhamba kweenyanga ezintathu zokugqibela iseluqeshweni ngokubanzi. Isalathisi samaxabiso senyuke nge-0.2 yepesenti kuphela, enokubonwa njengotshintsho phakathi kwemida yempazamo. Okwangoku, kukho iingxelo ezisuka kushishino lwabarhwebi ukuba imibuzo yanda emva kokunciphisa izinga lenzala yemali-mboleko, kodwa oku akukaqinisekiswa kwiinkcukacha-manani zentengiselwano. Ngoko ingxelo ithatha isikhundla sokuba kusenyanga kakhulu ukugweba ukuba imarike ingene kwinqanaba lokuphila.
texts.g:e7f9a5a1: Iziko lophando liphande abasebenzi beofisi abangu-1,200: abaphenduli abasebenza ekhaya ubuncinane kabini ngeveki baxele ukwaneliseka okumndilili komsebenzi okungama-78, okuphezulu kunama-65 abasebenzi beofisi. Ngokusekelwe koku iziko labhengeza ukuba ukusebenza kude kunyusa imveliso. Kodwa uphando lubuze kuphela ukwaneliseka okuzizingelayo kwaye alizange liyilinganise impumelelo yokwenyani. Ngaphezu koko, abathatha inxaxheba kusebenzo lukude bagxile kakhulu kwimisebenzi enenkululeko enkulu, ngoko kunzima ukuthi ingaba umahluko wokwaneliseka uvela kwindlela yokusebenza okanye kwimvelo yemisebenzi. Ngoko ezi ziphumo zodwa azonelanga ukufikelela esiphelweni sokuba ukusebenza kude kunyusa imveliso.
texts.g:9d18f689: Umlinganiselo weendleko zendlu kwingeniso kuwo onke amakhaya umndilili ungama-22 epesenti, inqanaba elifanayo nasemva kweminyaka emihlanu. Abanye bathatha oku njengesizathu sokuthi umthwalo wendlu awutshintshanga. Nangona kunjalo, umlinganiselo wamakhaya anengeniso ephantsi kakhulu angama-20 epesenti unyuke ukusuka kuma-31 ukuya kuma-38 epesenti, ngelixa lawo angama-20 epesenti aphezulu wehle ukusuka kuma-15 ukuya kuma-12 epesenti. Ukunyuka kwelinye icala nokwehla kwelinye kuye kwalingana, kwaye umndilili umane wahlala unjalo. Umndilili usixelela ukuba liphi iziko lonke kodwa awubonisi utshintsho olwenzeke phakathi kwamaqela. Ngoko akufuneki simeme esiphelweni sokuba umthwalo wawo onke amakhaya ufana kuphela ngenxa yokuba umndilili ufana.
texts.g:36c84153: Kunyaka wayo wokuqala, ilayibrari entsha evuliweyo iHansol ibine-40 lepesenti zabadwelisi abaninzi kunonyaka odlulileyo, kwaye isixeko sagweba ukuba inkcubeko yokufunda yabemi isasazekile. Kodwa ngelo xesha, iincwadi ezibolekiweyo zenyuke ngamaphesenti ama-3 kuphela. Kuphando lwabasebenzisi, uninzi lwathi beze kufunda egumbini lokufunda. Inani labadwelisi linokuba sisalathisi esibonisa ukufikeleleka nokukhululeka kwesixhobo, kodwa alimeli ngqo isixa sokufunda. Ukuthetha ngokusasazeka kwenkcubeko yokufunda, ezinye izalathisi ezinje ngenani leencwadi ezibolekiweyo okanye ixesha lokufunda kufuneka ziboniswe kunye.
texts.g:877e9eb2: Ukonyuka kwamaxabiso abathengi kulo nyaka kwaba ngama-2.1 lepesenti ngokusemthethweni, kodwa abemi abaninzi baziva ukuba iindleko zokuphila zonyuke kakhulu kunoko. Ngenxa yolu khenketho, kuvela uxwebhu lokuba izibalo ziphazamisa inyani. Noko ke, isalathisi samaxabiso sisixa esibalwa ngokumisela ubunzima beempahla ngokweqhekeko lenkcitho yekhaya eliqhelekileyo. Kunyaka apho amaxabiso okutya enyuka ngama-5 lepesenti, umgangatho oziviwa ngamakhaya anengeniso ephantsi achitha kakhulu kukutya kufuneka ube ngaphezulu kwesiqhelekileyo. Ekugqibeleni, ukungafani phakathi kwenani elisemthethweni nokuziviwa ngabantu akuvelisi ngenxa yokuba ukubala kuphosakele kodwa kuba inani elinye alinakumela lonke ikhaya.
texts.g:70fd5ba4: Intengiso yesiselo esitsha yenyuke nge-20 lepesenti kwiinyanga ezintathu emva kokuqala kwentengiso ngoJuni xa kuthelekiswa neenyanga ezintathu zangaphambili. Iqela lentengiso lazisa eli graph njengobungqina bempembelelo yentengiso. Noko ke, esi siselo yimveliso ekhwela imfuno ehlotyeni, kwaye nakunyaka odlulileyo, ngaphandle kwentengiso, intengiso yenyuke nge-18 lepesenti ngexesha elifanayo. Ukuthatha oku ngokuthelekisa, ukonyuka okubangelwa yintengiso kungama-2 amanqaku eepesenti ubuninzi. Nangona kunjalo, imozulu neemveliso ezikhuphisanayo zinokuba zahlukile phakathi konyaka odlulileyo nalo nyaka, ngoko nesi sixa kunzima ukuthathwa njengempembelelo eqinisekisiweyo.
texts.g:6a73ec88: Xa inkonzo yokuthenga kwi-intanethi yaqhuba uphando lokwaneliseka kwabathengi, ama-35 lepesenti abaphendulayo akhetha 'andanelisekanga kakhulu.' Abanye abalawuli bacinga ukuba kuvele ingxaki enzulu kwinkonzo. Kodwa inqanaba lokuphendula lophando belisengama-12 lepesenti kuphela, kwaye abathengi abanezikhalazo bahlala bephendula ngokuzimisela ngakumbi kuphando. Ngoko ke inani lama-35 lepesenti alinakufundwa njengovavanyo lwabo bonke abathengi. Oko akuthethi ukuba olu lwazi alunaluncedo, noko. Izizathu zokunganeliseki ezibhalwe ngabaphendulayo zinokuba yimikhondo ebonisa ukuba ngawaphi amacandelo afuneka aphuculwe kuqala.
texts.g:70ffd4cd: Isilinganiselo samanqaku abafundi abagqitha isidlo sakusasa sasingaphantsi ngamanqaku ama-6 kunabo bakutyayo. Esi siphumo sibhekiswa rhoqo njengesizathu sengxelo yokuba ukutya isidlo sakusasa kunyusa impumelelo yezemfundo. Kodwa xa kuthelekiswa abafundi kuphela abasuka kwiikhaya ezinemivuzo efanayo, ikhefu lamanqaku lancipha laya kwi-1.5. Kungenxa yokuba abafundi abasuka kwiintsapho ezinemivuzo ephantsi banokugqitha isidlo sakusasa kwaye ngokufuthi baneemeko zokufunda ezingamandla. Olu hlalutyo aluthethi ukuba isidlo sakusasa asinamphumo kwaphela, kodwa lubonisa ngokucacileyo ukuba inxalenye enkulu yekhefu elibonwe ekuqaleni lichazwa ngezinye izinto.
texts.g:844ee22d: Kuncinci isampulu, kukhulu ukwenza iphutha kwiziphumo.
texts.g:d839f44d: Phantse isiqingatha sabaphenduli baphendule ukuba bayixabisa ikhwalithi ngaphezu kwexabiso.
texts.g:6fee16d1: Nangona umvuzo wanda, izinga lokonga lavela ukuba lehle kunoko.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revHon: Uphononongo: -(으)시- ihlonipha omnye umntu, izenzi zokuthobeka ze--드리- zichaza izenzo zakho ezibhekise kuye, kwaye -(스)ㅂ니다 igcina ithoni isesikweni.
texts.n:k.k9.review_k9:revVocab: Uphononongo: amabizo eshishini aseKorea asuka kwisiTshayina adla ngokubonakala efana, ngoko khetha ngentsingiselo nangesenzi abadityaniswa naso.
texts.s:a122a17d: Umntu ucela ixesha lentlanganiso kwaye kufuneka ujonge ikhalenda yakho.
texts.s:0a04257f: Awuzange ulandele inkcazelo kwaye ucela ngembeko ukuba iphindwe.
texts.s:518a3c4f: Umsebenzi mnye ukuncede ukugqiba umsebenzi wakho.
texts.g:041dba0a: Ndiza kuyithumela kuwe ngaphambi kokuphela kosuku lwanamhlanje.
texts.s:041dba0a: Uthembisa umthengi ukuhambisa uxwebhu ngaphambi kokuphela kosuku.
texts.s:c90c163d: Uvumela undwendwe ngembeko ukuba luqale ukuthetha kwintlanganiso.
texts.g:3f33725f: Ingxelo yohambo lweshishini kufuneka ingeniswe ngaphakathi kweveki emva kokubuya.
texts.g:eb27f927: Ndiza kuqhubeka nalo mcimbi emva kokufumana imvume yomphathi wesebe.
texts.g:9fa71d57: Umsebenzi endiphethe ngawo kukulawula iiakhawunti zabathengi.
texts.g:d5e564ff: Ndinomsebenzi omninzi kule veki, ngoko ndicinga ukuba kuza kufuneka ndisebenze ngaphezu kwexesha.
texts.g:263851c9: Unokundifumana ngemesenjala nangeli xesha ndisebenza ekhaya.
texts.g:81c8a6b9: Kuvele into ekhawulezileyo, ngoko andiqondi ukuba ndingakwazi ukuya kwintlanganiso.
texts.g:21439490: Ndiza kuqhagamshelana nawe emva kokuxela kumphathi wecandelo.
texts.g:7a1064f6: Intengiso yekota yoku yedlule ekujoliswe kuko ngamaphesenti ali-10.
texts.g:270a0a19: Nceda uphinde uhlole iimeko phambi kokusayina isivumelwano.
texts.g:93802476: Imveliso entsha yamkelwe kakuhle, ngoko imiyalelo iphindaphindwe kabini.
texts.g:c167797b:
A: Mncedisi woMphathi, ungawujonga umsebenzi wohambo lwebhizinisi lwangomso?
B: Ewe, uya eBusan ngenqwelomoya ngentsimbi yethoba kusasa.
A: Intlanganiso nomthengi ngeyiphi ixesha?
B: Ngentsimbi yesibini emva kwemini, kwaye ndikuthumelele izixhobo zentlanganiso ngeimeyile.
texts.g:6a8b5faa:
KuMphathi weCandelo uLee,
Ndicela imvume yakho.
Ndincamathisele isivumelwano nomthengi omtsha, ngoko nceda usijonge.
Ndiza kuvuya ukuba ungaphendula ngaphakathi kwanamhlanje.
texts.n:k.k10.culture_deep:habitual: Izithethe zichazwa ngezenzo zexesha langoku kwizinto ezenziwa rhoqo ngabantu, rhoqo kunye neebizo zesiko okanye isithethe.
texts.g:c0eaaee5: Umntu one-nunchi ekhawulezayo uziva imeko yomnye umntu nokuba akaxelelwanga.
texts.g:99095a49: AmaKorea abeka ixabiso elikhulu ekugcineni udumo phambi kwabanye.
texts.g:fa697d7b: Ngomhla woNyaka oMtsha weNyanga, abantu bayaqubuda kwabadala babo baze bafumane izipho zemali.
texts.g:29a6105a: Abantu bathi uyafumana unyaka wobudala ngokutya isuphu yekeyiki yerayisi ekuseni koNyaka oMtsha.
texts.g:54990d5f: Ngexesha leChuseok, abantu batyelela amangcwaba eentsika zabo.
texts.g:e756c6e1: Kukho isiko lokutya isuphu yolwandle ekuseni kosuku lokuzalwa.
texts.g:eaacf306: Kusuku lokuqala lokuzalwa komntwana, kuqhutyelwa umsitho kwaye umntwana ukhetha into etafileni.
texts.g:bf6ebf5d: Phambi kokufika kobusika, abamelwane bahlangana benze i-kimchi kunye.
texts.g:73b15dba: Xa uya emtshatweni, kububuhle ukunika isipho semali sokuncoma.
texts.g:c87cda76: Xa uya emingcwabeni, abantu banikela imali yokuthuthuzela baze bakhale ngokuzola.
texts.g:fb00f0a7: Emva kokufudukela kwikhaya elitsha, abantu bamema abahlobo kumcimbi wekhaya elitsha.
texts.g:867b21b6: Abantu bakhulula izihlangu xa bengena ekhayeni.
texts.g:79b030c5: Xa usela nomdala, kububuhle ukujika intloko yakho uthe xa usela.
texts.g:587ded32: Xa unika into umdala, umntu usebenzisa zozibini izandla.
texts.g:16c17ab1: Ukubuza ubudala bomntu ongamaziyo yindlela yokuvumelana ngezihloko kunye nesimbo sentetho.
texts.g:2b01b8d4: KwisiKorea, abantu bahlala bethi 'yethu' nakwizinto ezinje ngekhaya 'lam' okanye umama 'wam'.
texts.g:b2e9b57e: I-Ondol yinkqubo yesiko yokufudumeza efudumeza umgangatho.
texts.g:9f8f16af: I-Hanbok yaphathwa ngemihla ekhethekileyo enje ngemiqondiso nemitshato.
texts.g:65461830: Abantu babekholelwa ukuba ukutya i-red bean porridge ngexesha lokuphela kobusika kugcina ishwa libi kude.
texts.g:abde95a2: Ngezona ntsuku zishushu zehlobo, abantu batya isuphu yenkukhu ye-ginseng ukubuyisa amandla.
texts.g:d7b6477c: Ngenyanga epheleleyo yokuqala yonyaka, abantu baqhekeza amandongomane baze banqwenele unyaka ophilileyo.
texts.g:d002b1c5: Ngosuku loviwo lokungena eyunivesithi, amaxesha okuqala omsebenzi ayabuyiselwa umva kwaye wonke umntu ukhuthaza abo bavivinywayo.
texts.g:74455bff: EKorea, ethanda ukuthembeka kwabazali, kwakukho iindlu ezininzi ezazihlala kwaye zinakekela abazali bazo.
texts.g:7b9ccd1a: I-Pumasi sisithethe sokunikezelana ngesandla emsebenzini kunye nokubuyisa ububele.
texts.g:bfb397ed: Kwimihla emikhulu, iintsapho ziyahlangana ziqhube izithethe zesikhumbuzo seentsika.
texts.g:0476afea: Ngosuku lweHangul, abantu bayakhumbula ukwenziwa kwealfabhethi yesiKorea nguKumkani uSejong.
texts.g:20538219: Kwi-jjimjilbang, abantu bayajuluka baze bachithe ixesha neentsapho nabahlobo.
texts.g:fa5bf7ca: Ekutyeni, uqala ukutya emva kokuba umntu omdala ethabathe icephe neentonga zakhe.
texts.g:9512d04e: EKorea, inkcubeko ye-'jeong' yokwabelana ngokutya nabamelwane iqhubekile ixesha elide.
texts.g:09d4434e: Kukho uhlalutyo lokuba inkcubeko ye-'ppalli-ppalli' yaseKorea yasekwa ngexesha lokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwezoqoqosho.
texts.g:4a7216bf: Ukusebenzisa intetho yembeko neyamahlelo ngokwahlukileyo yimikhwa yolwimi ebonisa ubudlelwane bakho nomnye umntu.
texts.g:dbdd19d8: EKorea, abantu bahlala bebizwa ngesihloko somsebenzi okanye ngobudlelwane obunjengo-'umama ka-so-and-so' endaweni yegama.
texts.g:203bdce4: Ukwala ukutya ukutya okunikwa ngumntu kanye okanye kabini kunokuthi ngamanye amaxesha kuvele ekunqwenelweni kokuhloniphisa.
texts.g:74724f36: Inkcubeko yemihla yeholide yaseKorea iyatshintsha kancinane. Kwixesha elidlulileyo, intsapho namahlobo ahlanganisana endlini enye kwaye achitha iintsuku enza ukutya aze aqhube izithethe zeentsika. Ngoku ke, iindlu ezininzi zilungiselela iitafile ezilula okanye ziyahamba kwiihambo. Nanjengoko ubume butshintsha, intsingiselo yokuchitha ixesha kunye nokujonga omnye komnye isakhathalelwa kubaluleke.
texts.g:4e23238d: Ilifa lenkcubeko elingabonakaliyo libhekisa kwimpahla nezakhono ezidluliselwe ngamalungu oluntu ngokwezizukulwana.
texts.g:fe5e1e70: Nokuba ubume bayo butshintsha ngexesha, isithethe sesiko sigcina umsebenzi waso wokuqinisekisa iibhanti zoluntu.
texts.g:fae4710a: Iingoma zomthonyama ezidluliselwe kwingingqi nganye zibonisa ubomi nemvakalelo yabemi bayo.
texts.g:0942f6e7: Ukunciphisa ukungaqondani phakathi kweenkcubeko, sidinga isimilo sokungagwebi enye inkcubeko ngemigangatho yethu.
texts.g:7486b8d2: Ukuhlonipha ubunguntu benkcubeko babaphambukeli kuxoxwa njengemfuneko yokudityaniswa kwentlalo.
texts.g:afc76388: Namhlanje siza kujonga ukugcinwa kwe-hanok ngokwembono yomgaqo-nkqubo welifa lenkcubeko. I-hanok ayiyondawo yokuhlala nje kuphela kodwa yimveliso yenkcubeko apho imozulu nendlela yokuphila zixinene. Noko ke, ukuba umntu uyiguqula ngenxa yokulula kwanamhlanje, ulwakhiwo lwayo olukhethekileyo lunokonakaliswa. Ngoko ke, ukulinganisela phakathi kokugcina nokusebenzisa kuyingongoma ephambili.
texts.g:5eec1ae4: A: Kukho ukugxekwa ukuba imibhiyozo yengingqi iba ngeyorhwebo kakhulu. B: Ngenxa yokuba amanani abadwelisi asetyenziswa njengesalathisi sokusebenza, amabali engingqi akhethekileyo kule ndawo ayenzakele kwezinye iindlela. C: Ndibona ngenye indlela. Abahlali bangayigcina umbhiyozo uqhubeka kuphela ukuba kukho ingeniso, ngoko kunzima ukuchasa ukurhweba ngokwako. Okubalulekileyo kukwakha ulwakhiwo apho ingeniso ibuyela koluntu lwengingqi.
texts.g:83f2d8a3: Isiseko sibhengeza iziphumo zokukhethwa kwenkqubo yaso yenkxaso yokugcina ubugcisa besiko ngolu hlobo. Kulo nyaka amaqela asixhenxe kwamashumi amathathu afake izicelo akhethiwe, kwaye uphononongo lugxile kwithuba lokudlulisa izakhono kunye nokunxulumana noluntu lwengingqi. Amaqela angakhethwanga aya kunikwa izimvo zophononongo ngokubhala.
texts.g:acba7a7b: A: Kukho inkxalabo enkulu yokuba iilwimi zesintu ziyanyamalala. Ucinga ukuba sisiphi isizathu? B: Kungenxa yokuba ulwimi oluyiyo lusasazeke kakhulu ngezixhobo zendaba nemfundo, nokuba ulutsha olufudukela ezixekweni lunciphise amathuba okusebenzisa ulwimi lwesintu. A: Yintoni ekufuneka yenziwe ukugcina iilwimi zesintu? B: Endaweni yokuphela ekurekhodeni, kufuneka zinxulunyaniswe nemfundo yengingqi ukuze zisetyenziswe ngokwenene ebomini bemihla ngemihla.
texts.g:001b4b52: Isihloko sentetho yanamhlanje ngendlela yokuphatha imeko yenkcubeko kuguqulelo. Inguqulelo ethe ngqo inenzuzo yokunyaniseka kokuqala, kodwa inokushiya iintsingiselo ezibonakala zimangalisa kubafundi. Ngokuchaseneyo, inguqulelo yenkululeko ilula ukuyifunda, kodwa kukho ingozi yokuba umlinganiswa woqobo uyasuswa. Siza kuthelekisa amandla nobuthathaka beendlela ezimbini ngemizekelo.
texts.g:fedf0417: A: Kukho ingxoxo enkulu ngesiko lokubuza ubudala kuqala xa abantu bedibana. Ukubona njani? B: Kuba isiKorean sitshintsha iimilo zokubiza nesimbo sentetho ngokuxhomekeke komnye umntu, ndibona ukubuza ubudala njengenkqubo esebenzayo yokumisela isakhelo sencoko. C: Ndiyayamkela loo mpawu, kodwa akukhokeleli kwisakhiwo apho icala elidala likhokela incoko liqina? B: Andiyiphiki ukuba bukho obo buthathaka. Kodwa leso sisiphumo esenziwe sisiko, hayi isizathu sokuvela kwesiko. Ukuba inkqubo yokubiza itshintsha, umbuzo uya kuncipha ngokwemvelo.
texts.g:fcb8250f: A: Sinokuchaza njani inkcubeko yokutshintshiselana ngezipho zeeholide nokuqinisekisa ukuzibuyisela? B: Ndiyibona njengophawu lokuthenjwa kwexesha elide. Inqwenelo yokubuyisela oko kufunyenweyo iba yintambo egcina ubudlelwane buqhubeka. C: Kodwa ukuba abantu bazama ukubuyisela ngqo oko bakufumeneyo, akufani ngokwenyani nentengiselwano? B: Ngaphandle kunokubonakala njalo. Kodwa ukuba yayiyintengiselwano, ubudlelwane buya kuphela ngokukhawuleza xa ixabiso lihlawulwe. Ukongeza ngabom into encinci kwisipho sokubuyisela ukuze kuhlale ityala kuthetha ukuba umntu akanayo injongo yokuphelisa ubudlelwane. Andiyiphiki ukuba ukubala kukho. Kuphela injongo yoko kubala kukuqhubeka, hayi ukulungisa iiakhawunti.
texts.g:46ef3493: A: Abanye bagxeka i-hanbok yemihla ngemihla, eguqulwe ukuze inxitywe ebomini bemihla ngemihla, ngokonakalisa isiko. C: Ndicinga ukuba ukuba isakhiwo, esinjengomlinganiselo wejacket nesikhaphu nokusetyenziswa kweentambo zeribhoni, singagcinwa, kunzima ukuyibiza ngokuthi yi-hanbok. B: Ndiyavuma ukuba isakhiwo esisiseko sifanele sihlonitshwe. Kodwa ukuba siyanyanzelisa ifom endala nakwizinto zokwenza, ubude nendlela yokubopha, kunokungabikho namnye ukunxiba. C: Uthetha ukuba ukuba akukho namnye unxibayo, isiko liyanqunyulwa. B: Ewe. Isinxibo esibekwe kwimyuziyam nesinxibo esinxitywa ngabantu zigcinwa ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. Ndicinga ukuba eyokugqibela ihlala ixesha elide.
texts.g:8a212118: A: Amakhaya ahlala nabazali ayehlile; ngaba ukuqonda kokuhlonipha abazali kuyaphela? B: Ndicinga ukuba akuthotywanga kangako kodwa kuguqule imilo yokuvakalisa. Nokuba abantu abahlali kunye, ukuhlonipha abazali kuyaqhubeka ngokwabelana ngeebhili zesibhedlele nokugcina unxibelelwano rhoqo. C: Loo ntolikho ibeka ukuba usapho luqhubeka lunoxanduva lokunyamekela. Alingengo lona lo mfanekiso lingxaki? B: Umbuzo ngokwawo uyavumeleka. Kodwa de inkqubo inike inkxaso eneleyo, loo mfanekiso awunakucinywa ngobusuku obunye. Emva kokuba inkqubo ikho kuphela sinokuthetha ngokuhlonipha abazali njengokhetho kunokuba ngumthwalo.
texts.g:7a77c58f: A: Inani lamakhaya enza i-kimchi ngokwawo liyehla. Ngaba inkcubeko yokwenza i-kimchi iyanyamalala? B: Kunzima ukugweba ngenani lamakhaya awenza yodwa. Nokuba abantu bayithenga, ukuba isiko lokwabelana nabamelwane nokubuza ngabo lihlala, inkcubeko iyaqhubeka. C: Kodwa ukuba inkqubo yokuhlangana ukusebenza kunye iyanyamalala, ukwabelana loo nako akunakuhlala ixesha elide? B: Loo nkxalabo ineneno. Kungenxa yoko iziko lethu likhuthaza ukurekhoda nokuxhasa isiko lokuhlangana nokwabelana, kunokuba lingaphezulu incasa ye-kimchi.
texts.g:bc4d2c30: A: Bathi ukulibazisa amaxesha okuqala komsebenzi nokulungisa ukuhla nokunyuka kweenqwelomoya ngosuku lovavanyo kubonakala kungaqhelekanga kubantu bamanye amazwe. texts.g:8889d001: A: Kwimimandla ethile, kwenziwe inkqubo apho abantu batshintshiselana ngomsebenzi wabo, ubalwa ngeeyure. Ngaba inokubizwa ngokuba sisiqendu sanamhlanje se-pumasi? texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:academicConn: Impikiswano ebhaliweyo esemthethweni isebenzisa iintetho ezimiselweyo zokudibanisa nezokuvuma ezineziphelo ekufuneka zihambelane nesivakalisi ezidibanisa sona.
texts.n:k.k10.logic_debate:causeLink: Izidibanisi ezifana 이에 따라 kunye 결과적으로 zidibanisa umphumo nesizathu esikhutshiweyo, ngoko isivakalisi esandulelayo kufuneka sinike eso sizathu.

texts.g:4a61030a: Abanye abantu bayakhathazeka ukuba imfundo yesiNgesi yangethuba iyaphazamisa ukukhula kolwimi lweenkobe. texts.g:6001b679: Le ngxelo ivavanya ukuba inkqubo yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali eneenxaxheba zabemi iphakamise ukungafihli kwemali. texts.g:5083f824: Abanye bathi ukuvalwa kweestrowu zeplastiki kuya kuba nempembelelo encinci kuba iistrowu zenza inxalenye encinci yenkunkuma yonke yeplastiki. Ukujonga amanani kuphela, oko akunjalo. Ukuba ngubani owamisela isiseko sokuthelekisa, nangayiphi inkqubo, akazange kwenziwe ukuba kwaziwe. Isixeko siceba ukubeka umgaqo wokugqibela kwangoko kwinyanga ezayo. Iqela labasebenzisi liqalile ukhuphiswano lokusayina ukuchasa ukuvalwa.
texts.g:798f379b: Ingxoxo yokuba ukhathalelo lwezonyango oluqhelekileyo kufuneka luvunyelwe ngokupheleleyo ifumana ukuqinisekisa ngokukhethekileyo kwiingingqi apho amaziko ezonyango engaxineneyo. Nangona kunjalo, ingxoxo echasayo yokuba, kwizigulana zokuqala, ukuba nokuxilongwa ngempazamo kunzima ukukucima ngaphandle kovavanyo ngokubonakalayo asinakuthathwa ngokulula. Ekugqibeleni, umba owuphikisayo ubonakala ulele kancinane ekukhetheni phakathi kokuvumela okanye ukuthintela kunokuba ulele ekubeni ngoluphi unyango olunokuvunyelwa phantsi kweemeko ezithile. Lo mba ucwangciselwe ukuphathwa njengomba oyintloko kwiforam yokuphucula inkqubo yezonyango eza kubanjwa kunyaka.
texts.g:ef70cb2f: Intetho ethelekisa imbali nesipili iqhelekile. Kodwa isipili sibonisa kuphela oko kuphambi kwaso, kwaye asizicingeli ukuba kufuneka sibonise phi sigqume phi. Kwinkqubo apho imbali ibaliswa khona, ukhetho lokuba kuqoshelwe ntoni kwaye kushiywe ntoni lwenziwa kuqala. Isiganeko esifanayo sihlala njengemboniso eyahlukileyo ngokupheleleyo ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ngubani oyibhalayo nakweliphi ixesha. Kungenxa yokuba indlela imithombo ekhethwa ngayo nelungiselelwa ngayo yisiqalo sokutolika. Oko umfuziselo wesipili ungakuboniyo yisandla somntu obonisayo.
texts.g:245fcc4b: Zininzi izifundo ezibonisa ukuba ukuqinisa imida yesantya kunciphisa ukufa kwezithuthi. Nangona kunjalo, uninzi lwezi zifundo lujolise kwiicandelo apho kwafakwa nezikhamera zokunyanzelisa. Ukuba umphumo ofanayo uya kuvela kwiindawo ezingenakunyanzeliswa akukavavanywa. Inkxalabo yokuba umthetho oguqula kuphela inani lomda wesantya ungasilele ukuvelisa iziphumo ezilindelekileyo ivela kule nto. Lo mbuzo uphakanyiswe amaxesha amaninzi kwiingingqi ezinezindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ingxoxo yomthetho oyilwayo onxulumene nayo ngoku imisiwe.
texts.g:2b820a90: A: Kukho ingxelo yokuba ixesha lokulala elimndilili landa emva kokuphunyezwa kwilizwe elivala ngokusemthethweni ukufikelela kwimidlalo yebusuku kwabaselula. B: Loo ngxelo yalandela unyaka omnye kuphela emva komgaqo, yayiqinelwe kubafundi bedolophu enye, kwaye kukho nophando olwahlukileyo olubonisa ukuba ukujikelezwa kwanda. A: Ubukho bokujikelezwa abenzi ukuba umgaqo ube nentsingiselo. Nokuba abanye bayajikelezisa, ixesha lonxibelelwano ngokwalo lehlile. B: Andithi aluyintsingiselo; ndithi kufuneka sikhathalele ngakumbi ekuthetheni ngobungakanani bempembelelo.
texts.g:b25acd75: Inkampani ibhengeza ukuba umvuzo wayo ophakathi wabasebenzi ungomnye wabaphezulu kushishino. Noko ke, lo mndilili ubandakanya umvuzo wabalawuli abathathu. Inkampani iceba ukunciphisa isiqingatha sobungakanani bokuqesha abasebenzi abatsha kulo nyaka xa kuthelekiswa nonyaka odlulileyo. Umbutho wabasebenzi ubanga ukuba ukuba abalawuli bayasuswa kwaye ixabiso eliphakathi liyabalwa, inani liyehla nakumndilili weshishini. Kodwa inkampani ayiyichazanga indlela eyibale ngayo umndilili, kwaye ukubala kombutho nako akuzange kunikwe umthombo wedata. Ibinzana lentengiso lipapashwe nakwibhodi yeendaba yangaphakathi.
texts.g:ba65edb4: Kunzima ukufikelela kwisigqibo esiqinileyo ngempembelelo yomgaqo-nkqubo ngale ziphumo zodwa.
texts.g:89ee8852: Phambi kokugqiba ukuba inkqubo iyazisa na, uphando lweempembelelo ezisecaleni ezilindelekileyo kufuneka lufike kuqala.
texts.g:6170ca92: Ukuba oku kutolika kuyasebenza, kubonakala ngathi ithiyori esele ikho kuya kufuneka ihlaziywe.
texts.g:1cacfd4d: Ekubeni ubungakanani besampuli abwaneli, esi siphumo kufuneka samkelwe njengesethutyana.
texts.g:05b58da0: Kwabakho ulindelo lokuba, ukuba imigaqo iyathomalaliswa, ukungena kweenkampani ezintsha kuya kuba nzulu.
texts.g:b2b9a6fb: Ingxelo ekuthethwa ngayo ayizukwazi ukuphepha ukugxekwa ngokuba iyigqithisile iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo.
texts.g:c588c2f4: Le nto ibonwa ngokutolikwa njengesiphumo sezinto ezininzi ezisebenza ngokudibeneyo kunesizathu esinye.
texts.g:5e706eae: Ukuba umda wengxoxo uyandiswa, kukho inkxalabo yokuba umba ophambili unokubonakala unganyanisekanga.
texts.g:854277b6: Abanye abaphandi bayabanga ukuba ukusebenzisa imivuzo ephantsi eyahlukileyo ngengingqi kuya kuvuselela imisebenzi kumaphondo. Ukuba iindleko zomsebenzi ziyehla, iindawo ezincinci zomsebenzi zifumana amandla okuqesha abantu abaninzi, bathi. Le ngqiqo ayinasiseko ngokupheleleyo. Noko ke, ukuba umahluko wemivuzo uyanda, ulutsha lunokushiya ngakumbi kwingingqi yengxowa-mali, kwaye amandla omsebenzi wengingqi ngokwawo anokuncipha. Ukuba akukho mntu usele wokusebenza, imisebenzi eyongeziweyo nayo ayizukuzaliswa. Ngoko ke, ukusebenzisa ngokwahlukileyo kufanelekile ukuqwalaselwa kuphela xa kulungiswa amanyathelo agqibezelayo okuyeka ukuphuma kwabemi ngaxeshanye.
texts.g:b2bd772f: Iimeko ziyaqhubeka nokwenzeka apho iiarhente zolawulo, nasemva kokufumana isicelo senkululeko yolwazi, zibamba amaxwebhu zikhankanya ukhuseleko lolwazi lobuqu. Akukho mntu ongavumiyo ukuba ukukhusela ulwazi lobuqu lixabiso elibalulekileyo. Kodwa ukufihla ngokupheleleyo namaxwebhu anokukhutshwa ukuba kuphela iinkcukacha ezichaza umntu ezinjengamagama okanye iidilesi zazigqunyiwe kusondele ekubalekeleni uxanduva kunokukhusela. Ukungabikho kwesixa kufuneka kube ngumahluko, kwaye xa kusetyenziswa umahluko, iarhente kufuneka ibonise imfuneko. Ekugqibeleni, umba awukokuba kuvezwa okanye hayi, kodwa ukuba umntu kufuneka agqume kude kangakanani.
texts.g:e39bdff0: Emva kokuba iziko lophando libhengeze iziphumo zophando ezibonisa ukuba abafundi abagqitha isidlo sakusasa banamabanga aphantsi, kwasasazeka ibango lokuba isidlo sakusasa siphakamisa amabanga. Uphando luyiqinisekisa ukuba ezi zinto zimbini ziyahambisana. Kodwa ukuze oku kubalwe njengobungqina bokuba kubangela, impembelelo yezinye izinto ezinjengeemeko zosapho okanye ixesha lokulala kufuneka lishiywe. Olu phando alulawulanga ezi zinto. Ngoko ke, into ebonisa iziphumo kuphela unxulumano, kwaye ukwanelisa akukaneli njengesiseko sengcebiso yomgaqo-nkqubo ecebisa isidlo sakusasa.
texts.g:fc68b080: Umgaqo wokuba ifom yoqobo kufuneka igcinwe ngokupheleleyo xa kubuyiselwa ilifa lenkcubeko wamkelwe kakhulu. Ukukhathazeka kokuba ukuzalisa iindawo ezonakeleyo ngezixhobo ezintsha kuyazigqubuthela inyaniso yembali nako kunengqondo. Noko ke, ukuba umntu unyanzelisa ukugcinwa kokuqala kodwa angahoyi isakhiwo esiwayo, into ekufuneka ikhuselwe ngokwayo iyanyamalala. Ukuthembeka akuveli ekugcineni izixhobo ezindala kuphela kodwa nasekubeni ngokuphandle ukuba ngawaphi amacandelo abuyiselwe. Ngoko ke, kuyafuneka ukubuyisela ngokufanelekileyo nokurekhoda amacandelo abuyiselweyo ngokucacileyo.
texts.g:15ba669d: Urhulumente wengingqi ugqibe inkqubo yovavanyo yezibonelelo zendlu kwaye wabhengeza ukuba ukwaneliseka phakathi kwamakhaya aphumeleleyo kudlule kwi-90 lepesenti. Imvakalelo yokuba isibonelelo sinceda inentsingiselo ngokuqinisekileyo. Kodwa ukwaneliseka kubonisa kuphela umbulelo owaziviswa ngabaxhamli kwaye akulinganisi ngqo ukuba uzinzo lwendlu lwaphucuka ngokwenene. Ukubhengeza inkqubo ngempumelelo ngaphandle kwezalathisi ezizinzileyo ezinjengenani lokufuduka okanye amatyala erenti kusekwangethuba. Ukuba kwandiswe okanye hayi kunokugqitywa emva kokuqinisekiswa kwezo zalathisi, kwaye ngekungekho ngemva kwexesha.
texts.g:25fd318d: Inkqubo yokuphela kwexesha, enika imimiselo ixesha lokusebenza, ihlolwa njengesixhobo esithintela imimiselo engeyomfuneko ukuba ihlale ikho. Ukuba umgaqo uphela ngokuzenzekelayo ngomhla omiselweyo, icandelo elinoxanduva alinakhethi kodwa ukuphinda licinge ngemfuneko yawo. Noko ke, ukuba nemimiselo enxulumene nokhuseleko iphelisiwe ngokungacingisisiyo, kuvela izikhewu kwaye ingozi iwela kwabemi. Ukuze kuzaliseke injongo yenkqubo yokuphela kwexesha, ubunzima bohlolo lokwandiswa kufuneka bubonakale ngokuhambelana nohlobo lomgaqo kunokuba yonke imimiselo ijongwe ngomgangatho ofanayo.
texts.g:d78ca367: Kukho umbono wokuba iziphumo zeofisi yebhokisi ziqinisekisa ixabiso lomsebenzi. Inyani yokuba abantu abaninzi bayikhethile luphawu olungenakungahoywa. Noko ke, ekubeni inani lababukeli liphenjelelwa kubungakanani bentengiso nenani lezikrini, alinakuthi kwangoko libe sisilinganiso somgangatho wobugcisa. Kunoko, ukujonga ukuba abaphulaphuli baphendule njani phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo nokuba ingxoxo ihlala ixesha elide na kusondela kuvavanyo olunyanisekileyo ngakumbi. Ngoko ke, impumelelo yeofisi yebhokisi sisiqalo nje sovavanyo kwaye ayinakuba sisigqibo.

texts.g:8c8e1913: Ezinye iinxalenye ziphakamisa inkxalabo yokuba eli nyathelo linokongeza ngakumbi ekudidekeni kwemarike.
texts.g:b7a6d5ec: Kuphando lweziko lophando kubasebenzi beofisi abayi-1,000, ama-68 ekhulwini abaphenduli ababenamava okusebenza kude bathi ukwaneliseka kwabo emsebenzini kunyukile. texts.g:309b4d03:
[Isaziso] Ukulungiswa kwesixhobo selayibrari yedolophu
Ilayibrari yedolophu iza kuvala okwethutyana amagumbi okufunda iiveki ezimbini, ukusukela ngoMatshi 4 ukuya kuMatshi 17, ngenxa yomsebenzi wokulungisa isixhobo. Ngexesha elifanayo, ukuboleka nokubuyisa iincwadi kuyaqhubeka njengesiqhelo kwidesika yolwazi yenhla. Sicela ukuqondwa ngenxa yokungathandeki okubangelwa yingxolo yokwakha.
texts.g:bfc7a9a5: Kutshanje, ubizo lwabahlali lokwenza iindawo zeenja kuphela kwiipaki zasezidolophini luyakhula. Iofisi yesithili igqibe ekubeni imise iindawo ezimbini zovavanyo kule nyaka kwaye igqibe ngokwandiswa emva kokuhlola iimeko zokophula imigaqo nenani lezikhalazo. Noko ke, abanye abahlali bavakalisa ukuchasana, bekhankanya ingxaki yengxolo nococeko.
texts.g:3e0d9d66: Kutshanje ezinye ulawulo lwengingqi luvuthulwane ekubhengezeni ukuba lungakanani indawo yepaki yesixeko eyenzayo. Kodwa indawo yepaki ayithethi ngokwayo ukuphila okungcono kwabemi. Nokuba iindawo ezinkulu eziluhlaza zakhiwe ngaphandle apho ukufikelela kubi, abahlali baya kuzifumana zinzima ukuzisebenzisa ebomini bemihla ngemihla. Impumelelo yomgaqo-nkqubo kufuneka ihlolwe hayi ngokuba inani lomhlaba oluqinisekisiweyo kodwa ngokuba bangaphi abemi abakonwabelayo kufuphi nekhaya. Ukuba nje kuhlala kukhuphiswano lwamanani, umgaqo-nkqubo weendawo eziluhlaza awunakuphuma kukugxekwa njengolawulo lokubonisa.
texts.g:a534b217: Olu phando luhlalutye iziphumo zokwazisa ixesha lokusebenza elinokuguquguquka kumashishini amancinci naphakathi angama-320 kwingingqi yengxowa-mali. Ukujikeleza kwabasebenzi kwehle ngomndilili wama-3.1 amanqaku eepesenti kumashishini amkele inkqubo, kodwa unxulumano nokukhula kwentengiso lwalungabalulekanga ngokwezibalo. Noko ke, ngenxa yokuba isampuli ithambekele kumashishini athile, kukho imida ekwenzeni iziphumo jikelele. Uphando olulandelayo ke lufuna ukuphinda luvavanye impembelelo kuwo onke amashishini nobungakanani beenkampani.
texts.g:e48636af: Urhulumente ugqibe ekubeni andise uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lokuphendula ukwehla kokuzalwa ngokwamanyathelo ukususela kunyaka ozayo. Noko ke, olu cwangciso luyahluka kwezangaphambili kuba lususa ekuxhaseni ngemali lugxile ekwakheni iziseko zokukhathalela abantwana. Urhulumente ugqibe ukuba izibonelelo zokuzalwa kodwa zinokungasombulula izinto ezisisiseko ezichaphazela isigqibo sokuba nomntwana, ezizezi umthwalo wokukhulisa abantwana nobunzima bokulinganisa umsebenzi nosapho. Ngenxa yoko uceba ukubeka ngaphezulu kwesiqingatha soHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali ekwandiseni iindawo zokukhathalela abantwana nezindlu zokukhathalela emva kwesikolo.
texts.g:58d6ef44: Ibango lokuba ulwimi ayisiso nje isikhongozeli sengcinga kodwa yimbumba eyila indlela esicinga ngayo likho kudala. Le yile ibizwa ngokuba yithiyori yokufana kolwimi. Izifundo zakutshanje ziyathambekela ekungayixhasini ngamandla ithiyori kodwa ziyamkela ngohlobo oluphakathi: ukuba ulwimi lunokuchaphazela ngokucekeceke isantya apho iindidi ezithile zibonwa okanye ulwalathiso lokuqwalasela. Ngamanye amagama, zibona ulwimi njengempembelelo kwimikhwa yokucinga kunokuba luyalela ukucinga.
texts.g:de67f65c: Emva kokuba isibhedlele sengingqi sibhengeze ukuba siza kurhoxisa unyango lwasebusuku, uqhankqalazo lwabahlali luqhubekile. Isibhedlele sikhankanye ukunqongophala kwabasebenzi bezonyango neelahleko. Kodwa ukuba unyango lwasebusuku luyanyamalala, abokuqala ukuxakeka bangabantu abadala, abangenakho ukuhamba lula. Asinakuyala ngokupheleleyo ingqiqo yolawulo lwesibhedlele, kodwa asinakukwazi ukungabuza ukuba kunengqiqo ngokwenene ukugweba inkonzo yoluntu ephezulu njengonyango ngenzuzo yodwa. Yiyo loo nto amanyathelo enkxaso avela kurhulumente wengingqi kufuneka ahambe kunye.
texts.g:6e1dc6da: Abaphandi balandele abafundi besikolo samabanga aphantsi abangama-480 iminyaka emibini ukuhlola unxulumano phakathi kwesixa sokufunda nesigama. Iqela elifunde ngakumbi libonise amanqaku aphezulu esigama. Noko ke, abaphandi abagqibanga ngokuthi ukufunda kuphakamise isigama. Kungenxa yokuba abakwazi ukukhupha ithuba lokuba abantwana ababenesigama esomeleleyo sele bakonwabele ukufunda ngakumbi ukususela ekuqaleni. Ukuqinisekisa unxulumano lobangela, bongeze, uphando lovavanyo oluguqula ngabom imeko yokufunda kufuneka lulandele.
texts.g:9de5619c: Ikomiti yethu iyavelana nenjongo yolu lungiso. Noko ke, sikholelwa ukuba kuyafuneka indlela ekhaliphileyo kwindlela umhla wokuphunyezwa uzanyaniswa ngayo. Iindawo ezincinci zomsebenzi zifumanisa kunzima ukufumana abasebenzi nemali ukuhlangabezana nemigangatho emitsha ngexesha elifutshane, kwaye ukuba imigangatho iqiniswa ngaphandle kokulungiselela kukho ingozi yokuba ukuvalwa kuya kwanda ngokuchasene nenjongo. Ikomiti ke ngoko icebisa ukumisela amaxesha okuthomalalisa ngokobukhulu kunye nokunikela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe okwangoku.
texts.g:45b728fe: Abasebenzi ababhaqele kwizixeko ekuqaleni kwexesha lemizi-mveliso bazifumana besendlwini engalunganga. Abaphengululi bexesha elo baphendula kule ngxaki ngeendlela ezimbini ezibanzi. Elinye icala lalingqina ukukhululeka kokuziphatha komntu ngamnye njengesizathu kwaye lagxininisa ukuguqulwa kokuziphatha, ngoxa elinye lalikhangela isizathu kukungalingani kwesakhiwo kwaye lalufuna ukuphuculwa kweziko. Inyani yokuba ingxoxo yanamhlanje ngomgaqo-nkqubo wobuhlwempu ifana nale ngxabano yangaphambili ibonisa ukuba iingcambu zengxaki zinzulu kangakanani.
texts.g:894393a9: Iqela labemi lenze isicelo ukuba ibhunga lengingqi lwandise umda wemizuzu epapashiweyo. Ibhunga belihlala livaliwe ngokunye okuqulethwe ngenxa yokuba kunokuhlasela ubumfihlo babathethi. Kodwa iingxelo zoluntu kufuneka zijongwe luluntu, kwaye ukufihla nokudibana kwemigaqo-nkqubo okungazanga nonxulumano nobumfihlo akuncomeki. Umda wolwazi oluza kukhuselwa kufuneka uchazwe ngokucacileyo, nayo yonke enye ipapashwe njengomgaqo. Umkhwa wokubalekela ukuvezwa kukubhubhisa ukuthembela kwebhunga ngokwalo.
texts.g:ce1b883f: Olu phando lubonisa ukuba kukho unxulumano olubalulekileyo phakathi kwemikhwa yokuqhuba umthambo neempawu zokudakumba.
texts.g:88eee315: Ukuba oku kuqhubeka, ukuhla kwengingqi kunokukhawulezisa.
texts.g:28c887ae: Kuxelwa ukuba umonakalo ukhule ngenxa yokuba ukuphendula ngokukhawuleza kungenziwanga.
texts.g:a69a2570: Nangona injongo yomgaqo-nkqubo ilungile, imibuzo ihleli ngokulunga kokunyanzeliswa kwawo.
texts.g:d7136abe: Isikhokelo siyagxekwa ngokuba sihlala singagcinwanga ngokwaneleyo entsimini nasemva kokuhlaziywa kwaso.
texts.g:49a29231: Iingcali ziqikelele ukuba eli nyathelo linokuvelisa iziphumo zexesha elifutshane kuphela.
texts.g:6916a3e8: Umbono wokuba lo mba kufuneka ubonwe njengengxaki yesakhiwo kunokuba ube kukuphambuka komntu ngamnye uyaqhubeka nokwenza ukholo.
texts.g:58a6978f: Urhulumente wengingqi ubhengeze ukuba intengiso yokuthengisa ngokucwecwe ngaphakathi kwendawo yawo yenyuke nge-12 lepesenti emva kokukhupha iivawutsha zezipho zengingqi ezingakumbi. Kodwa ngelo xesha intengiso kwindawo ekufutshane inyuke ngomlinganiselo ofanayo, kwaye ngaphezulu kwesiqingatha senkcitho yevawutsha yenzeke kwiivenkile ezinkulu ezazinabathengi abaninzi abaqhelekileyo. Iziko longeze ukuba le data yodwa yenza kube nzima ukuthi ngaba iivawutsha zadala ukusetyenziswa okutsha okanye zatshintsha nje indlela yokuhlawula yenkcitho esele icetyisiwe. Urhulumente wengingqi uthe uceba ukuqhubeka nokukhupha ngobungakanani obufanayo kwikota elandelayo.
texts.g:c70cd192: Ibhunga ledolophu lipasise umthetho wokuphelisa iimoto-moya zokuhambisa ezihamba ezindleleni zabahambi ngeenyawo, kodwa lagqiba ekubeni libambezele ukuwunyanzelisa ngonyaka omnye. Amalungu ebhunga athe akukho kungavumelani ngemfuneko yokunyanzelisa. Nangona kunjalo, kwaphawulwa ukuba ukuba iintlawulo zibekwa kuqala ngaphandle kokucinga ngesakhiwo semivuzo yabasebenzi bokuhambisa, iziphoso zinokuphinda zibuyele ezindaweni ezingabonakaliyo kangako. Isixeko sacacisa ukuba siza kunyusa iindawo zokumisa okwexeshana ngexesha lokuphuma. Olu hlaziyo lwapasiswa ngemvume yamalungu amaninzi akhoyo.
texts.g:7363c671: Ezinye iilebhorethri ezintathu zazama ukuphinda ziveliswe iipropati ze-superconducting zezixhobo ezintsha ezabhengezwa liqela elinye lophando, kodwa ezimbini kuzo azipumelelanga. Iqela lokuqala liphendule ngokuthi umahluko wokuhlambuluka kwesampulu unokuba sisizathu. Nelebhorethri enye eyaphumelelayo yathi uluhlu lobushushu bokulinganisa lwahluka, ngoko kwakunzima ukuthelekisa iziphumo ngqo. Uluntu lwezenzululwazi alubi luyalile ngokungxamela ukuba eli ngumsebenzi ongachanekanga okanye lalwamkele njengempumelelo. Ukuze eli nto lisebenze, kufuneka kuqala kuqinisekiswe ukuba ipropati efanayo ivela kubushushu begumbi.
texts.g:04ed4bbd: Abarhwebi bathi njengoko imarike yemveli yaziwa njengendawo yabakhenkethi, abatyeleli bayanda kakhulu kodwa abathengi abaqhelekileyo bancipha. Umbutho wolawulo lwemarike uvavanya ukuba ukuthengisa kwanda ngenxa yabatyeleli bangaphandle. Nangona kunjalo, abanye abarhwebi bachaza imarike yangoku ngokuthi 'usuku lwemarike luyabanjwa, kodwa imarike inyamalele.' Umrhwebi owathi oku wavuma ukuba ukuthengisa kwemihla ngemihla kwanda ngokwenene, kodwa kwehla. Umbutho uthe uceba ukwandisa iziko zolwazi lwabatyeleli kunyaka ozayo.
texts.g:28accf58: Urhulumente wabhengeza ukuba kunyaka abantu abaneminyaka engama-60 okanye ngaphezulu benza ngaphezulu kwama-20 ekhulwini abantu bonke abasebenzayo okokuqala ngqa. Nangona kunjalo, xa iinkcukacha-manani zahlulwa, uninzi lokwanda lwalusuka kwimisebenzi yoluntu yexeshana engaphantsi kweeyure ezili-15 ngeveki, kwaye ingeniso ephakathi yenyanga yehle ngokwenene. Ukugxekwa kokuba izinga lengqesho njengesalathisi alibonisi umgangatho womsebenzi kuphindwe nakule meko. Igosa likarhulumente lathi uhlalutyo olwahlukileyo ngokwezigaba ezineenkcukacha luza kukhutshwa kwinyanga ezayo. Iingcali zikholelwa ukuba inani elifanayo linokukhokelela ekuhlalutyeni imigaqo-nkqubo eyahlukeneyo ngokuxhomekeke ekutolikeni.
texts.g:c7538eaa: Kwinkomfa yokuguqulela, umnikezeli wabonisa ukuba igama lolwimi lomthombo lithwele inkcubeko ngakumbi, kokukhona ukuzama ukufumana nokusebenzisa elona linganayo kuyenza intsingiselo ithambe. Wavuma ukuba impikiswano echasayo, yokuba ukongeza amanqaku asemazantsi kuphazamisa ukuntywilisela komfundi, inexabiso elithile. Noko, wathi ufuna ukucacisa ukuba uguqulelo olulula ukulufunda alukho ngokuyimfuneko uguqulelo olunyanisekileyo kwesokuqala. Inkomfa yagqiba ekubeni ngale ngongoma ibe sisihloko sengxoxo esisesikweni kwintlanganiso yonyaka olandelayo.
texts.g:8ba74f1e: Isiseko sikarhulumente sithe siza kukhupha amarekhodi entshukumo yabemi kubaphandi, kususwe amagama needilesi. Isiseko sachaza ukuba kuba lonke ulwazi lokuchonga lufunyenwe lwacinywa akukho nkxalabo ngokungenelela kwimfihlo. Noko ke, umphengululi wezomthetho wabonisa ukuba uphando lwaphesheya luxele iimeko apho abantu abathile banokuchongwa ngeendlela zokuhamba namaxesha kuphela. Isiseko asizange sinike sikhundla sahlukileyo kule ngongoma. Umhla wokukhutshwa kwedatha awukamiselwa.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:nounEnd: Izihloko zeendaba zidla ngokuphela ngebizo okanye ibinzana lebizo kwaye zisuse izimamva zesenzi, ngoko isihloko sifundwa njengengxelo efinyeziweyo.
texts.n:k.k10.media_headline:commaClause: Ikoma kwisihloko seendaba idla ngokudibanisa izivakalisi ezimbini ezifinyeziweyo, ezinjengonobangela okanye isiganeko elandelwa sisiphumo saso.

texts.g:cc58d1d9:
[Iindaba ezishushu] Isixeko sehlisa umgama wesantya embindini wesixeko ukuya kwi-40 km/h, ukuqala kwinyanga ezayo
Ukuqala kwinyanga ezayo, isixeko siza kwehlisa umgama wesantya kwiindlela eziphambili zasembindini wesixeko ukusuka kwi-50 ukuya kwi-40 yeekhilomitha ngeyure. Isixeko sithe iingozi zabahambi ngeenyawo zehle ngexesha lovavanyo, kwaye siceba ukuhlalutya impembelelo kwakhona emva kweenyanga ezintandathu size sigqibe ukuba siyandise kwezinye iindlela.

texts.g:e5a860f5: Injongo yokunciphisa ukukhutshwa kwekhabhoni ilungiswe ibe phezulu
texts.g:2c0a984c: Uvavanyo lokuvulwa kwelayibrari ngokuhlwa luza kwandiswa
texts.g:8df1fdab: Isebe lemfundo lesixeko libhengeze ukuba ukususela kwisemestile elandelayo liza kwandisa ukukhathalelwa emva kwesikolo kwizikolo zaphantsi ukuya ngentsimbi yesixhenxe ngokuhlwa.
texts.g:91094162: Iingcali zihlalutye ukuba ngale nyathelo yodwa, ukunyuka kwamaxabiso akuyi kuba lula ukukwehlisa.
texts.g:ed0ce6a5: Ukuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe kwenyanga ephelileyo, kuncediswa ngokusebenza okuqinileyo kwee-semiconductors, kufike kwinqanaba eliphezulu kwaloo nyanga.
texts.g:eca8dbcf:
[Isishwankathelo] Ukuvulwa kwelayibrari ngokuhlwa kuza kwandiswa... abasebenzisi bayanelisekile kakhulu
Isixeko sithe ukwaneliseka kwabasebenzisi ngokuvulwa kwamalayibrari oluntu ngokuhlwa, okuqhutywa njengovavanyo kulo nyaka, bekuphezulu. Uninzi lwabaphendulayo luphendule ukuba kulula kuba banokuboleka iincwadi nasemva komsebenzi. Ngokusekelwe kwezi ziphumo, isixeko siceba ukongeza amalayibrari alishumi avulwa ngokuhlwa kunyaka olandelayo.
texts.g:f804296d: Iphephandaba lipapashe inqaku elinesihloko esithi 'Impembelelo yezibonelelo zoshishino lolutsha iqinisekisiwe'. Kodwa emzimbeni, inqanaba lokusinda kunyaka omnye lwabafumana izibonelelo belisezi-2 zeepesenti kuphela ngaphezu kweqela lothelekiso, kwaye abaphandi bathi isampuli incinci kwaye kunzima ukuyenza jikelele. Ngale ndlela isihloko sinengxelo eyomeleleyo kunesigqibo esilumkileyo somzimba.
texts.g:593213fa: Ukusebenzisa iimilo zemibuzo kwizihloko zeendaba kuyanda. Kukho ukukhusela ukuba kubonisa ukuphapha ekungaqinisekiseni iinyani ezingaqinisekiswanga. Kodwa isihloko esinjengo 'Inkxaso-mali: iya kusebenza?' sishiya abafundi bengathathi ngaphandle kwempawu engalunganga nangona umzimba ungenayo impendulo. Kufana nokungenisa ingxoxo ngokukhawuleza ngokuboleka imilo yombuzo. Abafundi badla ngokujonga kuphela isihloko, ngoko abafumani ithuba lokulungisa le mpawu. Isihloko somilo wombuzo sinokuthethelelwa kuphela xa umzimba unikezela izizathu zalo mbuzo.
texts.g:0e25e2a6: Njengoko ukukhuphisana kwezindaba ezitsha kukhula, ulwazi olungaqinisekiswanga lufika kwizihloko rhoqo. Kuba abafundi befuna iindaba ezikhawulezayo, isantya ngokwaso asinakubekwa tyala. Kodwa nokuba impazamo ilungiswa kamva, impembelelo eshiywe sisihloko sokuqala ayicinywa lula, kuba amanqaku okulungisa awafundwa ngokubanzi njengoko owokuqala. Ukungqubana kwesantya nokuchaneka akuthethi ukuba kufuneka kusonjululwe ngokufutshane inqanaba lokuqinisekisa. Nokuba kude, ukushicilela kuphela iinyani eziqinisekisiweyo yindlela yokugcina ukuthenjwa.
texts.g:53030fa1: Isihloko esithi 'Iingozi zebhayisikili ziphindwe kabini' sibamba ingqalelo yabafundi kwangoko. Kuyamkeleka ukuthi ukubeka izinga lotshintsho kuqala yindlela esebenzayo yokucinezela ulwazi. Kodwa ukuba inani lesiseko lincinci, 'ukuphindwa kabini' kuthetha kancinane, kuba isihloko esifanayo sinokubakho xa imeko enye iba mbini. Ngokuchaseneyo, ukuba amakhulu eemeko aphindwe kabini, isihloko esifanayo siya kuba nobunzima obahlukileyo kakhulu. Xa izinga lotshintsho lisetyenziswa kwisihloko, umzimba kufuneka ubonise nenani lokuqala ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukulinganisa ubukhulu.
texts.g:bc267d69: Ukubeka iimpawu zesicatshulwa kwisihloko nokudlulisa intetho njengoko injalo kubonakala ngathi kukuhanjiswa okusemthethweni ngaphandle kokwakha komxeli. Ngokwenene, le ndlela iluncedo ekuhanjisweni ngokwethembeka kwentetho ngokwayo. Kodwa ukuba kukhethwa kuphela igama elibhaqayo kakhulu kwintetho ende libekwe kwisihloko, ukucatshulwa kuba kukhetho kunokuhanjiswa. Iimpawu zesicatshulwa zinokuba azisosiqinisekiso sokuchaneka kodwa luphawu lokuhlelwa. Abafundi kufuneka bajonge emzimbeni indlela amazwi angaphakathi kweempawu zesicatshulwa anqunyulwe ngayo kumxholo wawo.
texts.g:63ea35cf: Amanqaku eendaba alandela isakhiwo se-inverted pyramid esibeka umongo kwisiqendu sokuqala. Esi sakhiwo sisebenza kakuhle ngokuba sivumela abafundi ukuba bafumane umongo nokuba bayekile emva kokufunda isiqalo kuphela. Nangona kunjalo, okukhulu isiganeko sinzima, kokukhona ukubeka isiphelo kuphela kwisiqendu sokuqala kuyisusela imiqathango neengxoxo ezichasayo ngasemva, ukuze abafundi abafunda isiqalo kuphela baqonde iinyani ngokulula kakhulu. Imeko yokuba abafundi abaninzi abafundi ukuya esiphelweni ngokwayo iba bubuthathaka balesi sakhiwo. Kungcono ukushwankathela kwisiqendu sokuqala kodwa ubandakanye nomqathango omnye obaluleke kakhulu.
texts.g:31402c52: Umfundi obona isihloko esithi 'Amaxabiso abathengi ayancipha' angaqonda lula ukuba amaxabiso ehlile. Kungathiwa yinto eqhelekileyo ebantwini abafunda iindaba zoqoqosho ukuba le ntetho ecinezelweyo ithetha ukuba ukwenyuka kuthambile. Nangona kunjalo, abafundi bonke abahlanganyeli kula mazwi, kwaye ukuba kugxininiswa 'ukuncipha' kuphela ngelixa amanqanaba amaxabiso esaphezulu, kunokusasaza ithemba elingahambelaniyo nendlela abantu abaziva ngayo. Xa kufinyezwa amagama obuchule, kufuneka kuqala kucingwe ukuba abafundi banesiseko esifanayo.
texts.g:87c0595a: Igama elithi 'impikiswano' lisetyenziswa rhoqo kwizihloko zeendaba. Kufuneka kwamkelwe ukuba ligama elilungileyo lokuxela ngokufutshane umba othe izimvo zahlulahlulana. Kodwa ekusebenzeni, 'impikiswano' ibekwa nakwingxoxo evakaliswa ngabambalwa okanye izityholo ezinesiseko esibuthathaka, kwenza kubonakale ngathi uluntu lonke luhlulahlulene. Igama elinye lenza umba ubonakale mkhulu. Ukusebenzisa le ntetho, umzimba kufuneka ubonise ngokukhethekileyo ukuba ngubani ophikisana ngantoni.
texts.g:f9c7128e: Urhulumente ugqibe ekubeni andise utyalo-mali lophando nophuhliso kwisiphakamiso soHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lonyaka ozayo xa kuthelekiswa nalo nyaka.
texts.g:ebceec56: Amatyala exesha lekota yesithathu yalo nyaka ayabikwa ukuba ehle okokuqala kwirekhodi.
texts.g:aba71c16: Ukungakwazi ukunciphisa umahluko nolawulo kwiincoko zomvuzo, umbutho wabasebenzi ugqibe ekubeni ubeke umbuzo wokuqhankqalaza kwivoti.
texts.g:bf376452: Abasemagunyeni edolophu bacinga ukumisa ukusebenza kweenkampani ezigqithe imida yemo yamanzi.
texts.g:6cd67870: Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwanda kodwa imfuno yasekhaya yancipha, ngoko ukuphinda kwenyuka koqoqosho kuyacotha.
texts.g:9425392b: Iqela lophando lithe iziphumo zifuna ukuphinda ziqinisekiswe ngesampulu enkulu.
texts.g:16055c60: Olu hlaziyo luqala ukusebenza ukususela ngomhla emva kweenyanga ezintandathu zasemva kokubhengezwa.
texts.g:07781593: Ifilimu idlule kubabukeli abayimiliyoni emva kweentsuku ezintathu kuphela zivuliwe, yabangela isiphango sebhokisi-ofisi.
texts.g:0c1b4b47: Iphephandaba lithe, phantsi kwesihloko esithi 'Ukungasebenzi kunyuka kakhulu, uphawu lwengxaki,' izinga lokungasebenzi lale nyanga linyuke ngamanqaku epesenti angu-0.3 ukusuka kwinyanga edlulileyo laya kwi-3.4 yepesenti. Nangona kunjalo, isibhengezo se-Employment Trends Institute sithi uphando lujolise kumakhaya esampulu kwaye linempazamo yeenkcukacha-manani ye-plus okanye minus 0.4 amanqaku epesenti. Utshintsho olungaphakathi kwemida yempazamo lunzima ukwahlula njengotshintsho lokwenyani okanye isiphumo sethuba sesampulu. Ngoko, nokuba umzimba wenqaku udlulisa amanani achanekileyo, intetho ethi 'kunyuka kakhulu' kwisihloko inamandla ngaphezu kokutolika kwamanani. Kukhuselekile ukugweba emva kokujonga ukuhamba kweenyanga ezininzi kunokuguquguquka kwenyanga enye.
texts.g:b5385d29: Kuvoti yezimvo ngesicwangciso sophuhliso sedolophu entsha, ama-48 epesenti ayexhasa kwaye ama-45 epesenti ayechasa, kwaye umhambisi weendaba wabika 'Uluvo olunxaxhayo lophuhliso luhamba phambili.' Impazamo yesampulu yale voti yi-plus okanye minus 3.1 amanqaku epesenti kwinqanaba lokuthembeka le-95 epesenti. Kuba umahluko wamanqaku angu-3 phakathi kwenkxaso nokuchasa ulele ngaphakathi kwemida yempazamo, awukwazi ukuthi ngokwenkcukacha-manani yeyiphi icala elikhulu. Kwimeko enjalo, ukubhala 'uluvo lwahlulwe ngokulinganayo' yintetho ethembekileyo ngakumbi kwidatha. Ingxelo edlulisa ubungakanani bamanani ngqo kudidi inokubonakala kubafundi njengeyinto esele igqityiwe.
texts.g:408798cc: Iphephandaba lasekuhlaleni lakhupha isihloko esithi 'Iingozi zebhayisikili kwisithili ziphindwe kabini.' Ukujonga umzimba, inani leengozi lenyuke ukusuka kwi-3 kunyaka odlulileyo laya kwi-6 kulo nyaka. Ngokwezinga kuphela yi-100 yepesenti yokunyuka, kodwa kuba inani elipheleleyo lincinci, nomahluko wethuba wemeko enye okanye ezimbini utshintsha izinga kakhulu. Ngokuchaseneyo, iingozi zeemoto kwingingqi enye zenyuke nge-5 yepesenti, ukusuka kwi-1,200 ukuya kwi-1,260, kodwa azizange zibe sisihloko. Siliphi icala eliyingozi abafundi abayifunayo ngokwenene ukuyazi? Akufuneki sifunde izinga eligxininiswe sisihloko njengoko libonisa ngqo ukubaluleka kwenqaku.
texts.g:f1021423: Kwi-bar graph yenqaku elinye, ixabiso eliphakathi lerenti yeNgingqi A lalizotywe ngokuphezulu okungaphezu kokubini kweNgingqi B. Kodwa i-axis eme nkqo ayiqalanga ku-0 kodwa ku-800,000 won. Amanani wenyani ngu-920,000 won ye-A kunye no-850,000 won ye-B, umahluko ongaphezulu kancinane kwama-8 lepesenti. Ukuba indawo yokuqala inqunyulwe, nomahluko omncinci ubonakala ngathi kukwahlukana okukhulu. Nokuba imo yegrafu ibonakala isekela ibango lenqaku, abafundi bayatsalwa yimpembelelo yokubona ngaphandle kokuba bahlole isikali neeyunithi.
texts.g:9369abc2: Kumanqaku emozulu, intetho ethi 'ubushushu obuphezulu ukususela ekuqalisweni kweerekhodi' idinga ukuqwalaselwa ekutolikweni. Umzekelo, indawo yokujonga yeOnsaemi ibirekhoda ubushushu ukususela ngo-1998, ngoko 'ukususela ekuqalisweni kweerekhodi' kwayo kungumqondiso nje womgangatho kwirekhodi yeminyaka engamashumi amabini. Ayinakubekwa ecaleni ithelekiswe neerekhodi zezinye iindawo ebezijonga phantse kwiminyaka elikhulu. Ngaphezu koko, ukuba iindawo ezijikelezileyo zendawo yokujonga ziye zaba yindawo yesixeko kwaye ubushushu bukhula lula, izizathu zokunyuka kobushushu ziquka utshintsho kwindawo yendawo kunye notshintsho lwemozulu. Ngoko ke le ntetho ingaba yinyani, kodwa oko akuthethi ukuba ngubungqina obuthe ngqo botshintsho lwemozulu.
texts.g:f28ddb3b: Isihloko seqinisi elinye sifundeka 'Isongezelelo sokutya A sinyusa ingozi yomhlaza.' Kodwa umphandi ocatshuliweyo emzimbeni wathi nje, 'Kwiimvavanyo zeempuku kwakukho iimeko apho amathumba anyuka kwizixa eziphezulu, ngoko asinakukhupha ithuba lengozi kubantu nabo.' Le ntetho isondele ekubeni ingozi ayikakhutshwa kunokuthi ingozi iqinisekisiwe. Isihloko sasusa imeko 'ithuba' kunye nomda 'uvavanyo lweempuku' saseleka isigqibo sodwa. Ukucatshulwa kwentetho akuthethi ukuba ukulumkela kwentetho kudluliselwe kunye.
texts.g:8f4d8e8f: Abafundi abaqaphele inqaku elinesihloko esithi 'Umvuzo ophakathi wabasebenzi beofisi: 52 million won' bakhathazeka ukuba ingeniso yabo ayifikeli kumgangatho ophakathi. Kodwa itheyibhile yophando olufanayo ibonakalise umlinganiselo ophakathi njengo-41 million won. Ukuba umlinganiselo ophakathi ungaphezulu kwe-10 million won ngaphezu kwexabiso eliphakathi kuthetha ukuba inani elincinci labafumana kakhulu belitsale umndilili. Kwidata apho ulwabiwo lujongene necala elinye, njengengeniso, umndilili unokungabi ngomelayo imeko yabantu abaqhelekileyo. Inani elisetyenziswe kwisihloko belingalunganga, kodwa ukukhathazeka okuvakalelwa ngabafundi kuvela ikakhulu ekukhetheni isalathisi.

texts.g:476bd6f7: Khangela isivumelwano kwakhona phambi kokuba usityikitye. Khumbula ingcebiso yokubetha nebhulorho yelitye phambi kokuwela.
texts.g:f8424b93: Ebezidla ngokuba ngoyena unobuchule, kodwa xa edibana nomelana nobhetele kakhulu kukhuphiswano wavakalelwa ngenene ukuba kusoloko kukho ongcono.
texts.g:81648b2d: Ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini somhlobo wam ibibonakala imnandi ngakumbi, kodwa xa sitshintshisana kwakungekho mahluko mkhulu. Isiqhulo esithi iindawo zabanye abantu zibonakala zinkulu siyinyani ngenene.
texts.g:00c76a75: Ukuthemba ukudlala kakuhle emva kweveki enye kuphela yokufunda ikatala kukuhaha. Awunako ukuhlutha ngoku okokuqala kwecephe, ngoko masenze umthambo kancinane.
texts.g:f8203342: Xa abantu ababini bephikisana yaye omnye ecaleni ephinda-phinda ukuvusa umsindo wabo, abantu basebenzisa isiqhulo esithi ukuvuthela indlu evuthayo.
texts.g:d26b1edf: Ukucaphuka namhlanje ngenxa yokuba akukho siqhamo kwimbewu etyalwe izolo kuphela kufana nokufuna iti yelayisi eshiswe emthonjeni.
texts.g:6d27989e: Nokuba yindlela ohamba kuyo rhoqo inokuba itshintshile ngenxa yokwakhiwa, ngoko kufuneka sithathele ingqalelo ingcebiso yokubuza izalathiso nakwindlela eqhelekileyo.
texts.g:3a277141: Kuvezwe uluvo lokutsiba uphicotho lokhuseleko ukuze kuncitshiswe ixesha lokwakha. Okwangoku kubonakala njengenzuzo kuba uyilo luye lwanyuselwa. Kodwa kanye xa kuvela ingozi, ukwakha kuyayeka iinyanga ezininzi yaye kulandele ukwabelana ngetyala. Isaci esithi 'ukuba uyaphuthuma, thatha indlela ende' sisebenza ngqo kolu lwazi. Endaweni yokuphuthuma ube nelahleko enkulu, ukulandela inkqubo emisiweyo kuye kubonakale ukuba kukhawuleza ekugqibeleni.
texts.g:2dd11ef7: Ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi abatsha, iingcaciso zabasebenzi abadala zihlala zihlangana nengxaki enye: nokuba zichaza kakuhle kangakanani, azingeni kumntu ongayibonanga indawo yomsebenzi. Njengesaci esithi 'ukuva amahlandlo alikhulu akulunganga njengokubona kanye', ukubona umatshini usebenza ngamehlo akho kunokwenza iiyure zengcaciso zigqitywe kwimizuzu. Oko akuthethi ukuba ingcaciso ayifuneki. Olona laulo luphumelelayo kukwakha isiseko sokuqonda ngamava endaweni yomsebenzi emva koko ulungelelanise ngengcaciso.
texts.g:4e66256a: Iiplatifomu ezimbini ezinkulu zokuhambisa zikhuphisane ngokunciphisa imirhumo kwaye zathi ngxi ekubhengezeni izibonelelo zabanini bevenkile. Kodwa xa ukhuphiswano luphelile, inkampani enye yathenga enye, kwaye umqhubi omtsha warhoxisa izibonelelo ebezithembise. Abantu abaninzi bathi ngale nto, 'Xa iminenga ilwa, umqolo wolwandle uyaphuka.' Kodwa eli saci lichaza kuphela imeko yokulimala phakathi kwedabi; alibandakanyi imeko emva kokuba idabi liphelile, apho ophumeleleyo enza iqabane lakhe elitsha lorhwebo aze atshintshe imiqathango. Ilahleko yabanini kufuneka ibonwe njengevela hayi ekubanjweni ngengozi kodwa kwisakhiwo esilungiselelwe ekuqaleni ukubenza baxhomekeke kwicala elinye.
texts.g:392498f6: Abantu abagxeka ubungcali babiza umphandi othoba nzulu kwicandelo elinye kuphela 'ixoki lombombo.' Kodwa amanzi ayaphuma kuphela xa umbombo nzulu. Ingxaki yexoki ayikokuba lihlala embombeni kodwa kukuba alinakucinga isibhakabhaka esibanzi ngaphandle kwawo. Umphandi owaziyo imida yecandelo lakhe uthetha namaxoki ezinye iimbombo, ezisa imibuzo emitsha, aze asebenzise leyo mibuzo ukuthoba umbombo wakhe ngokunzulu kwakhona. Ngoko ke, into efunekayo ayikokuzalisa imibombo kodwa ukwakha iindlela phakathi kwayo.
texts.g:259c83de: Ngokwengxelo yeziko lelifa lenkcubeko, ngaphezulu kwesiqingatha seendawo ezifunyenwe kwiminyaka elishumi edlulileyo zavela ngengozi ngexesha lokumba umhlaba ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha. Abantu bebecinga ukuba sele bayazi yonke into ngomhlaba ophantsi kwesixeko esiphakathi ngenxa yokuba usondele. Isaci esithi 'Kumnyama phantsi kwesibane' sibonisa ubumnyama obuvela hayi ngenxa yokuba izinto azibonakali kodwa ngenxa yokuba akukho mntu uzamayo ukujonga. Ukuba nokuba inxalenye yengqwalasela eqaliselwe ekumbeni okukude yayijiyelwe kwinto elele ngaphantsi kweenyawo, ngekubakho ilifa elingaphantsi elinokukhuselwa phambi kokuba lonakale.
texts.g:a8777528: Kukho inkolelo eqhelekileyo yokuba ukuba iprojekthi yophando oludibeneyo inabantu abaninzi abanoxanduva, izinto ziyaphosakala. Kodwa ukujonga iimeko zentsebenziswano enkulu yophando phakathi kweendawo ezininzi, nokuba inani leendawo ezithatha inxaxheba lifana, ezinye zavelisa iziphumo ezinye azange. Into eyazahlulayo ayiyonani lamalungu kodwa kukuba bebebhale phantsi ekuqaleni ukuba ngubani onegunya lokugqibela lokwenza izigqibo. Iphenyane elikwisaci lenyuka intaba hayi ngenxa yokuba abantu abaninzi babedyakalala kodwa ngenxa yokuba kungekho mntu wokugqiba indlela. Ngoko ke ukusebenzisa 'Ukuba kukho abantu abaninzi bokudyakalala, iphenyane liyenyuka intaba' njengesiseko sokunciphisa inani labathathi-nxaxheba kukuchaza ngokungachanekanga isizathu.
texts.g:1f6577ed: Kuphawulwa ukuba uninzi lwamalungu ekomiti yovavanyo ngabantu abasebenze ixesha elide kushishino oluvavanywayo. Amalungu aphendula ngelithi ubuchule buyafuneka ukuze uvavanyo lunokwenzeka. Akukho nanye kwezi ntetho iphosakeleyo. Noko ke, into eyaphawulwa lisaci elithi 'Iklabhu isebenzisana nenkala' ayiyonto yabani bolwaphukelo kodwa inyani yokuba abantu abachithe ixesha kwimeko enye babona izinto ngemigangatho efanayo. Ngoko isisombululo asikokuxelela abantu ukuba bathembe ngokulula intliziyo yamalungu ngamnye okanye ukukhupha wonke umntu kushishino. Indlela enenyani kukuvezwa kwemidla nokubandakanya amalungu avela kwezinye iimvelaphi ngokwesabelo esimiselweyo.
texts.g:b26c3202: Ingxelo yeziphumo zeprojekthi yenkxaso ichaza ukuba umgangatho wengqesho wolutsha olwathatha inxaxheba wawungama-85 lepesenti. Noko ke, uninzi lwemisebenzi lwaluyizivumelwano zexesha elifutshane ezaluhlala kuphela ngexesha leprojekthi, kwaye nasemva kweenyanga ezintandathu emva kokuba iprojekthi iphelile, isabelo esasisahleli kwindawo yomsebenzi enye sasingaphantsi kwesinye kwezintathu. I-apricot yasendle ebonakala ihle ngaphandle inokwaziwa ukuba iyintoni emva kokuba uluma kuyo. Ukulinganisa iziphumo zale projekthi, umntu kufuneka ajonge inyama, ubude bengqesho egciniweyo, kunokuba ajonge ulwebu, umgangatho wengqesho. Kunjalo, akukho mfuneko yokukhanyela nethuba lokuba imisebenzi yexesha elifutshane inokuba sisiqalo somsebenzi.
texts.g:0a684b7e: Isaci sokuba imikhwa yobuntwana ihlala ubomi bonke sibhekiswa rhoqo njengesizathu semfundo yamandulo. Kodwa ufundo lwe-neuroscience lubonisa ukuba ingqondo inokutshintsha nasemva kokuba umntu ekhule. Oko akuthethi ukuba sinokuthi isaci asilunganga. Kungenxa yokuba umntu unokutolika ukuba imikhwa ebethelelwe ebuntwaneni ihlala hayi ngenxa yokuba ayinakutshintshwa kodwa ngenxa yokuba iyaphindaphindwa ngaphandle kokuziva efuna ukuyitshintsha. Ukuyifunda ngale ndlela, 'Umkhwa wonyaka wesithathu uhlala de kube ngamashumi asibhozo' usondele ngakumbi kwisilumkiso sokuba imeko yamandulo icutha ngokuthe cwaka ukhetho lwakamva kunengxelo ebhengeza isiphelo.

texts.g:6cde1dc5: Emva kokujuluka kwisauna, umzimba wam waziva ulula.

texts.g:d3e5f156: Nangona kubhengezwe ukuba ukunyuka kwamaxabiso kuyehla, uqoqosho abantu abaziva lona alukaphuculwa.
texts.g:6f7b68b9: Njengesaci sithi, 'ukulungisa isitali emva kokulahlekelwa yinkomo': kuyadlulwa ngexesha ukwenza ukuhlola ukhuseleko emva kokuba ingozi yenzekile.
texts.g:d6e43b05: Urhulumente ugqibe ukwandisa ingxowa-mali yenkxaso yemisebenzi yolutsha ngamanyathelo ukuqala kwinyanga ezayo.
texts.g:8bd7a509: Aba bobabini bangabahlobo abadala, ngoko nangaphandle kokuthetha baqondane iintliziyo omnye komnye ngovelwano olungathethwanga.
texts.g:52da5270: Siza kukwazisa ngeziphumo zentlanganiso kamva ngesaziso.
texts.g:0ef77f9c: Kutshanje izixeko ezininzi ziye zaqhuba iibhayisikili ezabelwanayo. Iibhayisikili ezabelwanayo ziqwalaselwa njengokuncedisa ukunciphisa ukuxinana kwezithuthi nokungcoliseka komoya. Noko ke, kukho ukugxekwa ukuba abasebenzisi bashiya iibhayisikili naphi kwaye bathintela abahamba ngeenyawo. Ukusombulula oku, kuyafuneka umgaqo wokuba iibhayisikili zibuyiselwe kuphela kwiindawo ezimiselweyo.
texts.g:4e399a24: Olu lungiso luyagxekwa ngokuba ludinga uqeqesho olupheleleyo loluntu phambi kokuba lusebenze.
texts.g:c2680bc3: Ngokusekelwe kwiziphumo zolu vavanyo, iqela lophando liphawule imida yethiyori esele ikho.
texts.g:9c3ed599: Lo mba ucwangciselwe ukugqitywa ekugqibeleni emva kokugqitywa kwengxoxo phakathi kwamaphondo afanelekileyo.
texts.g:3f609bf9: Njengoko ukungaqiniseki kwemarike kukhule, izigqibo zotyalomali kufuneka zenziwe ngokuthe cwaka.
texts.g:583f6070: Ekubeni loo mbutho ulandela umdla woluntu, unoxanduva lokuveza iiakhawunti zawo ngokuvulekileyo.
texts.g:1025bee0: Kwintetho yanamhlanje siza kujonga impembelelo yokwanda kwabantu abadala kwimali yengingqi. Okokuqala, ngokusekelwe kwizibalo zeminyaka elishumi edlulileyo, siza kuhlola ukungafani phakathi kweengeniso nenkcitho yenhlalontle, size sihlalutye, ngamaqela amathathu, ukuba kutheni olu khenketho lukhula. Okokugqibela, ndiza kuchaza ukuba kutheni uhlaziyo lwesakhiwo lufuneka endaweni yeziyobisi zexesha elifutshane.
texts.g:2feffde4: A: Ungasixelela ngombono wokungenisa ukuguqulelwa okuzenzekelayo ekuphatheni izikhalazo zoluntu kumaziko karhulumente? B: Kucacile ukuba ukulula kuya kunyuka. Noko ke, kwiinkalo ezinjengamagama asemthethweni, apho umngcipheko wokuguqulelwa kakubi uphezulu, ndicinga ukuba ukuhlolwa ngabaphandi kufuneka kwenziwe kunye. A: Ngoko ngubani omele athwale iindleko zokuhlolwa? B: Kuyabonakala ukuba iziko likarhulumente elixhamla kwinkqubo lilithwale.
texts.g:401a0f29: Ikomiti ichaza indawo yayo malunga neengcamango ezisandula ukuphakanyiswa zokungcoliswa kwamanzi ngolu hlobo. Uphando oluzakuthi gqi aluqinisekisanga ungcoliseko ekwinqanaba elinobungozi emzimbeni womntu. Noko ke, ukuthomalalisa uxhalabo lwabahlali, siza kwenza uvavanyo olongezelelweyo size sipapashe iziphumo veki nganye.
texts.g:3f5c09b9: A: Yintoni ocinga ukuba yeyona ngxaki inkulu yomgaqo-nkqubo wokuziqhelanisa nokutshintsha kwemozulu, Gqirha? B: Ndicinga ukuba kukusebenzisana phakathi kwamasebe karhulumente kunebhajethi. Ngenxa yokuba iiarhente ezininzi zilandela amanyathelo okukhusela izikhukhula kwindawo enye ngokwahlukeneyo, kubakho utyalo-mali oluphindwe kabini, yaye kwiimeko ezininzi inzuzo ayifikeleli ngokwenene kumaqela asengozini. A: Ngoko yeyiphi indlela efunekayo? B: Kufuneka inkqubo eyila isicwangciso esidityanisiweyo kwinqanaba lengingqi kwaye ihlolisise iziphumo ngokudibeneyo.
texts.g:0a1c9bde: Imigaqo yokuziphatha kuphando sisiqinisekiso esisisiseko esixhasa ukuthembeka kweziphumo zophando. Hayi nje ukutshintsha idatha ngokungenasizathu kodwa nokuthatha amagama omnye umntu ngaphandle kokucaphula umthombo kubalwa njengokungaziphathi kakuhle kuphando. Ngoko ke abaphandi banoxanduva lokubika iziphumo njengoko zinjalo, nokuba zahlukile kwingqikelelo.
texts.g:87916770: Eli bali lichaza impumelelo kunye nemida yeprojekthi yokuvuselela isixeko ngendlela elinganiselweyo.
texts.g:03c8f3eb: Umbhali ixhasa ibango lakhe ngokunika imizekelo emithathu.
texts.g:869a5d05: Imizuzu yentlanganiso kufuneka isishwankathele ngamafutshane izigqibo ezithathiweyo kunye nomsebenzi ozayo.
texts.g:087eb960: Kwintshayelelo yesiphakamiso, imvelaphi kunye nenjongo yophando kufuneka ibonakale, yaye isiphelo kufuneka sibonise iziphumo ezilindelekileyo.
texts.g:6a812acc: Njengoko kubhengeziwe ngezantsi, abo bachaphazelekayo bacelwa ukuba bafake izicelo phakathi kwexesha elimisiweyo.
texts.g:1169c0b8: Umgaqo-nkqubo wagxekwa njengethiyori nje yentetho eyasilela ukubonisa ngokufanelekileyo amazwi asenkundleni.
texts.g:c93d7e85: Ukushwankathela, injongo yolu hlaziyo yehla ibe zizinto ezimbini, ukwenza lula iinkqubo nokomeleza uxanduva.
texts.g:8342bfa1: 'Ukungathathi hlangothi kwekhabhoni' kuthetha ukwenza ubungakanani begesi yokufudumeza umhlaba ekhutshiweyo bulingane nobo ifunxwayo okanye ikhutshwayo ukuze ukukhutshwa okuthe gqi kube yimpuku. Oku akuthethi ukuphelisa ngokupheleleyo ukukhutshwa; kuthetha ukulinganisa amalungu anzima ukuwancitshisa ngokwenza amahlathi okanye ubugcisa bokubamba. Ngoko ke, ukufezekisa ukungathathi hlangothi kwekhabhoni kufuna kokubini iinzame zokunciphisa kunye neendlela zokulinganisa.
texts.g:b726ec3e: A: Izimvo ziyahlukana ngokuba ingaba imaphakathi yenzala mayinciphiswe na. Masiqale sive kuGqirha B. B: Ukuba izinga lenzala liyancitshiswa, umthwalo wenzala uyehla kwaye ukusetyenziswa kunokuvuseleleka. Kodwa ityala losapho liphezulu ngoku, ngoko isithuba esongezelelweyo sinokuya ekuhlaleni ityala kunokuba siye ekusetyenzisweni. C: Ndiyayiqonda loo nkxalabo, kodwa asinakujonga nje uqoqosho lutshona, akunjalo? B: Andichasani nokuncitshiswa ngokwako. Ndithetha ukuba ukuba izinga lenzala liyancitshiswa ngaphandle kwamanyathelo okulawula ityala, isiphumo esilindelekileyo sinokuba sisiqingatha.
texts.g:fbb5abf4: A: Izimvo ziyahlukana malunga nomthetho-sikhumbuzo wokongeza iiCCTV zasezindleleni. B: Nangona zikho izifundo ezithi iyanceda ekuthinteleni ulwaphulo-mthetho, umngcipheko wokuba imivalo isetyenziselwe ngaphaya kwenjongo nawo mkhulu. Ngoko ndicinga ukuba ukumisela ngokucacileyo injongo yofakelo nexesha lokugcina emthethweni kuyimfuneko. C: Ndicinga ukuba ukongeza izixhobo zokubeka esweni ezingenabungqina bempembelelo yeyona ngxaki. B: Unyanisile ukuba ubungqina bempembelelo busaneleyo. Kodwa kunzima ukuvuma ukuthintela ofakelo ngokupheleleyo. Sinokuzisebenzisa ixesha elithile, sivavanye impembelelo, size sifakele isiqendu sokuzisusa ukuba akukho ziphumo.
texts.g:b74e7fde: A: Abanye bathi kufuneka sibambezele amanyathelo okusabela kuba iimbonakalo zomzekelo wemozulu zinempazamo. C: Ukuba amanani ayahluka ngomzekelo ngamnye, akukho nzululwazi yokumisa imigaqo-nkqubo ebiza kakhulu kude kube kunyanisekile ngakumbi? B: Kuyinyani ukuba imizekelo iyahluka. Kodwa umahluko ukwinqanaba lokuba lingakanani ukunyuka kobushushu, hayi ukuba luyanyuka okanye hayi. Kwakhona, umonakalo kwimeko embi kakhulu mkhulu ngaphandle kokuthelekiswa nenkcitho yokulungiselela. C: Ngoko uthetha ukuba nje ukungaqiniseki akusosizathu sokubambezela? B: Ukuze ukubambezela kube nesizathu, ukungaqiniseki kufuneka kushukumise nesalathiso. Akunjalo ngoku.
texts.g:8ac184e0: A: Sixoxa ngokuba isixa senkxaso yolutsha sinikwe bonke abantu abatsha okanye kuphela abo banengeniso ephantsi. B: Ukuba uhlula ngengeniso, abamkeli baziva bedikwa kwaye abantu abatsha abangaphezulu kancinane komda baphelelwa yinkxaso. Ndibeka ingqalelo kwintlawulo yoluntu lonke. C: Ingxaki yimali. Ukuyinika wonke umntu, kufuneka unciphise isixa kakhulu okanye unyuse irhafu. B: Andinako ukuyiphika. Kungenxa yoko ndingabhengezi ukuphunyezwa okupheleleyo ukususela ekuqaleni. Ndicinga ngokuqala ngeqela leminyaka elinciphisiweyo ndiwandise emva kokubona impembelelo.
texts.g:c517e875: A: Iofisi yesithili ifuna ukunciphisa iikhawunta zenkonzo yaye ifudukele kwizicelo ze-intanethi. C: Ukuphatha izinto kwi-intanethi kunciphisa iindleko kwaye kunciphisa ukulinda. Abasebenzi bekhawunta bangaphantsi. B: Kuyacaca ukuba ukusebenza kakuhle kuyanda. Kodwa kubahlali abangaqhelananga neenkonzo ze-intanethi, ikhawunta yeyona ndlela kuphela. Xa indlela inyamalala, abo baqala ukubandezeleka yinto engalunganga ngokubanzi ngabantu nabo abanzima ukuvakalisa amazwi abo. C: Nangona kunjalo, ingxaki yabasebenzi ayisonjululwanga. B: Ngoko andikucebisi ukuphelisa iikhawunta, kodwa ukunciphisa ukusebenza kumaxesha asetyenziswa kancinane nokuhambisa laba basebenzi kwitafile yoncedo.
texts.g:9e6048cb: A: Ukuba ukuguqulela ngokoqobo okanye ngokukhululekileyo kungcono xa kuguqulelwa imibongo yakudala yingxoxo exesha elide. B: Ndicinga ukuba ukuguqulela ngokoqobo kufuneka kube sisiseko. Ngokuguqulela ngokukhululekileyo kukho ingozi yokuba ukutolika komguquleli kudluliselwe kumfundi ngokungathi ngowokuqala. C: Kodwa ukuhambisa amagama ngamnye ngamnye akukho ntolika sele ikhetha intsingiselo? Akukho kuguqulela ngaphandle kokutolika. B: Kunjalo. Umntu akanakuphepha ukutolika. Oko ndikuthethayo akulo ukuphelisa ukutolika kodwa ukuvumela abafundi bahlonele apho ukutolika kungenelele khona. Amanqaku afeza le ndima.
texts.g:e5b59eb3: A: Umba kukuba abasebenzi bemiqolo yokuhambisa kufuneka babonwe njengabasebenzi. C: Aba bantu bakhethe ukuguquguquka kokusebenza ngamaxesha abawafunayo, kwaye ukuba bachazwa njengabasebenzi, oko kuguquguquka kunyamalala. B: Ndiyavuma ukuba ukuguquguquka kunexabiso. Kodwa ukuba iqonga lilawula ukwabiwa komsebenzi nge-algorithm, kufana ngokwenene nokuba phantsi kwesikhokelo. Nangona kunjalo, andithi yonke imeko ithathwe njengomsebenzi; ndicinga ukuba inqanaba lolawulo kufuneka liphononongwe imeko ngemeko. C: Ngoko ucebisa ukuphatha njani izikhuseleko ezinjengokugutyungelwa kwengozi yomsebenzi? B: Ngokwahlukileyo kwisigwebo sokuba ngumsebenzi, kunokubekwa kuqala iwebhu esezantsi yokhuseleko ngokuchasene neengozi.
texts.g:1e59163a: Abantu abaninzi basayina izivumelwano ngaphandle kokuzifunda ngenyameko baphelele ekungeneni ezingxakini.

texts.g:ae728982: Ngenxa yokuba imfuno yasekhaya yaqhubeka nangona ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwehla, izinga lokukhula alinqunyulwanga kakhulu.
texts.g:45abc5d7: Kwiholo yemidlalo, ukucima ifowuni yakho ngenxa yokucinga ngabanye abaphulaphuli yinkqubo esisiseko.
texts.g:0ad5b45b: Ngokubonisa ubomi bemihla ngemihla obuqhelekileyo ngendlela ezolileyo, le noveli ibonisa ngokwenene amanxeba abalinganiswa.
texts.g:0b9af68a: Phambi kokungenisa isicelo, nceda uqinisekise ukuba onke amaxwebhu afunekayo aphelele.

texts.n:k.k10.sino_four:fourChar: Ezi zaci zonkcukacha ezine zivela kwiinhlobo zesiTshayina; isilabhili nganye ithwala intsingiselo enye, kwaye ibinzana lonke lisetyenziswa njengesibizo okanye isichazi.
texts.n:k.k10.sino_four:ctx: Isaci esinezinkcukacha ezine sifundwa ngokweqendu elisingqongileyo: amagama esizathu nesiphumo phambi kwesaci abonisa ukuba imeko inethamsanqa, ayinalo, igqithisile okanye iyancomeka.
texts.g:9e86100f: Ithamsanqa nesikhubekiso azibonakali kwangaphambili, ngoko ungavuyi okanye ulahlekelwe lithemba kakhulu.
