texts.g:bc110a30: Ifektri itshile yonke kwaye izixhobo zayo zonke zatshintshwa, kwaye ngenxa yoko isantya sokuvelisa saphindaphindeka, ngoko kuyinto yenene yentsikelelo ehonjisiweyo.
texts.g:93a72436: Unyaka ngamnye omtsha ndithatha isigqibo sokuqhuba umthambo, kodwa ekubeni andizokuhlala ngaphezu kweentsuku ezintathu, izigqibo zam zihlala zingaphumeleli emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa.
texts.g:8138c19a: Ukuya emsebenzini ngebhayisikili kukunika umthambo kwaye kugcina kwiindleko zohambo, ngoko kubulala iintaka ezimbini ngelitye elinye.
texts.g:1ca73e05: Lowo waphula isithembiso wacaphuka endaweni yokuxolisa, okuyiqhawe elalela ikhoboka ngokunzulu.
texts.g:50a57c06: Kuthiwa umthambo olunge emzimbeni, kodwa ukuwenza iiyure ezilishumi ngosuku kukugulisa ngokwenene, ngoko isithethe sokuba ukugqitha okufana nokungafikeleli siyinyani.
texts.g:bd35520a: Iinkampani ezimbini zikhetha kuphela amacandelo alungileyo kwizibalo ezifanayo kwaye zibhenela ngokuzithanda.
texts.g:dd6e0f5b: Xa umfundi efumene iziphumo ezingcono kunotitshala, utitshala wavuya wathi umfundi udlule inkosi yakhe.
texts.g:45b7572e: Ukufunda ulwakhiwo lweendlu ezindala ze-hanok nokuyisebenzisa kuyilo lwanamhlanje ngumzekelo olungileyo wokufunda okutsha kokudala.
texts.g:abb02c4f: Abasebenzi bokukhulula baqhubeke nokukhangela imini nobusuku ukufumana abantu abalahlekileyo.
texts.g:966842b0: Kutshanje, abantu abaninzi balahlekelwa ziisixa ezikhulu emva kokukhohliswa ngamazwi amnandi athembisa 'ukhuseleko lwemali yokuqala kunye nenzuzo yenyanga ye-20%.' Kutyalo-mali oluqhelekileyo, ukuba inzuzo inkulu, ingozi inkulu. Isithembiso senzuzo ephezulu engenangozi kufuneka sithandabuzwe ngenxa yoko kanye. Endaweni yokutsalwa ngamazwi amnandi nokuxhamla, sifuna umkhwa wokuqala ukuhlola ukuba inkampani ibhaliswe kwisiko elisemthethweni.
texts.g:36da0494: Inkampani yokutya ifihle isiphene semveliso eyayisazi, kodwa umntu wangaphakathi owayerhwebesha ekugqibeleni wabonisa yonke into. Abantu abaninzi bayaphendula ngokuziva bekhululekile, bethi ubulungisa busoloko buphumelela. Kodwa inyani yokuba isiphumo silungisiwe ayithethi ukuba inkqubo nayo yayiyiyo. Kwakukho kudala abathengi abalimeleyo, kwaye ukuba inkqubo yokubeka iliso ibingenabunzima inyaniso ibinokuhlala ingcwatyiwe. Ubulungisa ukuphumelela akwenzeki ngokwabo; kuba nokwenzeka kuphela xa amaziko nenkalipho zikuxhasa.
texts.g:acf2b5ae: Isaci sokuba okuninzi kungcono sinokulungela izinto, kodwa kunzima ukusisebenzisa kulwazi njengoko lunjalo. Ngezinto ezininzi, iziseko zokugweba zibonakala zikhula, kodwa enyanisweni ixesha nomgudu odingekayo ukucoca into efunekayo nazo ziyakhula. Ngaphezu koko, xa izinto ezingaqinisekanga ukuba zivela phi zidityaniswa, isigqibo sinokuphazamiseka. Okubalulekileyo ayikokuba uqokelele kangakanani kodwa ukuba ukhetha ngokuchanekileyo kangakanani usebenzise izinto ezithembekileyo.
texts.g:099e31d2: Abantu abalahlekelwe ngumsebenzi ngexesha lokhuselo lwezoqoqosho bahlala bephiwa intuthuzelo ngebinzana elithi 'Saeongjima.' Lithetha ukuba okulungileyo nokubi bobomi akunakuqikelelwa, ngoko iintsuku ezilungileyo ziya kuza ukuba ulinda. Indoda endala kwibali ayigwebanga ngokungacingisisiyo ukuba lilungile okanye libi ithamsanqa xa ihashe layo lalibaleka okanye xa lalibuya. Kodwa eli binzana alithethi ukuhlala ungenza nto ulindele ithamsanqa. Amazwi entuthuzelo awanakuthatha indawo yamanyathelo. Okufunwa ngabangaphangeliyo, kunye nesimilo sokwamkela ukungaqiniseki ngokuzola, yinkxaso ethe ngqo enjengoqeqesho olutsha nokukhuselwa kwengeniso.
texts.g:52aa979d: Xa inkampani yazisa icebo lolungiso elagcina umvuzo wonyaka ofanayo kodwa lonyusa isabelo seebhonasi zokusebenza ngokutshintsha ngokuhlisa umvuzo osisiseko, umbutho wabasebenzi wachasa, ulibiza 'Josammosa.' Iinkawu ebalini zazibudenge kuba zaphosa inyani yokuba, nokuba zintathu ekuseni okanye zine, zazisixhenxe ngosuku. Kodwa eli cebo linokwahluka elingekho kwibali leenkawu. Iibhonasi zinokuncipha ngokuxhomekeke kwiziphumo zenkampani, kwaye umvuzo osisiseko ngumgangatho wemali yokuphelisa umsebenzi nokuhlola imali yemboleko. Nokuba izixa zibonakala zifana, ukuba ukuba ngubani othwele ingozi uyatshintsha, kunzima ukuliyeka eli njengoJosammosa.
texts.g:cdec0eb0: Umbhiyozo wengingqi uphumelele ekutsaleni izihambi, kwaye abadwelisi banda unyaka ngamnye. Kodwa imisitho enenxaxheba yabahlali yehle kwaye inqwelo yatshintshela ekujikelezeni abadlali bangaphandle. Ngenxa yolu tshintsho, kuvela ukugxekwa 'kokujika kwenkosi nomtyeli'. Inkosi yomnyhadala kufuneka ibe ngabahlali abakhathalele isithethe sawo, kodwa incasa yabatyeleli iye yagqiba umxholo womsitho. Kodwa umntu akanakubeka ityala ekwandeni kwabatyeleli ngokwako. Ingxaki kukuba, ngenxa yokwamkela abatyeleli, inkosi isunduzelwe ngaphandle kwendawo yayo. Impumelelo yomnyhadala kufuneka ihlolwe hayi ngenani labadwelisi kodwa ngokuba abahlali basemi embindini wenqwelo okanye hayi.
texts.g:17a6db45: Abantu abaninzi bacaphula 'Daegi-manseong' ngokuchasene nengxoxo yokukhetha abantwana abanetalente kwangethuba. Bathi kuba kukho iitalente eziqhakaza emva kwexesha, akufuneki ziyohlulwe kwangethuba. Kodwa le ngxoxo ichasayo nayo inomsantsa. Ngenxa yokuba i-Daegi-manseong ithetha ngesiphumo sesikhongozeli esikhulu esigqityiweyo emva kwexesha, ayisixeleli ngeemeko ezingenakubalwa ezalinda ukuqhakaza emva kwexesha azange. Ukuqokelela amabali empumelelo kuphela ukuxoxa ngexesha lokukhetha akwanelanga njengesiseko. Into ekufuneka ihlolwe endaweni yoko kukuba ukukhetha kuphela ngqeqesho olunye okanye amathuba avulwa kwakhona kamva.
texts.g:ef984356: Nanini ukuvela izimvo zokunciphisa ibhajethi yoqeqesho lokusabela kwiintlekele, isaci esithi 'Yubi-muhwan' siyasetyenziswa njengengqiqo yokuphikisa. Esi saci asilunganga ngokungafanelekanga kodwa sibuthathaka ekunyanzeleni. Xa ulungiselelo luphumelela, akukho nto yenzekayo, ngoko impumelelo yalo ayihlali njengemeko ebonakalayo. Inyani yokuba kwakungekho ngozi inokuba bubungqina bokuba uqeqesho lwalusebenza, okanye ubungqina bokuba uqeqesho lwalungafuneki ekuqaleni. Ngoko ukuze kuqinisekiswe abo banoxanduva lwebhajethi, into efunekayo ayisosikhuselo-mazwi kodwa yidatha eqikelela umonakalo obuya kwenzeka ngaphandle koqeqesho.
texts.g:7d9c642e: Umvelisi wenze isibhengezo esikhulu ekhuthaza ulawulo olunobuhlobo nokusingqongileyo, kodwa amaxwebhu akhe okuvakalisa athi ukukhutshwa kwegesi yokufudumeza umhlaba kunyuke ngexesha elifanayo. Kulula ukukubiza oku ngokuthi 'Pyori-budong.' Kodwa Pyori-budong ithetha ukuba ngaphandle nangaphakathi kwahlukile, yaye ukuthetha oko umntu kufuneka azi ngaphakathi. Ukuba isibhengezo sichaza isicwangciso sokunciphisa ukukhutshwa kwaye isicwangciso sisesigabeni sokuphunyezwa, umahluko neenkcukacha zangoku unokuba kukulibaziseka kwexesha kunokukhohlisa. Isigwebo kufuneka senziwe emva kokuqinisekisa ukuba isicwangciso sokunciphisa sichaziwe kangakanani nokuba senziwa njengoko kuthenjisiwe.
texts.g:5b588c16: Iqela elisebenze kunye ixesha elide lihambelana ngaphandle kokuthetha. Abantu bakubiza oku ngokuthi 'Isim-jeonsim' baze bakuthathe njengentsebenziswano efanelekileyo. Kodwa le ndlela inexabiso. Imilinganiselo ekwabelwana ngayo ngokungathethwanga ayishiywa emaxwebhini, ngoko iyanyamalala kanye xa amalungu etshintsha. Kwakhona, inkolelo yokuba 'siyazi ngaphandle kokuthetha' ikhupha nethuba lokubonisa ukuba ngamnye uyiqonda ngokwahlukileyo. I-Isim-jeonsim ibonisa amandla ayo kuphela kwisiseko apho imilinganiselo ebalulekileyo sele ibhaliwe.
texts.g:c86776f8: Iprojekthi ibinomsitho omkhulu wokuqala kodwa phantse akukho ziphumo, ngoko yaphelela kancinane.
texts.g:af636628: Ngenxa yokunyuka kwamaxabiso ezixhobo ezingafakwanga nokungazinzi kwamaxabiso otshintshiselwano ngoku, imeko yokubetha emva kokubetha, inkampani yayeke utyalo-mali lwayo.
texts.g:383161c6: Abagwebi banike amanqaku aphezulu kuba umenzi wesicelo ugcine ukuzola waza waphatha nemibuzo engalindelekanga ngokuziqhelanisa kwangoko.
texts.g:efbd5c64: Abachasi bajonge ngolangazelelo ithuba lokuthatha isabelo sethu semarike, ngoko eli alilo ixesha lokuphumla.
texts.g:96c6433c: Ingcali yaziwa njengomntu ofundileyo ngokubanzi osazi kakuhle hayi kuphela imbali kodwa neenkwenkwezi nonyango.
texts.g:fac27988: Imeko yentlanganiso yehla ngenxa yengxelo eyayibalekela undoqo wombuzo kwaye ihambahamba ngemiba engadibananga.
texts.g:40dc49d8: Isimo sokungagqibi sokuxhela izigqibo nokuguqula izimvo sinzima ukuphumelela ukuthembeka kwamalungu eqela.
texts.g:05e2223f: Ukuba le khontrakthi iyasilela, inkampani eyiqabane ngokuqinisekileyo iya kunqumla nokuthengiselana.
